*bālārkasadṛśākārāṃ bhāsayaṃtīṃ diśo daśa \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. He shall then as before invoke Vāgīśī that pervades his Ātman, that has the form and features of the early morning sun and that illuminates the ten quarters.

## \|\| 12.18.31 \|\|

*tataḥ śeṣaṃ yathāpūrvaṃ kṛtvā devaṃ maheśvaram \|*  
*āvāhyārādhya hutvāsmai śivājñāṃ manasā diśet \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. He shall perform the remaining rites as before. He shall invoke lord Śiva and propitiate him. After performing homa he shall mentally submit to the behest of Śiva.

## \|\| 12.18.32 \|\|

*maheśvaraṃ tathotsṛjya kṛtvānyāṃ ca kalāmimām \|*  
*śāṃtyatītāṃ kalāṃ nītvā tadvyāptimavalokayet \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. After ritualistically dismissing the lord he shall lead another Kalā to Śāntyatītakalā and survey its pervasion.

## \|\| 12.18.33 \|\|

*svātmano vyāpikāṃ tadvadvāgīśāṃ ca viciṃtayet \|*  
*nabhomaṃḍalasaṃkāśāṃ pūrṇāṃtaṃ cāpi pūrvavat \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. As before he shall meditate on Vāgīśā that pervades the Ātman as resembling the permanent. Up to the final offering (Pūrṇāhuti) everything is as before.

## \|\| 12.18.34 \|\|

*kṛtvā śeṣavidhānena samabhyarcya sadāśivam \|*  
*tasmai samādiśedājñāṃ śaṃbhoramitakarmaṇaḥ \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. After doing everything in accordance with injunctions and worshipping Sadāśiva he shall submit to him the behest of Śiva of unmeasured activity.

## \|\| 12.18.35 \|\|

*tatrāpi ca yathāpūrvaṃ śivaṃ śirasi pūrvavat \|*  
*samabhyarcya ca vāgīśaṃ praṇamya ca visarjayet \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. There too, after worshipping Śiva as before on the head and bowing to Vāgīśa he shall ritualistically dismiss him.

## \|\| 12.18.36 \|\|

*tataśśivena samprokṣya śiṣyaṃ śirasi pūrvavat \|*  
*vilayaṃ śāṃtyatītāyāḥ śaktitattve 'tha ciṃtayet \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. Sprinkling then the disciple on the head as before with Śiva mantra he shall think of the merging of Śāntyatītakalā in the Śakti Tattva.

## \|\| 12.18.37 \|\|

*ṣaḍadhvanaḥ pare pāre sarvādhvavyāpinī parām \|*  
*koṭisūryapratīkāśaṃ śaivīṃ śaktiñca cintayet \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. On the other side beyond the six pathways he shall think of the greatest Śakti of Śiva that pervades the pathways and that equals a crore of suns.

## \|\| 12.18.38-39 \|\|

*tadagre śiṣyamānīya śuddhasphaṭikanirmalam \|*  
*prakṣālya kartarīṃ paścācchivaśāstroktamārgataḥ \|\| 38 \|\|*

*kuryāttasya śikhācchedaṃ saha sūtreṇa deśikaḥ \|*  
*tatastāṃ gomaye nyasya śivāgnau juhuyācchikhām \|\| 39 \|\|*

38-39. He shall bring the disciple as pure as the crystal in front of it. After washing the scissors, the preceptor shall cut off the tuft of the disciple as well as his thread in the manner mentioned in the Śaivite Scriptures. He shall place it in cowdung and consign it to Śiva fire.

## \|\| 12.18.40 \|\|

*vauṣaḍaṃtena mūlena punaḥ prakṣālya kartarīm \|*  
*haste śiṣyasya caitanyaṃ taddehe vinivartayet \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. Then with the basic mantra ending with Vauṣaṭ he shall wash the scissors and hands. He shall restore the consciousness of the disciple to his body.

## \|\| 12.18.41-42 \|\|

*tataḥ snātaṃ samācāṃtaṃ kṛtasvastyayanaṃ śiśum \|*  
*praveśya maṃḍalābhyāsaṃ praṇipatya ca daṃḍavat \|\| 41 \|\|*

*pūjāṃ kṛtvā yathānyāyaṃ kriyāvaikalyaśuddhaye \|*  
*vācakenaiva maṃtreṇa juhuyādāhutitrayam \|\| 42 \|\|*

41-42. The disciple shall take bath and perform Ācamana. Good wishes and blessings shall be conferred on him. He shall be brought to the Maṇḍala and made to prostrate. In order to expiate for the shortcomings in the rites due worship shall be performed. The preceptor shall pour three Āhutis by reciting the mantra.

## \|\| 12.18.43 \|\|

*upāṃśūccārayogena juhuyādāhutitrayam \|*  
*punassaṃpūjya deveśaṃ mantravaikalyaśuddhaye \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. In order to expiate for the shortcomings in the Mantra he shall worship the lord of the gods and pour three Āhutis by muttering the mantra.

## \|\| 12.18.44 \|\|

*mānasoccārayogena juhuyādāhutitrayam \|*  
*tatra śaṃbhuṃ samārādhya maṃḍalasthaṃ sahāṃbayā \|\| 44 \|\|*

44\. He shall pour three Āhutis by repeating the mantra mentally. After propitiating Śiva there, in the Maṇḍala and Pārvatī, he shall pour three Āhutis. With palms joined in reverence the preceptor shall pray thereafter.

## \|\| 12.18.45 \|\|

*hutvāhutitrayaṃ paścātprārthayetprāṃjalirguruḥ \|*  
*bhagavaṃstvatprasādena śuddhirasya ṣaḍadhvanaḥ \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. “O lord, due to your grace the, purity of the six pathways of the disciple has been completed. Now, O lord, lead him unto your imperishable abode.”

## \|\| 12.18.46 \|\|

*kṛtā tasmātparaṃ dhāma gamayainaṃ tavāvyayam \|*  
*iti vijñāpya devāya nāḍīsaṃdhānapūrvakam \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. After submitting thus to the lord he shall perform every thing as before, from Nāḍisandhāna to the Pūrṇāhuti. Then he shall purify the elements

## \|\| 12.18.47 \|\|

*pūrṇāṃtaṃ pūrvavatkṛtvā tato bhūtāni śodhayet \|*  
*sthirāsthire tataḥ śuddhyai śītoṣṇe ca tataḥ pade \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. Then, for conducting purity he shall meditate on the regions stable or unstable, hot or cold in the purificatory rite of the Bhūtas in the form of. unity that is pervaded.

## \|\| 12.18.48 \|\|

*dhyāyedvyāptyaikatākāre bhūtaśodhanakarmaṇi \|*  
*bhūtānāṃ graṃthivicchedaṃ kṛtvā tyaktvā sahādhipaiḥ \|\| 48 \|\|*

48\. After cutting off the knot of the Bhūtas he shall join the Bhūtas on to the great lord Śiva. by the path of steady concentration.

## \|\| 12.18.49 \|\|

*bhūtāni sthitayogena yo japetparame śive \|*  
*viśodhyāsya tanuṃ dagdhvā plāvayitvā sudhākaṇaiḥ \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. He shall purify his body, burn it, and drench it with drops of nectar. Steadying the Ātman he shall make his body in consonance with the pure pathways.

## \|\| 12.18.50-51 \|\|

*sthāpyātmānaṃ tataḥ kuryādviśuddhādhvamayaṃ vapuḥ \|*  
*tatrādau śāntyatītāṃ tu vyāpikāṃ svādhvanaḥ kalām \|\| 50 \|\|*

*śuddhāmeva śiśormūrdhni nyasecchāntimukhe tathā \|*  
*vidyāṃ galādinābhyaṃtaṃ pratiṣṭhāṃ tadadhaḥ kramāt \|\| 51 \|\|*

50-51. There at the outset he shall place on the head of the disciple the Śāntyatīta kalā that pervades the pathways; the Śāmikalā on the face; Vidyā kalā in the spot beginning with the throat and ending with the navel; Pratiṣṭhā kalā upto the knees; Nivṛtti kalā beneath it. Thereafter he shall meditate on it.

## \|\| 12.18.52 \|\|

*jānvaṃtaṃ tadadho nyasyennivṛttiṃ cānuciṃtayet \|*  
*svabījaissūtramaṃtraṃ ca nyasyāṃ gaistaṃ śivātmakam \|\| 52 \|\|*

52\. With the basic mantra, its Bījas and ancillaries he shall meditate on him in the form of Śiva. He shall invoke the lord in the lotus of the heart and worship him.

## \|\| 12.18.53 \|\|

*buddhvā taṃ hṛdayāṃbhoje devamāvāhya pūjayet \|*  
*āśāsya nityasāṃnidhyaṃ śivasvātmyaṃ śiśau guruḥ \|\| 53 \|\|*

53\. The teacher shall pray for the perpetual presence of Śiva in the disciple. He shall impose good qualities on the disciple possessed of Śaivite splendour.

## \|\| 12.18.54-55 \|\|

*śivatejomayasyāsya śiśorāpādayedguṇān \|*  
*aṇimādīnprasīdeti pradadyādāhutitrayam \|\| 54 \|\|*

*tathaiva tu guṇāneva punarasyopapādayet \|*  
*sarvajñātāṃ tathā tṛptiṃ bodhaṃ cādyantavarjitam \|\| 55 \|\|*

54-55. He shall perform three Āhutis praying—“O lord, be pleased to bestow on him the attributes Aṇimā, etc.” Likewise he shall invoke the lord for the presence of these qualities in him, viz:—omniscience, contentment, eternal enlightenment, unviolated Śakti, freedom and infinite power.

## \|\| 12.18.56 \|\|

*aluptaśaktiṃ svātantryamanaṃtāṃ śaktimeva ca \|*  
*tato devamanujñāpya sadyādikalaśaistu tam \|\| 56 \|\|*

56\. Then securing permission from the lord and meditating on him in the heart he shall pour water over the disciple from the vessels of Sadyojāta etc. in order.

## \|\| 12.18.57 \|\|

*abhiṣiṃceta deveśaṃ dhyāyanhṛdi yathākramam \|*  
*athopaveśya taṃ śiṣyaṃ śivamabhyarcya pūrvavat \|\| 57 \|\|*

57\. Then after making the disciple sit and worship Śiva as before he shall secure permission from the lord and impart Śiva’s knowledge to him.

## \|\| 12.18.58 \|\|

*labdhānujñaḥ śivācchaivīṃ vidyāmasmai samādiśet \|*  
*oṃkārapūrvikāṃ tatra saṃpuṭāntu namo 'ṃtagām \|\| 58 \|\|*

58\. He shall impart also the plicated Mantra beginning with Om and ending with Namaḥ and the Śaktividyā of a similar nature, accompanied by Śiva and Śakti.

## \|\| 12.18.59 \|\|

*śivaśaktiyutāñcaiva śaktividyāṃ ca tādṛśīm \|*  
*ṛṣiṃ chandaśca devaṃ ca śivatāṃ śivayostathā \|\| 59 \|\|*

59\. He shall instruct him in the name of the sage, metre, deity and the efficacy of Śiva and Śivā, the worship of Śiva, his Āvaraṇa and the postures.

## \|\| 12.18.60 \|\|

*pūjāṃ sāvaraṇāṃ śambhorāsanāni ca sandiśet \|*  
*punaḥ saṃpūjya deveśaṃ yanmayā samanuṣṭhitam \|\| 60 \|\|*

60\. Worshipping the lord of the gods again he shall submit to Śiva—‘Please make whatever has been performed by me a well accomplished thing’.

## \|\| 12.18.61 \|\|

*sukṛtaṃ kuru tatsarvamiti vijñāpayecchivam \|*  
*sahaśiṣyo gururdevaṃ daṇḍavatkṣitimaṃḍale \|\| 61 \|\|*

61\. Followed by his disciple the preceptor shall prostrate before the lord on the ground. Thereafter he shall ritualistically dismiss him from the Maṇḍala and the fire.

## \|\| 12.18.62 \|\|

*praṇamyodvāsayettasmānmaṃḍalātpāvakādapi \|*  
*tataḥ sadasikāḥ sarve pūjyāḥ pūjārhakāḥ kramāt \|\| 62 \|\|*

62\. Then those assembled there and worthy of worship shall be duly worshipped.

## \|\| 12.18.63 \|\|

*sevyā vittānusāreṇa sadasyāśca sahartvijaḥ \|*  
*vittaśāṭhyaṃ na kurvīta yadīcchecchivamātmanaḥ \|\| 63 \|\|*

63\. The members of the assembly including the Ṛtviks shall be honoured with the gifts. He who desires his welfare shall not be niggardly.

## Chapter 19 - The consecration of the aspirant and the greatness of the Mantra

## \|\| 12.19.1 \|\|

*upamanyuruvāca \|*  
*ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi sādhakaṃ nāma nāmataḥ \|*  
*saṃskāramantramāhātmyaṃ kathane sūcitaṃ mayā \|\| 1 \|\|*

Upamanyu said:—

1\. Hereafter I shall explain the consecratory rite ‘Sādhaka’ indicated by me while explaining the greatness of the mantra.

## \|\| 12.19.2 \|\|

*saṃpūjya maṃḍale devaṃ sthāpya kumbhe ca pūrvavat \|*  
*hutvā śiṣyamanuṣṇīṣaṃ prāpayedbhuvi maṃḍale \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. As before the lord shall be worshipped in the Maṇḍala and the vessels and the homa performed. The disciple shall be brought to the Maṇḍala without his headdress.

## \|\| 12.19.3-4 \|\|

*pūrvāṃtaṃ pūrvavatkṛtvā hutvāhutiśataṃ tathā \|*  
*saṃtarpya mūlamantreṇa kalaśairdeśikottamaḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

*sandīpya ca yathāpūrvaṃ kṛtvā pūrvoditaṃ kramāt \|*  
*abhiṣicya yathāpūrvaṃ pradadyānmantramuttamam \|\| 4 \|\|*

3-4. After performing hundred Āhutis and the rites upto the Pūrṇāhuti, and the rite of Tarpaṇa with the water from the jars repeating the Mūlamantra, the preceptor shall make offering and perform every rite as mentioned before. He shall pour water on the disciple and impart the excellent Mantra.

## \|\| 12.19.5 \|\|

*tatra vidyopadeśāṃtaṃ kṛtvā vistaraśaḥ kramāt \|*  
*puṣpāmbunā śiśoḥ pāṇau vidyāṃ śaivīṃ samarpayet \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. There, after imparting the Śaivitc lore in detail, he shall place this in the disciple’s hand with water from the flowers.

## \|\| 12.19.6 \|\|

*tavaihikāmuṣmikayoḥ sarvasiddhiphalapradaḥ \|*  
*bhavatyeva mahāmantraḥ prasādātparameṣṭhinaḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. ‘By the grace of the supreme lord this great Mantra shall certainly confer on you the Siddhis both of this world and the next one.’

## \|\| 12.19.7 \|\|

*ityutvā devamabhyarcya labdhānujñaḥ śivādguruḥ \|*  
*sādhanaṃ śivayogaṃ ca sādhakāya samādiśet \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. After saying this, the preceptor shall worship lord Śiva and secure his formal permission. He shall then impart to the aspirant the Yoga of Śiva, the means of liberation.

## \|\| 12.19.8-9 \|\|

*tacchrutvā gurusaṃdeśaṃ kramaśo maṃtrasādhakaḥ \|*  
*purato viniyogasya mantrasādhanamācaret \|\| 8 \|\|*

*sādhanaṃ mūlamantrasya puraścaraṇamucyate \|*  
*purataścaraṇīyatvādviniyogākhyakarmaṇaḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

8-9. On hearing the instructions of the preceptor, the aspirant disciple shall practise the Mantra before utilising it. This practice of the Mūlamantra is called Puraścaraṇa since it has to be practised before the rite Viniyoga.

## \|\| 12.19.10 \|\|

*nātyantaṃ karaṇīyantu mumukṣormantrasādhanam \|*  
*kṛtantu tadihānyatra tāsyāpi śubhadaṃ bhavet \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. A devotee who desires salvation need not practise the mantra too often. If practised moderately it is auspicious here and hereafter.

## \|\| 12.19.11-16 \|\|

*śubhe 'hani śubhe deśe kāle vā doṣavarjite \|*  
*śukladantanakhaḥ snātaḥ kṛtapūrvāhṇikakriyaḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

*alaṃkṛtya yathā labdhairgaṃdhamālyavibhūṣaṇaiḥ \|*  
*soṣṇīṣaḥ sottarāsaṃgaḥ sarvaśuklasamāhitaḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

*devālaye gṛhe 'nyasmindeśe vā sumanohare \|*  
*sukhenābhyastapūrveṇa tvāsanena kṛtāsanaḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

*tanuṃ kṛtvātmanaḥ śaivīṃ śivaśāstroktavartmanā \|*  
*saṃpūjya devadeveśaṃ nakulīśvaramīśvaram \|\| 14 \|\|*

*nivedya pāyasaṃ tasmai samapyārādhanaṃ kramāt \|*  
*praṇipatya ca taṃ devaṃ prāptānujñaśca tanmukhāt \|\| 15 \|\|*

*koṭivāraṃ tadardhaṃ vā tadardhaṃ vā japecchivam \|*  
*lakṣaviṃśatikaṃ vāpi daśalakṣamathāpi vā \|\| 16 \|\|*

11-16. On an auspicious day, in a holy spot, in the favourable season, the devotee shall take bath and perform the rites of the forenoon scrupulously keeping the teeth and the nails sparkling white in colour. He shall bedeck himself in scented flowers, garlands and ornaments readily available. He shall wear a white head-dress and a white upper cloth. His dress shall be white and pure. He shall sit comfortably in the.manner to which he is accustomed cither in the temple or in his own house or in any charming place. He shall make his body worthy of Śaivite rites along the path mentioned in the Śaivite scriptures. He shall worship the lord Nakul-Īśvara. He shall offer milk pudding as Naivedya and conclude the rite of propitiation. After bowing to him he shall formally take his permission. He shall repeat the mantra ten million or five million, or two and a half million or two million or a million times.

## \|\| 12.19.17 \|\|

*tataśca pāyasākṣāralavaṇaikamitāśanaḥ \|*  
*ahiṃsakaḥ kṣamī śāṃto dāṃtaścaiva sadā bhavet \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. Thereafter his diet shall be limited in quantity and confined to milk pudding and such other as is devoid of salt and acidity. He shall not be violent. He shall be forbearing, quiet and self-possessed for ever.

## \|\| 12.19.18 \|\|

*alābhe pāyasasyāśnanphalamūlādikāni vā \|*  
*vihitāni śivenaiva viśiṣṭānyuttarottaram \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. If milk pudding is not available he shall take fruits and roots. They are ordained by Śiva himself and in the series of order gradually they are better.

## \|\| 12.19.19-20 \|\|

*caruṃ bhakṣyamatho saktukaṇānyāvakameva ca \|*  
*śākaṃ payo dadhi ghṛtaṃ mūlaṃ phalamathodakam \|\| 19 \|\|*

*abhimaṃtrya ca mantreṇa bhakṣyabhojyādikāni ca \|*  
*sādhane 'sminviśeṣeṇa nityaṃ bhuñjīta vāgyataḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

19-20. Whatever he cats daily whether, Caru, ground flour of fried grains, gruel, vegetables, milk, curd, ghee, roots, fruits and water he shall take in only after consecrating it with the mantras while the practice of the mantra is being kept up. He shall remain silent too.

## \|\| 12.19.21 \|\|

*mantrāṣṭaśatapūtena jalena śucinā vratī \|*  
*snāyānnadīnadotthena prokṣayedvātha śaktitaḥ \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. He shall take bath in the water from east-flowing or west-flowing rivers and purify himself by repeating hundred and eight mantras or sprinkle himself as strength permits him.

## \|\| 12.19.22 \|\|

*tarpayecca tathā nityaṃ juhuyācca śivānale \|*  
*saptabhiḥ pañcabhirdravyaistribhirvātha ghṛtena vā \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. He shall perform the rites of Tarpaṇa and homa in the Śaivite fire with seven, five or three materials of worship or with ghee alone.

## \|\| 12.19.23 \|\|

*itthaṃ bhaktyā śivaṃ śaivo yaḥ sādhayati sādhakaḥ \|*  
*tasyehāmutra duṣprāpaṃ na kiṃcidapi vidyate \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. Nothing is inaccessible in this world or the next to him who is a devotee of Śiva and who is an aspirant practising the mantra of Śiva thus with devotion.

## \|\| 12.19.24 \|\|

*athavā 'haraharmaṃtraṃ japedekāgramānasaḥ \|*  
*anaśnanneva sāhasraṃ vinā mantrasya sādhanam \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. Or he shall perform the Japa of the mantra a thousand times everyday, with full concentration of the mind. He shall not take food before the thousand Japas are completed.

## \|\| 12.19.25 \|\|

*na tasya durlabhaṃ kiṃcinna tasyāstyaśubhaṃ kvacit \|*  
*iha vidyāṃ śriyaṃ saukhyaṃ labdhvā muktiṃ ca viṃdati \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. Nothing is difficult of access to him. Nothing is inauspicious to him. He attains learning, prosperity, happiness, and salvation.

## \|\| 12.19.26 \|\|

*sādhane viniyoge ca nitye naimittike tathā \|*  
*japejjalairbhasmanā ca snātvā mantreṇa ca kramāt \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. Whether in the course of practice or application, whether done as a Nitya rite or a Naimittika rite he shall perform the Japa after taking bath with water or with Bhasma.

## \|\| 12.19.27 \|\|

*śucirbaddhaśikhassūtrī sapavitrakarastathā \|*  
*dhṛtatripuṃḍrarudrākṣo vidyāṃ pañcākṣarīṃ japet \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. He shall perform the Japa of the five-syllabled mantra, pure in person and mind, with the tuft tied up, wearing the sacred thread on the body and having the Pavitra round the finger. He shall have the Tripuṇḍra marks and shall wear Rudrākṣa beads.

## Chapter 20 - Special consecration

## \|\| 12.20.1 \|\|

*upamanyuruvāca \|*  
*athaivaṃ saṃskṛtaṃ śiṣyaṃ kṛtapāśupatavratam \|*  
*ācāryatve 'bhiṣiṃceta tadyogatvena cānyathā \|\| 1 \|\|*

Upamanyu said:—

1\. The preceptor shall crown consecrated disciple as a preceptor after he has performed íhe Pāśupata rite if he has the requisite qualities and not otherwise.

## \|\| 12.20.2 \|\|

*maṇḍalaṃ pūrvavatkṛttvā saṃpūjya parameśvaram \|*  
*sthāpayatpañcakalaśāndikṣu madhye ca pūrvavat \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. The Maṇḍala shall be made as before and after worshipping the lord he shall, as before, place five water-jars one in each of the four quarters and one in the middle.

## \|\| 12.20.3 \|\|

*nivṛttiṃ purato nyasya pratiṣṭhāṃ paścime ghaṭe \|*  
*vidyāṃ dakṣiṇataḥ śāṃtimuttare madhyataḥ parām \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. Nivṛtti Kalā shall be installed in the vessel in the east, Pratiṣṭhā Kalā in the vessel in the west; Vidyā Kalā in the south. Śānti Kalā in the north and the Parā Kalā in the middle.

## \|\| 12.20.4 \|\|

*kṛtvā rakṣādikaṃ tatra baddhvā mudrāṃ ca dhainavīm \|*  
*abhimaṃtrya ghaṭānhutvā pūrṇāṃtaṃ ca yathā purā \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. The following rites shall be performed as before, viz. those of Rakṣā, the Mudrābandha or the gesture of the cow, repetition of mantra over the vessels and the homa till the Pūrṇāhuti.

## \|\| 12.20.5 \|\|

*praveśya maṃḍale śiṣyamanuṣṇīṣaṃ ca deśikaḥ \|*  
*tarpaṇādyaṃ tu maṃtrāṇāṃ kuryātpūrvāvasānakam \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. The preceptor shall make the disciple enter the Maṇḍala. He shall not wear the head-dress. The Tarpaṇa and other rites too shall be performed as before.

## \|\| 12.20.6 \|\|

*tataḥ saṃpūjya deveśamanujñāpya ca pūrvavat \|*  
*abhiṣekāya taṃ śiṣyamāsanaṃ tvadhirohayet \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. Then the lord shall be worshipped and his permission obtained ritualistically. He shall make the disciple sit on the seat for the pouring of water.

## \|\| 12.20.7 \|\|

*sakalīkṛtya taṃ paścātkalāpañcakarūpiṇam \|*  
*nyastamaṃtratanuṃ baddhvā śivaṃ śiṣyaṃ samarpayet \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. The disciple imagined as the five-fold offering of fruits shall be united with the Kalās and conceived as Śiva inasmuch as the mantra has been installed on his body; he shall be worshipped then.

## \|\| 12.20.8 \|\|

*tato nivṛttikuṃbhādighaṭānuddhṛtya vai kramāt \|*  
*madhyamāntācchivenaiva śiṣyaṃ tamabhiṣecayat \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. Then the water from the vessels beginning with Nivṛtti Kumbha and ending with the middle shall be poured over the disciple repeating the names of Śiva.

## \|\| 12.20.9 \|\|

*śivahastaṃ samarpyātha śiśoḥ śirasi deśikaḥ \|*  
*śivabhāvasamāpannaḥ śivācāryaṃ tamādiśet \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. Then the preceptor shall place his hand, repeating the Śiva mantra on the head of the disciple. The preceptor equipped with the piety towards Śiva shall call him Śivācārya.

## \|\| 12.20.10 \|\|

*athālaṃkṛtya taṃ devamārādhya śivamaṇḍale \|*  
*śatamaṣṭottaraṃ hutvā dadyātpūrṇāhutiṃ tataḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. He shall be adorned. Then the preceptor shall propitiate him in Śivamaṇḍala. After performing hundred and eight Āhutis he shall offer the Pūrṇāhuti.

## \|\| 12.20.11 \|\|

*punaḥ sampūjya deveśaṃ praṇamya bhuvi daṃḍavat \|*  
*śirasyaṃjalimādhāya śivaṃ vijñāpayedguruḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. The preceptor shall worship the lord and prostrate on the ground with palms joined in reverence over the head. He shall submit to the lord Śiva.

## \|\| 12.20.12 \|\|

*bhagavaṃstvatprasādena deśikoyaṃ mayā kṛtaḥ \|*  
*anugṛhya tvayā deva divyājñāsmai pradīyatām \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. “O lord, by your grace this disciple has been made a preceptor by me. O lord, after blessing him, may the divine behest be bestowed on him.

## \|\| 12.20.13 \|\|

*evaṃ vijñāpya śiṣyeṇa saha bhūyaḥ praṇamya ca \|*  
*śivaṃ śivāgamaṃ divyaṃ pūjayecchivavadguruḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. After submitting thus, the preceptor shall bow to Śiva again along with the disciple. He shall worship the divine Śiva-Āgama in the same manner as Śiva himself.

## \|\| 12.20.14 \|\|

*punaḥ śivamanujñāpya śivajñānasya pustakam \|*  
*ubhābhyāmatha pāṇibhyāṃ dadyācchiṣyāya deśikaḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. Then he shall take the ritualistic permission from Śiva. The preceptor shall take the book “Śivajñāna” with both the hands and hand it over to the disciple.

## \|\| 12.20.15 \|\|

*sa tāmmūrdhni samādhāya vidyāṃ vidyāsanopari \|*  
*adhiropya yathānyāyamabhivaṃdya samarcayet \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. The disciple shall accept it with his bent head and place the Vidyā over the scat. He shall then respectfully adore it.

## \|\| 12.20.16 \|\|

*atha tasmai gururdadyādrājopakaraṇānyapi \|*  
*ācāryapadavīṃ prāpto rājyaṃ cāpi yato 'rhati \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. The preceptor shall give him royal paraphernalia since one who has attained the status of Ācārya deserves even a kingdom.

## \|\| 12.20.17 \|\|

*athānuśāsanaṃ kuryātpūrvairācaritaṃ yathā \|*  
*yathā ca śivaśāstroktaṃ yathā lokeṣu pūjyate \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. Then he shall impart to him the modes of discipline followed by elders as mentioned in Śaivite sacred literature and as honoured amongst the people.

## \|\| 12.20.18 \|\|

*śiṣyānparikṣya yatnena śivaśāstroktalakṣaṇaiḥ \|*  
*saṃskṛtya ca śivajñānaṃ tebhyo dadyācca deśikaḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. The preceptor shall test the disciples assiduously through the characteristics mentioned in Śaivite scriptures. He shall consecrate them and impart to them the Śaivite knowledge.

## \|\| 12.20.19 \|\|

*evaṃ sarvamanāyāsaṃ śaucaṃ kṣāṃtiṃ dayāṃ tathā \|*  
*aspṛhāmapyasūyāṃ ca yatnena ca vibhāvayet \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. He shall infuse in him all these qualities without difficulty, viz. purity, forbearance, mercifulness, non-covetousness and absence of jealousy even strenuously.

## \|\| 12.20.20 \|\|

*itthamādiśya taṃ śiṣyaṃ śivamudvāsya maṃḍalāt \|*  
*śivakuṃbhānalādīṃśca sadasyānapi pūjayet \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. After thus urging the disciple he shall ritualistically dismiss Śiva from the Maṇḍala. He shall worship the Śivakumbha, fire and others who had been invited there.

## \|\| 12.20.21-23 \|\|

*yugapadvātha saṃskārānkurvīta sagaṇo guruḥ \|*  
*tatra yatra dvayaṃ vāpi prayogasyopadiśyate \|\| 21 \|\|*

*tadādāveva kalaśānkalpayedadhvaśuddhivat \|*  
*kṛtvā samayasaṃskāramabhiṣekaṃ vinākhilam \|\| 22 \|\|*

*samabhyarcya śivaṃ bhūyaḥ kṛtvā cādhvaviśodhanam \|*  
*tasminparisamāpte tu punardevaṃ prapūjayet \|\| 23 \|\|*

21-23. Or the preceptor accompanied by his attendants shall simultaneously perform all the consecratory rites; the rites shall be repeated twice. The water-vessels shall be installed in the beginning itself as in the rite of the purification of the paths. After performing the Samaya consecration, wholly without ablution Śiva shall be worshipped again after the purification of the path. When that is concluded he shall worship the lord again.

## \|\| 12.20.24 \|\|

*hutvā maṃtrantu saṃtarpya saṃdīpyāśāsya ceśvaram \|*  
*samarpya maṃtraṃ śiṣyasya pāṇau śeṣaṃ samāpayet \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. After homa the Tarpaṇa rite of the mantra shall be performed. After the blessing of the lord the mantra shall be placed in the hand of the disciple and the remaining rites concluded.

## \|\| 12.20.25 \|\|

*athavā maṃtrasaṃskāramanuciṃtyākhilaṃ kramāt \|*  
*adhvaśuddhiṃ guruḥ kuryādabhiṣekāvasānikam \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. Or beginning with the consecration of the Mantra and concluding with the rite of Abhiṣeka the rites of the purification of the path shall be performed by the preceptor.

## \|\| 12.20.26 \|\|

*tatra yaḥ śāntyatītādikalāsu vihito vidhiḥ \|*  
*sa sarvo 'pi vidhātavyastattvatrayaviśodhane \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. In the purificatory rite of the three Tattvas the rites mentioned for the Kalās Śāntyatīta and others shall be performed.

## \|\| 12.20.27 \|\|

*śivavidyātmatattvākhyaṃ tattvatrayamudāhṛtam \|*  
*śaktau śivastato vidyāttasyāstvātmā samudbabhau \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. Śiva, Vidyā and Ātmatattva—these are the three Tattvas. Śiva came out of Śakti and from Śiva the Vidyā and from Vidyā the Ātman.

## \|\| 12.20.28 \|\|

*śivena śāṃtyatītādhvā vyāptastadaparaḥ paraḥ \|*  
*vidyayā pariśiṣṭo 'dhvā hyātmanā nikhilaḥ kramāt \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. The Śāntyatīta path is pervaded by Śiva. The next path is pervaded by Vidyā and the remaining paths are pervaded by Ātman.

## \|\| 12.20.29 \|\|

*durlabhaṃ śāṃbhavaṃ matvā maṃtramūlaṃ manīṣiṇaḥ \|*  
*śāktaṃ śaṃsīta saṃskāraṃ śivaśāstrārthapāragāḥ \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. Intelligent persons who have mastered Śaivite Scriptures laud the consecration through Śakti after considering that the consecration through Śiva is very difficult of access.

## \|\| 12.20.30 \|\|

*iti te sarvamākhyātaṃ saṃskārākhyasya karmaṇaḥ \|*  
*cāturvidhyamidaṃ kṛṣṇa kiṃ bhūya śrotumicchasi \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. O Kṛṣṇa, thus the four types of consecratory rites have been narrated to you. What else do you wish to hear?

## Chapter 21 - Nitya and Naimittika rites

## \|\| 12.21.1 \|\|

*kṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*bhagavañchrotumicchāmi śivāśramaniṣeviṇām \|*  
*śivaśāstroditaṃ karma nityanaimittikaṃ tathā \|\| 1 \|\|*

Śrī Kṛṣṇa said:—

1\. O holy lord, I wish to hear the compulsory and optional rites of those who follow Śaivite conduct of life, as mentioned in Śaivite scriptures.

## \|\| 12.21.2 \|\|

*upamanyuruvāca \|*  
*prātarutthāya śayanāddhyātvā devaṃ sahāmbayā \|*  
*vicārya kāryaṃ nirgacchedgṛhādabhyudite 'ruṇe \|\| 2 \|\|*

Upamanyu said:—

2\. He shall rise early in the morning and meditate on the lord and the goddess For performing necessaries he shall go out of the house when the sun has risen.

## \|\| 12.21.3 \|\|

*abādhe vijane deśe kuryādāvaśyakaṃ tataḥ \|*  
*kṛtvā śaucaṃ vidhānena daṃtadhāvanamācaret \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. In a secluded spot where there is no hindrance he shall evacuate his bowels. After washing in accordance with the rules he shall clean the teeth.

## \|\| 12.21.4 \|\|

*alābhe daṃtakāṣṭhānāmaṣṭamyādidineṣu ca \|*  
*apāṃ dvādaśagaṇḍūṣaiḥ kuryādāsyaviśodhanam \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. On the eighth and other days whenever tooth-brush twig is not available he shall gargle twelve times and clean the teeth.

## \|\| 12.21.5 \|\|

*ācamya vidhivatpaścādvāruṇaṃ snānamācaret \|*  
*nadyāṃ vā devakhāte vā hrade vātha gṛhe 'pi vā \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. After performing Ācamana he shall take bath either in a river or in a pond or in an eddy or in the house itself.

## \|\| 12.21.6 \|\|

*snānadravyāṇi tattīre sthāpayitvā bahirmalam \|*  
*vyāpohya mṛdamālipya snātvā gomayamālipet \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. The toilet articles shall be kept on the bank. The dirt of the body shall be washed off. The clay shall be applied over the body. After taking bath he shall apply cow-dung over the body.

## \|\| 12.21.7 \|\|

*snātvā punaḥ punarvastraṃ tyaktvāvātha viśodhya ca \|*  
*susnāto nṛpavadbhūyaḥ śuddhaṃ vāso vasīta ca \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. He shall take bath again and abandon the old cloth. Like a king he shall put on new dress.

## \|\| 12.21.8 \|\|

*malasnānaṃ sugaṃdhādyaiḥ snānaṃ dantaviśodhanam \|*  
*na kuryādbrahmacārī ca tapasvī vidhavā tathā \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. Neither a Brahmacārin nor an ascetic nor a widow shall take bath with the scented soaps. They shall not use tooth-brush twig for cleaning the teeth.

## \|\| 12.21.9 \|\|

*sopavītaśśikhāṃ baddhā praviśya ca jalāṃtaram \|*  
*avagāhya samācāṃto jale nyasyettrimaṃḍalam \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. He shall tie his tuft and have the sacred thread in the normal way. He shall enter water and plunge therein. After performing the Ācamana he shall take plunge thrice in the water.

## \|\| 12.21.10-11 \|\|

*saumye magnaḥ punarmaṃtraṃ japecchaktyā śivaṃ smaret \|*  
*utthāyācamya tenaiva svātmānamabhiṣecayet \|\| 10 \|\|*

*gośṛṃgeṇa sadarbheṇa pālāśena dalena vā \|*  
*pādmena vātha pāṇibhyāṃ pañcakṛtvastrireva vā \|\| 11 \|\|*

10-11. After plunging in, he shall repeat the mantra and think on Śiva and Śakti. He shall get up and perform Ācamana. Then he shall pour water over the body with the cow-horn along with Darbha, or with the leaf of a Palāśa tree, or the lotus leaf or with both the hands, five or three times.

## \|\| 12.21.12 \|\|

*udyānādau gṛhe caiva vardhanyā kalaśena vā \|*  
*avagāhanakāle 'dbhirmaṃtritairabhiṣecayet \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. If he is taking bath in a garden or in the house he shall pour water with Vardhanī or a water-jar. When taking bath he shall pour water with the mantras.

## \|\| 12.21.13 \|\|

*atha cedvāruṇaṃ kartumaśaktaḥ śuddhavāsasā \|*  
*ārdreṇa śodhayeddehamāpādatalamastakam \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. If one is unable to take water-bath, one shall take a wet cloth and wipe the body from foot to head.

## \|\| 12.21.14 \|\|

*āgneyaṃ vātha vā māṃtraṃ kuryātsnānaṃ śivena vā \|*  
*śivaciṃtāparaṃ snānaṃ yuktasyātmīyamucyate \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. Or he shall take the self-bath. That is, one shall repeat the name Śiva. That bath wherein Śiva is remembered is called the self-bath of a Yogin.

## \|\| 12.21.15 \|\|

*svasūtroktavidhānena maṃtrācamanapūrvakam \|*  
*ācaredbrahmayajñāṃtaṃ kṛtvā devāditarpaṇam \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. In accordance with the rules prescribed in one’s code he shall perform the rites of Tarpaṇa for the gods beginning with Ācamana and ending with Brahmayajña.

## \|\| 12.21.16 \|\|

*maṃḍalasthaṃ mahādevaṃ dhyātvābhyarcya yathāvidhi \|*  
*dadyādarghyaṃ tatastasmai śivāyādityarūpiṇe \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. Meditating on lord Śiva stationed in the Maṇḍala and worshipping him duly he shall offer Arghya to Śiva in the form of the sun.

## \|\| 12.21.17-19 \|\|

*atha vaitatsvasūtroktaṃ kṛtvā hastau viśodhayet \|*  
*karanyāsaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā sakalīkṛtavigrahaḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

*vāmahastagatāṃbhobhirgaṃdhasiddhārthakānvitaiḥ \|*  
*kuśapuṃjena vābhyukṣya mūlamaṃtrasamanvitaiḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

*āpohiṣṭhādibhirmantraiḥ śeṣamāghrāya vai jalam \|*  
*vāmanāsāpuṭenaiva devaṃ saṃbhāvayetsitam \|\| 19 \|\|*

17-19. Or after performing what is prescribed in one’s own Sūtra he shall wash his hands and perform the rite of Karanyāsa. He shall make his body united with the Kalās through water taken in the left palm and containing scents and white mustard. He shall then sprinkle water over him through the bunch of Kuśa grass repeating the mantras ‘Āpo hi ṣṭhā’ etc. accompanied by the basic mantra. Sniffing at the water remaining in the left nostril he shall think on lord Śiva again.

## \|\| 12.21.20 \|\|

*arghamādāya dehasthaṃ savyanāsāpuṭena ca \|*  
*kṛṣṇavarṇena bāhyasthaṃ bhāvayecca śilāgatam \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. Taking off the dark-complexioned sin of the body through the left nostril and that outside, he shall conceive it as gone to the rock.

## \|\| 12.21.21 \|\|

*tarpayedatha devebhya ṛṣibhiśca viśeṣataḥ \|*  
*bhūtebhyaśca pitṛbhyaśca dadyādarghyaṃ yathāvidhi \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. He shall perform the Tarpaṇa rite to the gods, to the sages in particular, to the Bhūtas and to the Pitṛs. He shall offer Arghya duly.

## \|\| 12.21.22 \|\|

*raktacaṃdanatoyena hastamātreṇa maṃḍalam \|*  
*suvṛttaṃ kalpayedbhūmau raktacūrṇādyalaṃkṛtam \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. With a handful of red sandal water he shall make a circular Maṇḍala on the ground and embellish it with red powder.

## \|\| 12.21.23 \|\|

*tatra saṃpūjayedbhānuṃ svakīyāvaraṇaiḥ saha \|*  
*svakholkāyeti maṃtreṇa sāṃgatassukhasiddhaye \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. There he shall worship the sun with the covers along with his ancillaries repeating the mantra “Khakholkāya” for securing happiness.

## \|\| 12.21.24-25 \|\|

*punaśca maṃḍalaṃ kṛtvā tadaṃgaiḥ paripūjya ca \|*  
*tatra sthāpya hemapātraṃ māgadhaprasthasaṃmitam \|\| 24 \|\|*

*pūrayedgaṃdhatoyena raktacaṃdanayoginā \|*  
*raktapuṣpaistilaiścaiva kuśākṣatasamanvitaiḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

24-25. He shall make another Maṇḍala and worship it with its ancillaries. He shall place there a gold-vessel of the size of the Prastha current in the Magadha land. He shall fill it with scented water and red sandal along with red flowers, gingelly seeds, Akṣatas and Kuśa grass.

## \|\| 12.21.26-29 \|\|

*dūrvāpāmārgagavyaiśca kevalena jalena vā \|*  
*jānubhyāṃ dharaṇīṃ gatvā natvā devaṃ ca maṃḍale \|\| 26 \|\|*

*kṛtvā śirasi tatpātraṃ dadyādarghyaṃ śivāya tat \|*  
*athavāṃjalinā toyaṃ sadarbhaṃ mūlavidyayā \|\| 27 \|\|*

*utkṣipedambarasthāya śivāyādityamūrtaye \|*  
*kṛtvā punaḥ karanyāsaṃ karaśodhanapūrvakam \|\| 28 \|\|*

*buddhveśānādisadyāṃtaṃ pañcabrahmamayaṃ śivam \|*  
*gṛhītvā bhasitaṃ mantrairvimṛjyāṅgāni saṃspṛśet \|\| 29 \|\|*

26-29. Or it can contain Dūrvā, Apāmārga and other articles or mere water. He shall keep that pot over his head. Kneeling down he shall bow to the lord in the Maṇḍala and offer it as Arghya to Śiva. Or he shall take water in the palms joined together and throw it up as an offering to Śiva stationed in the sky in the form of the sun. The water shall contain Darbha grass and the basic Mantra shall be repeated. Again he shall wash his hands and perform the Karanyāsa realising Śiva in the form of the five Brahmans\[4\] from Īśāna to Sadyojāta. He shall take Bhasma, in the hand and repeating mantra yā dināntaiḥ he shall touch limbs in order, viz—the face, chest, private parts, feet.

## \|\| 12.21.30-31 \|\|

*yā dināṃtaiśśirovaktrahṛdguhyacaraṇānkramāt \|*  
*tato mūlena sarvāṃgamālabhya vasanāntaram \|\| 30 \|\|*

*paridhāya dvirācamya prokṣyaikādaśamantritaiḥ \|*  
*jalairācchādya vāso 'yaddvirācamya śivaṃ smaret \|\| 31 \|\|*

30-31. Then repeating the basic mantra he shall touch all parts of the body and wear another cloth. After performing Ācamana twice he shall sprinkle water over himself eleven times repeating the mantra. He shall wear another cloth, perform Ācamana twice and remember Śiva.

## \|\| 12.21.32 \|\|

*punarnyastakaro mantrī tripuṃḍraṃ bhasmanā likhet \|*  
*avakramāya taṃ vyaktaṃ lalāṭe gandhavāriṇā \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. He shall perform Karanyāsa again and repeating the mantra he shall apply the Tripuṇḍra marks. On the forehead the marks shall be clear, broad and straight. Scented water shall be used to paste the Bhasma.

## \|\| 12.21.33-34 \|\|

*vṛttaṃ vā caturasraṃ vā bindumardhendumeva vā \|*  
*lalāṭe yādṛśaṃ puṇḍraṃ likhitaṃ bhasmanā punaḥ \|\| 33 \|\|*

*tādṛśaṃ bhujayormūrdhni stanayoraṃtare likhet \|*  
*sarvāṃgoddhūlanaṃ caiva na samānaṃ tripuṇḍrakaiḥ \|\| 34 \|\|*

33-34. It may also be circular or square in shape. It may be a single dot or a semicircular figure. But he shall apply the marks in the same way on the arms, head and chest as on the forehead. Dusting with the Bhasma is not on a par with Tripuṇḍra.

## \|\| 12.21.35 \|\|

*tasmāttripuṇḍramevaikaṃ likheduddhūlanaṃ vinā \|*  
*rudrākṣāndhārayedmūrdhni kaṃṭhe śrote kare tathā \|\| 35 \|\|*

35\. Hence it is better to have Tripuṇḍras above without dusting. He shall wear Rudrākṣa beads on the head, round the neck, in the ears and hands.

## \|\| 12.21.36 \|\|

*suvarṇavarṇamacchinnaṃ śubhaṃ nānyairdhṛtaṃ śubham \|*  
*viprādīnāṃ kramācchreṣṭhaṃ pītaṃ raktamathāsitam \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. The Rudrākṣa bead with the lustre of gold is excellent. It shall not be cut. What is not worn by others is the most auspicious. To the three castes the colours yellow, red and black are respectively excellent.

## \|\| 12.21.37 \|\|

*tadalābhe yathālābhaṃ dhāraṇīyamadūṣitam \|*  
*tatrāpi nottaraṃ nīcairdhāryaṃ nīcamathottaraiḥ \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. If the excellent bead is not available whatever is available shall be used for wearing. But it shall not be defective. The lower caste men shall not wear the bead intended for the higher caste. The higher caste men can wear the other types too.

## \|\| 12.21.38-39 \|\|

*nāśucirdhārayedakṣaṃ sadā kāleṣu dhārayet \|*  
*itthaṃ trisaṃdhyamathavā dvisaṃdhyaṃ sakṛdeva vā \|\| 38 \|\|*

*kṛtvā snānādikaṃ śaktyā pūjayetparameśvaram \|*  
*prajāsthānaṃ samāsādya baddhvā ruciramāsanam \|\| 39 \|\|*

38-39. Impure men shall not wear the Rudrākṣa bead. Everyone shall take bath twice, twice or once a day according to his strength, and worship the lord seated in a charming pose in the pedestal.

## \|\| 12.21.40 \|\|

*dhyāyeddevaṃ ca devīṃ ca prāṅmukho vāpyudaṅmukhaḥ \|*  
*śvetādīnnakulīśāṃtāṃstacchiṣyānpraṇamedgurum \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. He shall face the east or the north while meditating on the lord and the goddess. He shall worship the preceptor and the disciples from Śveta to Nakuliśa.

## \|\| 12.21.41-42 \|\|

*punardevaṃ śivaṃ natvā tato nāmāṣṭakaṃ japet \|*  
*śivo maheśvaraścaiva rudro viṣṇuḥ pitāmahaḥ \|\| 41 \|\|*

*saṃsāravaidyassarvajñaḥ paramātmeti cāṣṭakam \|*  
*athavā śivamevaikaṃ japitvaikādaśādhikam \|\| 42 \|\|*

41-42. Again he shall bow to the lord and repeat his eight names, viz. Śiva, Maheśvara, Rudra, Viṣṇu, Pitāmaha Saṃsāravaidya, Sarvajña and Paramātman. Or he shall repeat the name Śiva eleven times or more.

## \|\| 12.21.43 \|\|

*jihvāgre tejaso rāśiṃ dhyātvāvyādhyādiśāṃtaye \|*  
*prakṣālya caraṇau kṛtvā karau caṃdanacarcitau \|*

*prakurvīta karanyāsaṃ karaśodhanapūrvakam \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. For the removal of sickness he shall meditate on the mass of splendour at the tip of his tongue. He shall wash his feet and apply sandal paste on his hands. He shall perform Karanyāsa after wiping off his hands.

## Chapter 22 - The compulsory and optional rites of Śaivite Scriptures

## \|\| 12.22.1-2 \|\|

*upamanyuruvāca \|*  
*nyāsastu trividhaḥ proktaḥ sthityutpattilayakramāt \|*  
*sthitirnyāso gṛhasthānāmutpattirbrahmacāriṇām \|\| 1 \|\|*

*yatīnāṃ saṃhṛtinyāso vanasthānāṃ tathaiva ca \|*  
*sa eva bhartṛhīnāyāḥ kuṭuṃbinyāḥ sthitirbhavet \|\| 2 \|\|*

Upamanyu said:

1-2. Nyāsa is of three types: Sthiti, Utpatti and Laya. The first is for householders, the second for Brahmacārins, the third for ascetics, forest-dwellers and widows. For housewives the Sthitinyāsa is recommended.

## \|\| 12.22.3-4 \|\|

*kanyāyāḥ punarutpattiṃ vakṣye nyāsasya lakṣaṇam \|*  
*aṃguṣṭhādikaniṣṭhāṃtaṃ sthitinyāsa udāhṛtaḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

*dakṣiṇāṃguṣṭhamārabhya vāmāṃguṣṭhāntameva ca \|*  
*utpattinyāsa ākhyāto viparītastu saṃhṛtiḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

3-4. For a virgin Utpatti Nyāsa is praiseworthy. I shall now mention the characteristics of the Nyāsas. The procedure from the thumb to the little finger is the Sthitinyāsa. The procedure from the right thumb to the left little finger is the Utpattinyāsa. The reverse is Saṃhṛti (Laya).

## \|\| 12.22.5 \|\|

*sabiṃdukānnakārādīnvarṇānnyasyedanukramāt \|*  
*aṃgulīṣu śivaṃ nyasyettalayorapyanāmayoḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. The letters “Na” etc. along with the Bindus shall be fixed in order in the fingers. Śiva shall be fixed on the palms and on the little fingers.

## \|\| 12.22.6-7 \|\|

*astranyāsaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā daśadikṣvastramaṃtrataḥ \|*  
*nivṛttyādikalāḥ pañca pañcabhūtasvarūpiṇīḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

*pañcabhūtādhipaissārdhaṃ tataccihnasamanvitāḥ \|*  
*hṛtkaṇṭatālubhrūmadhyabrahmarandhrasamāśrayāḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

6-7. The Astranyāsa shall be made in the ten quarters by means of the Astramantra. The five Kalās—Nivṛtti etc. in the form of the five elements along with the lords of the elements and accompanied by their respective symbols shall be fixed in the chest, neck, palate, middle of the eye-brows and the Brahmarandhra. One shall conceive them in the different Bījas.

## \|\| 12.22.8-10 \|\|

*tadtadbījena saṃgraṃthīstadtadbījeṣu bhāvayet \|*  
*tāsāṃ viśodhanārthāya vidyāṃ pañcākṣarīṃ japet \|\| 8 \|\|*

*niruddhvā prāṇavāyuṃ ca guṇasaṃkhyānusārataḥ \|*  
*bhūtagraṃthiṃ tataśchidyādastreṇaivāstramudrayā \|\| 9 \|\|*

*nāḍyā suṣumnayātmānaṃ preritaṃ prāṇavāyunā \|*  
*nirgataṃ brahmarandhreṇa yojayecchivatejasā \|\| 10 \|\|*

8-10. In order to purify them one shall perform the Japa of the five-syllabled mantra. Restraining the vital breath thrice he shall cut off the knot of the elements repeating the Astra mantra and showing the mystic gesture of Astra. The Ātman urged by the vital breath through the Suṣumṇā vein and going out through the Brahmarandhra shall be united with the Śaivite splendour.

## \|\| 12.22.11-13 \|\|

*viśoṣya vāyunā paścāddehaṃ kālāgninā dahet \|*  
*tataścoparibhāvena kalāssaṃhṛtya vāyunā \|\| 11 \|\|*

*dehaṃ saṃhṛtya vai dagdhaṃ kalāsspṛṣṭvā sahābdhinā \|*  
*plāvayitvāmṛtairdehaṃ yathāsthānaṃ niveśayet \|\| 12 \|\|*

*atha saṃhṛtya vai dagdhaḥ kalāsargaṃ vinaiva tu \|*  
*amṛtaplāvanaṃ kuryādbhasmībhūtasya vai tataḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

11-13. Afterwards the body is withered up by the wind burnt by the deadly fire. Then upwardly the Kalās are dissolved through the wind. Dissolving the burnt body and touching the Kalās with the ocean he shall drench and flood the body through Amṛtas and keep it in its normal place. Killed and burnt without the creation of Kalā he shall flood with Amṛta that which is reduced to ashes.

## \|\| 12.22.14 \|\|

*tato vidyāmaye tasmindehe dīpaśikhākṛtim \|*  
*śivānnirgatamātmānaṃ brahmaraṃdhreṇa yojayet \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. In the body consisting of Vidyā, he shall join the Ātman that has come out of Śiva in the form of the flame of a lamp. He shall join it through the Brahmarandhra.

## \|\| 12.22.15 \|\|

*dehasyāntaḥ praviṣṭaṃ taṃ dhyātvā hṛdayapaṃkaje \|*  
*punaścāmṛtavarṣeṇa siṃcedvidyāmayaṃ vapuḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. After meditating on the Ātman that has entered the body, in the lotus of the heart, he shall sprinkle with the shower of nectar the body consisting of Vidyā.

## \|\| 12.22.16 \|\|

*tataḥ kuryātkaranyāsaṃ karaśodhanapūrvakam \|*  
*dehanyāsaṃ tataḥ paścānmahatyā mudrayā caret \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. Then he shall perform the rite of Karanyāsa after duly purifying it. Thereafter he shall perform the Dehanyāsa by means of the great Mudrā.

## \|\| 12.22.17 \|\|

*aṃganyāsaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā śivoktena tu vartmanā \|*  
*varṇanyāsaṃ tataḥ kuryāddhastapādādisaṃdhiṣu \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. After performing the rite of Aṅganyāsa in the manner mentioned by Śiva, he shall perform the Varṇanyāsa in the joints of hands, feet and other parts of the body.

## \|\| 12.22.18 \|\|

*ṣaḍaṃgāni tato nyasya jātiṣaṭkayutāni ca \|*  
*digbaṃdhamācaretpaścādāgneyādi yathākramam \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. After the Nyāsa of the six limbs accompanied by six types, he shall bind the quarters from the south-east onwards.

## \|\| 12.22.19 \|\|

*yadvā mūrdhādipañcāṃgaṃ nyāsameva samācaret \|*  
*tathā ṣaḍaṃganyāsaṃ ca bhūtaśuddhyādikaṃ vinā \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. Or he need perform only the Nyāsa of the five limbs beginning with the head. Similarly the Nyāsa of six limbs without the rites of purification etc. of the Bhūtas shall be performed.

## \|\| 12.22.20 \|\|

*evaṃ samāsarūpeṇa kṛtvā dehātmaśodhanam \|*  
*śivabhāvamupāgamya pūjayetparameśvaram \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. Thus he shall succinctly perform the purification of the body and Ātman. Attaining the status of Śiva he shall worship Parameśvara.

## \|\| 12.22.21 \|\|

*atha yasyāstyavasaro nāsti vā mativibhramaḥ \|*  
*sa vistīrṇena kalpena nyāsakarma samācaret \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. He who has sufficient leisure and is not confused in mind shall perform the rite of Nyāsa in a detailed manner.

## \|\| 12.22.22-23 \|\|

*tatrādyo mātṛkānyāso brahmanyāsastataḥ paraḥ \|*  
*tṛtīyaḥ praṇavanyāso haṃsanyāsastaduttaraḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

*pañcamaḥ kathyate sadbhirnyāsaḥ pañcākṣarātmakaḥ \|*  
*eteṣvekamanekaṃ vā kuryātpūjādi karmasu \|\| 23 \|\|*

22-23. The first is Mātṛkānyāsa; the next is Brahmanyāsa; Praṇavanyāsa is the third; the next is Haṃsa Nyāsa and the fifth Nyāsa is mentioned as Pañcākṣarātmaka (consisting of the five-syllabled mantra).

## \|\| 12.22.24-29 \|\|

*akāraṃ mūrdhni vinyasya ākāraṃ ca lalāṭake \|*  
*iṃ īṃ ca netrayostadvatuṃ ūṃ śravaṇayostathā \|\| 24 \|\|*

*ṛṃ ḥṃ kapolayoścaiva ḷaṃ ḹṃ nāsāpuṭadvaye \|*  
*ememoṣṭhadvayoromauṃ daṃtapaṃktidvayoḥ kramāt \|\| 25 \|\|*

*aṃ jihvāyāmatho tālunyaḥ prayojyo yathākramam \|*  
*kavargaṃ dakṣiṇe haste nyasetpañcasu saṃdhiṣu \|\| 26 \|\|*

*cavargaṃ ca tathā vāmahastasaṃdhiṣu vinyaset \|*  
*ṭavargaṃ ca tavargaṃ ca pādayorubhayorapi \|\| 27 \|\|*

*paphau tu pārśvayoḥ pṛṣṭhe nābhau cāpi babhau tataḥ \|*  
*nyasenmakāraṃ hṛdaye tvagādiṣu yathākramam \|\| 28 \|\|*

*yakarādisakārāṃtānnyasetsaptasu dhātuṣu \|*  
*haṃkāraṃ hṛdayasyāṃtaḥ kṣakāraṃ bhrūyugāṃtare \|\| 29 \|\|*

24-29. The Nyāsa of the various letters is as follows:—the letter A in the head; Ā in the forehead; ‘I’ and Ī in the eyes; “U” and “Ū” in the ears; “Ṛ” and “Ṛ”\[?\] in the cheek; ‘lṛ’\[ḷ?\] and ‘ḷṛ’\[ḹ?\] in the nostrils; ‘e’ and “ai” in the lips; o and “au” in the rows of teeth; ‘aṃ’ in the tongue and “aḥ” in the palate; the gutturals are in the five joints of the right hand; the palatals in the joints of the left hand; The linguals and the Dentals in the legs; Pa and Pha in the sides; “Ba” in the back and “Bha” in the navel; “Ma” in the heart; “Ya” to “Sa” in the seven constituent elements, skin etc; “ha” in the cavity of the heart and “kṣa” in the middle of the eyebrows.

## \|\| 12.22.30 \|\|

*evaṃ varṇānpravinyasya pañcāśadrudravartmanā \|*  
*aṃgavaktrakalābhedātpañca brahmāṇi vinyaset \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. After performing the Nyāsa of the letters in the manner of fifty Rudras the five Brahmans shall be fixed in the limbs, face etc. and Kalā.

## \|\| 12.22.31 \|\|

*karanyāsādyamapi taiḥ kṛtvā vātha na vā kramāt \|*  
*śirovadanahṛdguhyapādeṣvetāni kalpayet \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. The Karanyāsa may or may not be performed through them. The Brahmans shall be fixed in the head, face, chest, private parts and legs.

## \|\| 12.22.32 \|\|

*tataścordhvādivaktrāṇi paścimāṃtāni kalpayet \|*  
*īśānasya kalāḥ pañca pañcasveteṣu ca kramāt \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. The Kalās of Īśāna are five; these are fixed in the five faces beginning with the one above and ending with the one in the west.

## \|\| 12.22.33 \|\|

*tataścaturṣu vaktreṣu puruṣasya kalā api \|*  
*catasraḥ praṇidhātavyāḥ pūrvādikramayogataḥ \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. Then the four Kalās of Puruṣa shall be fixed in the four faces beginning with the one in the east.

## \|\| 12.22.34-36 \|\|

*hṛtkaṃṭhāṃseṣu nābhau ca kukṣau pṛṣṭhe ca vakṣasi \|*  
*aghorasya kalāścāṣṭau pādayorapi hastayoḥ \|\| 34 \|\|*

*paścāttrayoḥdaśakalāḥ pāyumeḍhrorujānuṣu \|*  
*jaṃghāsphikkaṭipārśveṣu vāmadevasya bhāvayet \|\| 35 \|\|*

*ghrāṇe śirasi bāhvośca kalpayetkalpavittamaḥ \|*  
*aṣṭatriṃśatkalānyāsamevaṃ kṛtvānupūrvaśaḥ \|\| 36 \|\|*

34-36. The eight Kalās of Aghora shall be fixed in the heart, neck, shoulders, navel, belly, back and the chest; then the thirteen Kalās of Vāmadeva are fixed in the anus, penis, thighs, knees, calves, hips, buttocks, sides, nose, head and the arms. Thus the experts perform the Nyāsa of the thirty-eight Kalās in due order.

## \|\| 12.22.37-41 \|\|

*paścātpraṇavaviddhīmānpraṇavanyāsamācaret \|*  
*bāhudvaye kūrparayostathā ca maṇibandhayoḥ \|\| 37 \|\|*

*pārśvodarorujaṃgheṣu pādayoḥ pṛṣṭhatastathā \|*  
*itthaṃ praṇavavinyāsaṃ kṛtvā nyāsavicakṣaṇaḥ \|\| 38 \|\|*

*haṃsanyāsaṃ prakurvīta śivaśāstre yathoditam \|*  
*bījaṃ vibhajya haṃsasya netrayorghrāṇayorapi \|\| 39 \|\|*

*vibhajya bāhunetrāsyalalāṭe ghrāṇayorapi \|*  
*kakṣayoḥ skandhayoścaiva pārśvayostanayostathā \|\| 40 \|\|*

*kaṭhyoḥ pāṇyorgulphayośca yadvā pañcāṃgavartmanā \|*  
*haṃsanyāsamimaṃ kṛtvā nyasetpañcākṣarīṃ tataḥ \|\| 41 \|\|*

37-41. Afterwards the experts of Praṇava shall perform the Praṇavanyāsa in the arms, elbows wrists, sides, belly, thighs, calves and the back. After performing the Praṇavanyāsa thus, the expert devotee shall perform the Haṃsanyāsa as mentioned in Śaivite scriptures, in the eyes, nostrils, arms, eyes, face, forehead, armpits sides, breasts, hips, hands and heels. Or in the manner of five limbs the Nyāsa shall be performed. Then he shall perform the Nyāsa of the five-syllabled mantra.

## \|\| 12.22.42-44 \|\|

*yathā pūrvoktamārgeṇa śivatvaṃ yena jāyate \|*  
*nāśivaḥ śivamabhyasyennāśivaḥ śivamarcayet \|\| 42 \|\|*

*nāśivastu śivaṃ dhyāyennāśivamprāpnuyācchivam \|*  
*tasmācchaivīṃ tanuṃ kṛtvā tyaktvā ca paśubhāvanām \|\| 43 \|\|*

*śivo 'hamiti saṃcintya śaivaṃ karma samācaret \|*  
*karmayajñastapoyajño japayajñastaduttaraḥ \|*

*dhyānayajño jñānayajñaḥ pañca yajñāḥ prakīrtitāḥ \|*  
*karmayajñaratāḥ kecittapoyajñaratāḥ pare \|*  
*japayajñaratāścānye dhyānayajñaratāstathā \|\| 44 \|\|*

42-44. Hereby Śivahood is generated along the path as mentioned before. A non-Śiva shall neither practise the mantra of Śiva nor worship Śiva nor meditate upon Śiva nor attain Śiva. Hence one shall dedicate himself to Śiva and eschew his identity. Thinking “I am Śiva” one shall perform Śaivite rites, viz. Karmayajña, Tapoyajña, Japayajña, Dhyānayajña and Jñānayajña.

## \|\| 12.22.45-61 \|\|

*jñānayajñaratāścānye viśiṣṭāścottarottaram \|*  
*kramayajño dvidhā proktaḥ kāmākāmavibhedataḥ \|*  
*kāmānkāmī tato bhuktvā kāmāsaktaḥ punarbhavet \|*  
*akāme rudrabhavane bhogānbhuktvā tataścyutaḥ \|\| 46 \|\|*

*tapoyajñarato bhūtvā jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ \|*  
*tapasvī ca punastasminbhogān bhuktvā tataścyutaḥ \|*  
*japadhyānarato bhūtvā jāyate bhuvi mānavaḥ \|*  
*japadhyānarato martyastadvaiśiṣṭyavaśādiha \|\| 48 \|\|*

*jñānaṃ labdhvācirādeva śivasāyujyamāpnuyāt \|*  
*tasmānmukto śivājñaptaḥ karmayajño 'pi dehinām \|*  
*akāmaḥ kāmasaṃyukto bandhāyaiva bhaviṣyati \|*  
*tasmātpañcasu yajñeṣu dhyānajñānaparo bhavet \|\| 50 \|\|*

*dhyānaṃ jñānaṃ ca yasyāsti tīrṇastena bhavārṇavaḥ \|*  
*hiṃsādidoṣanirmukto viśuddhaścittasādhanaḥ \|*  
*dhyānayajñaḥ parastasmādapavargaphalapradaḥ \|*  
*bahiḥ karmakarā yadvannātīva phalabhāginaḥ \|\| 52 \|\|*

*dṛṣṭvā narendrabhavane tadvadatrāpi karmiṇaḥ \|*  
*dhyānināṃ hi vapuḥ sūkṣmaṃ bhavetpratyakṣamaiśvaram \|*  
*yatheha karmaṇāṃ sthūlaṃ mṛtkāṣṭhādyaiḥ prakalpitam \|*  
*dhyānayajñaratāstasmāddevānpāṣāṇamṛṇmayān \|\| 54 \|\|*

*nātyaṃtaṃ pratipadyaṃte śivayāthātmyavedanāt \|*  
*ātmasthaṃ yaḥ śivaṃ tyaktvā bahirabhyarcayennaraḥ \|*  
*hastasthaṃ phalamutsṛjya lihetkūrparamātmanaḥ \|*  
*jñānāddhyānaṃ bhaveddhyānājjñānaṃ bhūyaḥ pravartate \|\| 56 \|\|*

*tadubhābhyāṃ bhavenmuktistasmāddhyānarato bhavet \|*  
*dvādaśānte tathā mūrdhni lalāṭe bhrūyugāntare \|*  
*nāsāgre vā tathāsye vā kandhare hṛdaye tathā \|*  
*nābhau vā śāśvatasthāne śraddhāviddhena cetasā \|\| 58 \|\|*

*bahiryāgopacāreṇa devaṃ devīṃ ca pūjayet \|*  
*athavā pūjayennityaṃ liṃge vā kṛtakepi vā \|*  
*vahnau vā sthaṇḍile vātha bhaktyā vittānusārataḥ \|*  
*athavāṃtarbahiścaiva pūjayetparameśvaram \|*  
*aṃtaryāgarataḥ pūjāṃ bahiḥ kurvīta vā na vā \|\| 60 \|\|*

45-46. Some are engaged in Karmayajña; others in Tapoyajña; still others in Japayajña; others in Dhyānayajña; and others in Jñānayajña. The latter ones are better than the earlier ones. Karmayajña is of two kinds: one with a specific desire and the other without that.

47-51. A person with a desire, even when he enjoys those pleasures becomes more and more attached to lust. If he is without desire he enjoys pleasures in Rudra’s abode and after a descent therefrom is reborn as a person engaged in Tapoyajña. There is no doubt in this. An ascetic enjoys pleasures in Rudra’s abode and after a fall therefrom is reborn in the world as a man devoted to Japa and Dhyāna. Such a man devoted to Japa and Dhyāna, thanks to heir excellence, attains knowledge ere long, and thereby attains Śiva’s Sāyujya. Hence he becomes a liberated soul even when he is devoted to Karmayajña at the behest of Śiva, if he is without desire. But a person with lust will always be in bondage. Hence one shall be devoted to Dhyāna and Jñāna among the five Yajñas.

52-55. He who has meditation and knowledge crosses the ocean of worldly existence. Dhyānayajña which is freedom from the defects of violence etc. is a pure mental process for salvation and is therefore the greatest means. Just as the persons working outside the palace are seen not enjoying much of the benefits within the royal palace so also the Karmins. To those who meditate, the subtle body of Īśvara becomes visible. But to the Karmins, only the clay, wood etc. are visible. Hence those who are devoted to Dhyānayajña do not accept deities in the form of stone and clay, since they know the reality of Śiva.

56-57. The man who eschews Śiva stationed in the Ātman and worships him externally, resigns the fruit in his hand and licks his elbow. From knowledge, meditation is generated and from meditation knowledge functions better. Through these two, one attains liberation. Hence one shall be devoted to meditation.

58-61. One shall worship the lord and the goddess by means of external service, or with the mind full of faith meditate on them in the twelve-petalled lotus, head, forehead, the middle of the eyebrows, the tip of the nose, face, neck, heart, navel or in any permanent spot. Or he shall worship and phallic image or an embodied idol or in an artificial fire or on the ground with devotion in accordance with one’s affluence. Or he shall worship the lord both internally and externally. A person engaged in mental worship may or may not perform the external worship.

## Chapter 23 - A gloss on the rules governing worship

## \|\| 12.23.1 \|\|

*upamanyuruvāca \|*  
*vyākhyāṃ pūjāvidhānasya pravadāmi samāsataḥ \|*  
*śivaśāstre śivenaiva śivāyai kathitasya tu \|\| 1 \|\|*

Upamanyu said:—

1\. I shall briefly give a commentary to the rules governing worships mentioned by Śiva to Śivā in the Śaivite scriptures.

## \|\| 12.23.2 \|\|

*aṃgamabhyaṃtaraṃ yāgamagnikāryāvasānakam \|*  
*vidhāya vā na vā paścādbahiryāgaṃ samācaret \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. With or without performing the internal worship which is its ancillary and which concludes with the rites in fire, one shall perform the external worship.

## \|\| 12.23.3-4 \|\|

*tatra dravyāṇi manasā kalpayitvā viśodhya ca \|*  
*dhyātvā vināyakaṃ devaṃ pūjayitvā vidhānataḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

*dakṣiṇe cottare caiva naṃdīśaṃ suyaśaṃ tathā \|*  
*ārādhya manasā samyagāsanaṃ kalpayedbudhaḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

3-4. The materials are mentally conceived and purified. After meditating on Vināyaka and worshipping the lord in accordance with the injunctions, the learned devotee shall propitiate Nandīśa and Suyasā in the south and the north and offer mentally well-conceived scat.

## \|\| 12.23.5 \|\|

*ārādhanādikairyuktassiṃhayogāsanādikam \|*  
*padmāsanaṃ vā vimalaṃ tattvatrayasamanvitam \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. It may be a throne or a yogic seat or lotus-seat equipped with the three principles.

## \|\| 12.23.6 \|\|

*tasyopari śivaṃ dhyāyetsāṃbaṃ sarvamanoharam \|*  
*sarvalakṣaṇasaṃpannaṃ sarvāvayavaśobhanam \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. Śiva shall be meditated on it. He is accompanied by Ambā. He is charming, endowed with all characteristics, auspicious in every limb.

## \|\| 12.23.7 \|\|

*sarvātiśayasaṃyuktaṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitam \|*  
*raktāsyapāṇicaraṇaṃ kuṃdacaṃdrasmitānanam \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. He possesses all excellences. He is bedecked in all ornaments. His face, hands and feet, are red. His face beams with smiles resembling the Kunda flower and the moon.

## \|\| 12.23.8 \|\|

*śuddhasphaṭikasaṃkāśaṃ phullapadmatrilocanam \|*  
*caturbhujamudārāṅgaṃ cārucaṃdrakalādharam \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. He is as pure as the pure crystal. He has three eyes resembling full blown lotus. He has four arms and splendid body. He wears the charming digit of the moon.

## \|\| 12.23.9 \|\|

*varadābhayahastaṃ ca mṛgaṭaṃkadharaṃ haram \|*  
*bhujaṃgahāravalayaṃ cārunīlagalāṃtaram \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. His hands show the gestures of granting the boon and protection. He holds the deer and an axe. fie has serpents for necklaces and bangles. His neck is charmingly blue.

## \|\| 12.23.10 \|\|

*sarvopamānarahitaṃ sānugaṃ saparicchadam \|*  
*tataḥ saṃciṃtayettasya vāmabhāge maheśvarīm \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. He has none to compare with. He is accompanied by his followers and attendants. Then the devotee shall think of him to his left.

## \|\| 12.23.11 \|\|

*praphullotpalapatrābhāṃ vistīrṇāyatalocanām \|*  
*pūrṇacaṃdrābhavadanāṃ nīlakuṃcitamūrdhajām \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. She is as tender as the petals of full blown-lotus. Her eyes are large and broad. Her face has the lustre of the full moon. Her tresses are dark-blue and curly.

## \|\| 12.23.12 \|\|

*nīlotpaladalaprakhyāṃ candrārdhakṛtaśekharām \|*  
*ativṛttaghanottuṃgasnigdhapīnapayodharām \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. Her complexion has the lustre of the petals of a blue lotus. She has the half moon for her coronet. Her breasts are round, weighty, lifted up, smooth and plump.

## \|\| 12.23.13 \|\|

*tanumadhyāṃ pṛthuśroṇīṃ pītasūkṣmavarāmbarām \|*  
*sarvābharaṇasaṃpannāṃ lalāṭatilakojjvalām \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. Her middle is slender. Her buttocks are large. She wears an exquisitely fine yellow garment. She is riddly bedecked in all ornaments. The Tilakā mark on her forehead is dazzlingly brilliant.

## \|\| 12.23.14 \|\|

*vicitrapuṣpasaṃkīrṇakeśapāśopaśobhitām \|*  
*sarvato 'nuguṇākārāṃ kiṃcillajjānatānanām \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. She shines with flowers of various colours embellishing her braid of hair. In every respect her features are in consonance with her qualities. Due to bashfulness her face is slightly lowered.

## \|\| 12.23.15 \|\|

*hemāraviṃdaṃ vilasaddadhānāṃ dakṣiṇe kare \|*  
*daṃḍavaccāparaṃ haste nyasyāsīnāṃ mahāsane \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. In her right hand she bears a shining golden lotus. She is seated on a splendid seat with the other hand placed on it like a supporting staff.

## \|\| 12.23.16-19 \|\|

*pāśavicchedikāṃ sākṣātsaccidānaṃdarūpiṇīm \|*  
*evaṃ devaṃ ca devīṃ ca dhyātvāsanavare śubhe \|\| 16 \|\|*

*sarvopacāravadbhaktyā bhāvapuṣpaissamarcayet \|*  
*athavā parikalpyaivaṃ mūrtimanyatamāṃ vibhoḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

*śaivīṃ sadāśivākhyāṃ vā tathā māheśvarīṃ parām \|*  
*ṣaḍviṃśakābhidhānāṃ vā śrīkaṃṭhākhyāmathāpi vā \|\| 18 \|\|*

*mantranyāsādikāṃ cāpi kṛtvā svasyāṃ tanau yathā \|*  
*asyāṃ mūrtau mūrtimaṃtaṃ śivaṃ sadasataḥ param \|\| 19 \|\|*

16-19. She splits the Pāśa. She is in the form of existence, knowledge and bliss. After conceiving the lord and the goddess thus and meditating on them in an excellent auspicious seat, the devotee shall worship with piety as flowers along with all types of service. Or he can conceive the form of the lord in any of the following ways:—as Śiva, Sadāśiva, Maheśvara, or as one having the name of twenty-six principles or as Śrīkaṇṭha. Just as Mantra Nyāsa is performed in the body so also in this form the devotee can meditate on embodied Śiva who is beyond Sat and Asat as in the manner of external worship. He shall complete the worship mentally.

## \|\| 12.23.20-23 \|\|

*dhyātvā bāhyakrameṇaiva pūjāṃ nirvartayeddhiyā \|*  
*samidājyādibhiḥ paścānnābhau homaṃ ca bhāvayet \|\| 20 \|\|*

*bhrūmadhye ca śivaṃ dhyāyecchuddhadīpaśikhākṛtim \|*  
*itthamaṃge svataṃtre vā yoge dhyānamaye śubhe \|\| 21 \|\|*

*agnikāryāvasānaṃ ca sarvatraiva samo vidhiḥ \|*  
*atha ciṃtāmayaṃ sarvaṃ samāpyārādhanakramam \|\| 22 \|\|*

*liṃge ca pūjayeddevaṃ sthaṃḍile vānale 'pi vā \|\| 23 \|\|*

20-23. He shall then mentally imagine the Homa in the navel with sacrificial twig, ghee etc. He shall meditate on Śiva in the middle of the eye-brows in the form of the flame of the pure lamp. Thus in this mentally conceived auspicious worship whether in the body or independently, the rules until the concluding rites in fire are the same. Or after concluding the imaginary procedure of propitiation the devotee shall worship the lord in the phallic image or on the ground or in the fire.

## Chapter 24 - The ritual of lord Śiva

## \|\| 12.24.1 \|\|

*upamanyuruvāca \|*  
*prokṣayenmūlamaṃtreṇa pūjāsthānaṃ viśuddhaye \|*  
*gandhacandanatoyena puṣpaṃ tatra vinikṣipet \|\| 1 \|\|*

Upamanyu said:—

1\. The devotee shall sprinkle the place of worship with scented sandal water for the sake of purity, with the basic mantra. He shall put flowers there.

## \|\| 12.24.2 \|\|

*astreṇotsārya vai vighnānavaguṇṭhya ca varmaṇā \|*  
*astraṃ dikṣu pravinyasya kalpayedarcanābhuvam \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. The obstacles shall be warded off. The place shall be veiled with Varma mantra. After performing the rite of Astranyāsa in the quarters, the place of worship shall be arranged.

## \|\| 12.24.3 \|\|

*tatra darbhānparistīrya kṣālayetprokṣaṇādibhiḥ \|*  
*saṃśodhya sarvapātrāṇi dravyaśuddhiṃ samācaret \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. Darbha grass shall be strewn over and washed by means of sprinkling. After cleaning the vessels he shall sanctify the materials.

## \|\| 12.24.4-5 \|\|

*prokṣaṇīmardhyapātraṃ ca pādyapātramataḥ param \|*  
*tathaivācamanīyasya pātraṃ ceti catuṣṭayam \|\| 4 \|\|*

*prakṣālya prokṣya vīkṣyātha kṣipetteṣu jalaṃ śivam \|*  
*puṇyadravyāṇi sarvāṇi yathālābhaṃ vinikṣipet \|\| 5 \|\|*

4-5. He shall wash and sprinkle the vessels of Prokṣaṇī Arghya, Pādya and Ācamanīya. After examining them he shall pour auspicious water therein. He shall place holy materials of worship there to the extent of their availability.

## \|\| 12.24.6 \|\|

*ratnāni rajataṃ hema gandhapuṣpākṣatādayaḥ \|*  
*phalapallavadarbhāṃśca puṇyadravyāṇyanekadhā \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. The holy materials of worship are many such as gems, silver, gold, scents, flowers, Akṣatas, fruits, sprouts and Darbha grass.

## \|\| 12.24.7 \|\|

*snānodake sugandhādi pānīye ca viśeṣataḥ \|*  
*śītalāni manojñānī kusumādīni nikṣipet \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. In the water for ablution and particularly in that intended for drinking, sweet scents as well as cool and charming flowers shall be put.

## \|\| 12.24.8-9 \|\|

*uśīraṃ candanaṃ caiva pādye tu parikalpayet \|*  
*jātikaṃkolakarpūrabahumūlatamālakān \|\| 8 \|\|*

*kṣipedācamanīye ca cūrṇayitvā viśeṣataḥ \|*  
*elāṃ pātreṣu sarveṣu karpūraṃ candanaṃ tathā \|\| 9 \|\|*

8-9. Sandal and Uśīra shall be put in the Pādya water. In the Ācamanīya, nutmeg, berry, camphor, Bahumūla, and Tamālaka shall be put, preferably powdered. Cardamom seeds, camphor and sandal can be put in the vessels.

## \|\| 12.24.10 \|\|

*kuśāgrāṇyakṣatāṃścaiva yavavrīhitilānapi \|*  
*ājyasiddhārthapuṣpāṇi bhasitañcārghyapātrake \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. In the Arghya vessel all these materials shall be put—shoots of Kuśa grass, Akṣatas, barley, gingelly seeds, other grains, ghee, white mustard, flowers and Bhasma.

## \|\| 12.24.11 \|\|

*kuśapuṣpayavavrīhibahumūlatamālakān \|*  
*prakṣipetprokṣaṇīpātre bhasitaṃ ca yathākramam \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. The following materials shall be put in the Prokṣaṇī vessel:—Kuśa, flowers, Yava grains, Bahumūla and Tamālaka along with Bhasma.

## \|\| 12.24.12 \|\|

*sarvatra mantraṃ vinyasya varmaṇāveṣṭya bāhyataḥ \|*  
*paścādastreṇa saṃrakṣya dhenumudrāṃ pradarśayet \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. Every vessel shall be blessed by chanting the mantras; externally covered by the Varma mantra and protected by Astra mantra. He shall show the Mudrā of cow.

## \|\| 12.24.13 \|\|

*pūjādravyāṇi sarvāṇi prokṣaṇīpātravāriṇā \|*  
*samprokṣya mūlamaṃtreṇa śodhayedvidhivattataḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. He shall purify the materials of worship by means of the water from the vessel Prokṣaṇī sprinkled on them repeating the basic mantra.

## \|\| 12.24.14 \|\|

*pātrāṇāṃ prokṣaṇīmekāmalābhe sarvakarmasu \|*  
*sādhayedarghyamadbhistatsāmānyaṃ sādhakottamaḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. If all the vessels are not available the excellent aspirant shall arrange the vessel Prokṣaṇī in every holy rite. Arghya etc. shall be performed by the water therefrom.

## \|\| 12.24.15-17 \|\|

*tato vināyakaṃ devaṃ bhakṣyabhojyādibhiḥ kramāt \|*  
*pūjayitvā vidhānena dvārapārśve 'tha dakṣiṇe \|\| 15 \|\|*

*antaḥpurādhipaṃ sākṣānnandinaṃ samyagarcayet \|*  
*cāmīkarācalaprakhyaṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitam \|\| 16 \|\|*

*bālendumukuṭaṃ saumyaṃ trinetraṃ ca caturbhujam \|*  
*dīptaśūlamṛgīṭaṃkatigmavetradharaṃ prabhum \|\| 17 \|\|*

15-17. Lord Vināyaka shall be worshipped with various foodstuffs. After that, near the southern doorway he shall duly worship the chief of harem Nandin himself. He resembles the golden mountain in lustre. He is bedecked in all ornaments. The crescent moon is his coronet. He is gentle. He has three eyes and four arms. He is the lord bearing shining trident, deer, axe and sharp-pointed baton. His face resembles the disc of the moon or he is conceived with the face of a monkey.

## \|\| 12.24.18-20 \|\|

*candrabimbābhavadanaṃ harivaktramathāpi vā \|*  
*uttare dvārapārśvasya bhāryāṃ ca marutāṃ sutām \|\| 18 \|\|*

*suyaśāṃ suvratāmambāṃ pādamaṇḍanatatparām \|*  
*pūjayitvā praviśyāntarbhavanaṃ parameṣṭhinaḥ \|\| 19 \|\|*

*saṃpūjya liṅgaṃ tairdravyairnirmālyamapanodayet \|*  
*prakṣālya puṣpaṃ śirasi nyasettasya viśuddhaye \|\| 20 \|\|*

18-20. In the north the wife of the doorkeeper, the daughter of the Maruts, Suyaśā who bedecks the feet of Ambā shall be worshipped. He shall enter the sanctum sanctorum of Brahmā and worship the Liṅga. The remnants of the previous worship shall be removed. It shall be washed. The flower shall be worn on the head for the sake of purity.

## \|\| 12.24.21 \|\|

*puṣpahasto japecchaktyā mantraṃ mantraviśuddhaye \|*  
*aiśānyāṃ caṇdamārādhya nirmālyaṃ tasya dāpayet \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. With the flower in the hand he shall perform the Japa of the mantra up to the extent of his ability for the parity; through the Mantra Caṇḍa shall be worshipped in the north-cast and the Nirmālya given over to him

## \|\| 12.24.22-24 \|\|

*kalpayedāsanaṃ paścādādhārādi yathākramam \|*  
*ādhāraśaktiṃ kalyāṇīṃ śyāmāṃ dhyāyedadho bhuvi \|\| 22 \|\|*

*tasyāḥ purastādutkaṃṭhamanaṃtaṃ kuṇḍalākṛtim \|*  
*dhavalaṃ pañcaphaṇinaṃ lelihānamivāmbaram \|\| 23 \|\|*

*tasyoparyāsanaṃ bhadraṃ kaṇṭhīravacatuṣpadam \|*  
*dharmo jñānaṃ ca vairāgyamaiśvaryañca padāni vai \|\| 24 \|\|*

22-24. Thereafter the scats Ādhāra etc shall be conceived. The Ādhāra Śakti shall be meditated upon as dark-complexioned and auspicious resting on the ground. In front of Ādhāra Śakti the serpent of curly form with uplifted neck shall be conceived. He is white in colour with five hoods seeming to lick the sky. Above that is the seat in the form of a lion of four feet. The feet are virtue, knowledge, absence of attachment, glory and prosperity.

## \|\| 12.24.25-26 \|\|

*āgneyādiśvetaraktapītaśyāmāni varṇataḥ \|*  
*adharmādīni pūrvādīnyuttarāṃtānyanukramāt \|\| 25 \|\|*

*rājāvartamaṇiprakhyānnyasya gātrāṇi bhāvayet \|*  
*asyordhvacchādanaṃ padmamāsanaṃ vimalaṃ sitam \|\| 26 \|\|*

25-26. They are respectively in the south-east, southwest, north-west and north-east and are coloured white, red yellow and black. Adharma etc. are in the directions cast etc. ending with the north. His bodies shall be conceived resembling the jewel Rājāvarta. Covering for him is the pure white lotus seat.

## \|\| 12.24.27 \|\|

*aṣṭapatrāṇi tasyāhuraṇimādiguṇāṣṭakam \|*  
*kesarāṇi ca vāmādyā rudrāvāmādiśaktibhiḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. Its petals are eight in number representing the eight attributes, Aṇimā etc. The filaments are the Rudras Vāma etc. in the company of Vāmā and other Śaktis.

## \|\| 12.24.28 \|\|

*bījānyapi ca tā eva śaktayoṃtarmanonmanīḥ \|*  
*karṇikāparavairāgyaṃ nālaṃ jñānaṃ śivātmakam \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. The seeds too are those Śaktis alone Manonmanī etc. within. The pericarp is the greatest detachment and the stalk is the Śaivite knowledge.

## \|\| 12.24.29 \|\|

*kandaśca śivadharmātmā karṇikānte trimaṇḍale \|*  
*trimaṇḍaloparyātmādi tattvatritayamāsanam \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. The bulbous root at the extremity of the pericarp with the three zones shall be used in the Śaivite rites. Over the three zones the three Tattvas, Ātman etc. are the seats.

## \|\| 12.24.30 \|\|

*sarvāsanopari sukhaṃ vicitrāstaraṇāstṛtam \|*  
*āsanaṃ kalpayeddivyaṃ śuddhavidyāsamujjvalam \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. Above the seats shall be conceived the divine seat refulgent with the pure learning or knowledge, very comfortable and covered over by a covering sheet of colours.

## \|\| 12.24.31 \|\|

*āvāhanaṃ sthāpanaṃ ca sannirodhaṃ nirīkṣaṇam \|*  
*namaskāraṃ ca kurvīta badhvā mudrāḥ pṛthakpṛthak \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. He shall perform the rites of invocation, installation prevention, surveying and obeisance showing separate Mudrās for each.

## \|\| 12.24.32 \|\|

*pādyamācamanaṃ cārghyaṃ gaṃdhaṃ puṣpaṃ tataḥ param \|*  
*dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ ca tāṃbūlaṃ dattvātha svāpayecchivau \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. After offering Pādya, Acamana, Arghya, scents, flowers, incense, light and Tāmbūla, the devotee shall perform the ablution of Śiva and Śivā.

## \|\| 12.24.33-38 \|\|

*athavā parikalpyaivamāsanaṃ mūrtimeva ca \|*  
*sakalīkṛtya mūlena brahmābhiścāparaistathā \|\| 33 \|\|*

*āvāhayettato devyā śivaṃ paramakāraṇam \|*  
*śuddhasphaṭikasaṃkāśaṃ devaṃ niścalamakṣaram \|\| 34 \|\|*

*kāraṇaṃ sarvalokānāṃ sarvalokamayaṃ param \|*  
*aṃtarbahiḥsthitaṃ vyāpya hyaṇoraṇu mahattaram 2 \|\| 35 \|\|*

*bhaktānāmaprayatnena dṛśyamīśvaramavyayam \|*  
*brahmeṃdraviṣṇurudrādyairapi devairagocaram \|\| 36 \|\|*

*devasāraṃ ca vidvadbhiragocaramiti śrutam \|*  
*ādimadhyāntarahitaṃ bheṣajaṃ bhavarogiṇām \|\| 37 \|\|*

*śivatattvamiti khyātaṃ śivārthaṃ jagati sthiram \|*  
*pañcopacāravadbhaktyā pūjayelliṃgamuttamam \|\| 38 \|\|*

33-38. Or after conceiving the seat and the deity thus and uniting it into a complete unit with the five Brahmans and others, repeating the basic mantra, the devotee shall invoke Śiva the great cause along with the goddess. The lord is as pure as the crystal, steady and imperishable. He is the cause of all worlds. He is the great Being who pervades everything from within and without. He is the minutest of all minute things, the greatest of all great things. He is easily visible to the devotees. He is the unchanging lord. He is invisible to Brahmā, Viṣṇu, Rudra and other gods. He is the essence of the Vedas. He is heard by the learned men as the incomprehensible being. He is without beginning, middle or end. He is the medicine for the ailing patients of worldly existence. He is famous as Śivatattva. He is steady and insistent for the welfare of the universe. The devotee shall worship this excellent lord with ñve types of devotional service.

## \|\| 12.24.39 \|\|

*liṃgamūrtirmaheśasya śivasya paramātmanaḥ \|*  
*snānakāle prakurvīta jayaśabdādimaṃgalam \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. The phallus is the image of Śiva the great Ātman. At the rite of ablution auspicious shouts of victory shall be raised.

## \|\| 12.24.40-41 \|\|

*pañcagavyaghṛtakṣīradadhimadhvādipūrvakaiḥ \|*  
*mūlaiḥ phalānāṃ sāraiśca tilasarṣapasaktubhiḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

*bījairyavādibhiśśastaiścūrṇairmāṣādisaṃbhavaiḥ \|*  
*saṃsnāpyālipya piṣṭādyaiḥ snāpayeduṣṇavāribhiḥ \|\| 41 \|\|*

40-41. The phallic idol shall be bathed with the liquid Pañcagavya, curds, milk, ghee, honey etc., powdered roots, essence of fruits, powdered gingelly seeds, mustard and fried grains, yava seeds etc. and the meritorious powder of black gram. After bathing the idol it shall be smeared with paste of flour and bathed in hot water.

## \|\| 12.24.42-44 \|\|

*gharṣayedvilvapatrādyairlepagaṃdhāpanuttaye \|*  
*punaḥ saṃsnāpya salilaiścakravartyupacārataḥ \|\| 42 \|\|*

*sugaṃdhāmalakaṃ dadyāddharidrāṃ ca yathākramam \|*  
*tataḥ saṃśodhya salilairliṃgaṃ beramathāpi vā \|\| 43 \|\|*

*snāpayedgaṃdhatoyena kuśapuṣpodakena ca \|*  
*hiraṇyaratnatoyaiśca maṃtrasiddhairyathākramam \|\| 44 \|\|*

42-44. The devotee shall rub the idol with the leaves of Bilva etc. for the removal of the smell. Again he shall bathe it with water. Royal service shall be rendered, such as the appliances of scents myrobalan or turmeric paste. Again the phallic and the embodied image shall be washed with scented water, sprinkled with Kuśa grass and flowers or with the water from gold and gemset vessels purified by the chanting of mantras.

## \|\| 12.24.45 \|\|

*asaṃbhave tu dravyāṇāṃ yathāsaṃbhavasaṃbhṛtaiḥ \|*  
*kevalairmaṃtratoyairvā snāpayecchraddhayā śivam \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. If the materials are not available whatever is available shall be used. Mere water with chantings of mantra can also be used for the ablution of Śiva. The devotee shall faithfully perform the rite.

## \|\| 12.24.46 \|\|

*kalaśenātha śaṃkhena vardhanyā pāṇinā tathā \|*  
*sakuśena sapuṣpeṇa snāpayenmaṃtrapūrvakam \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. The water shall be poured with a pot, or couch, or Vardhanī or with the hand holding Kuśa grass and flowers all the time repeating the mantras.

## \|\| 12.24.47-48 \|\|

*pavamānena rudreṇa nīlena tvaritena ca \|*  
*liṃgasūktādisūktaiśca śirasātharvaṇena ca \|\| 47 \|\|*

*ṛgbhiśca sāmabhiḥ śaivairbrahmabhiścāpi pañcabhiḥ \|*  
*snāpayeddevadeveśaṃ śivena praṇavena ca \|\| 48 \|\|*

47-48. The hymns of Pavamāna, Rudra, Nila and Tvarita or the hymns of Liṅga Sūkta or the hymns from Atharvaśiras Upaniṣad or the hymns from the Ṛgveda or Sāmaveda relating to Śiva or the five Brahmans be used for the ablution of the lord of the chiefs of the gods. The name Śiva and the Praṇava too shall be used.

## \|\| 12.24.49 \|\|

*yathā devasya devyāśca kuryātsnānādikaṃ tathā \|*  
*na tu kaścidviśeṣo 'sti tatra tau sadṛśau yataḥ \|\| 49 \|\|*

49\. There is no difference in the manner in which the rite of ablution is performed in regard to the lord or the goddess since they are equal.

## \|\| 12.24.50 \|\|

*prathamaṃ devamuddiśya kṛtvā snānādikāḥ kriyāḥ \|*  
*devyaiḥ praścātprakurvīta devadevasya śāsanāt \|\| 50 \|\|*

50\. After performing the rites of ablution to the lord those to the goddess shall be performed. This is what the lord of the gods has ordained.

## \|\| 12.24.51 \|\|

*ardhanārīśvare pūjye paurvāparyaṃ na vidyate \|*  
*tatra tatropacārāṇāṃ liṃge vānyatra vā kvacit \|\| 51 \|\|*

51\. When the half-female form of the lord is to be worshipped, no serial order in the performance of rites shall be observed. Similarly in regard to the services rendered to the phallic or the embodied image.

## \|\| 12.24.52 \|\|

*kṛtvā 'bhiṣekaṃ liṃgasya śucinā ca sugaṃdhinā \|*  
*saṃmṛjya vāsasā dadyādaṃbaraṃ copavītakam \|\| 52 \|\|*

52\. After performing the ablution of the phallic idol it shall be wiped with a pure fragrant cloth. The devotee shall then offer garment and the sacred thread.

## \|\| 12.24.53-56 \|\|

*pādyamācamanaṃ cārghyaṃ gaṃdhaṃ puṣpaṃ ca bhūṣaṇam \|*  
*dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ ca naivedyaṃ pānīyaṃ mukhaśodhanam \|\| 53 \|\|*

*punaścācamanīyaṃ ca mukhavāsaṃ tataḥ param \|*  
*mukuṭaṃ ca śubhaṃ bhadraṃ sarvaratnairalaṃkṛtam \|\| 54 \|\|*

*bhūṣaṇāni pavitrāṇi mālyāni vividhāni ca \|*  
*vyajane cāmare chatraṃ tālavṛṃtaṃ ca darpaṇam \|\| 55 \|\|*

*dattvā nīrājanaṃ kuryātsarvamaṃgalanisvanaiḥ \|*  
*gītanṛtyādibhiścaiva jayaśabdasamanvitaḥ \|\| 56 \|\|*

53-56. These are offered in order—Pādya, Ācamana, Arghya, scents, flowers, ornaments, incense, light, Naivedya, water for drinking, water for rinsing, Ācamanīya once again, substance for the fragrance of the mouth, good and auspicious coronet studded with all gems, ornaments, sacred garlands of different types, fans, chowries, palmyra leaf fan, mirror, and Nīrājana. At the time of Nīrājana there shall be all sorts of auspicious sounds like songs, instrumental music, dance and shouts of ‘Victory’.

## \|\| 12.24.57-59 \|\|

*haime ca rājate tāmre pātre vā mṛnmaye śubhe \|*  
*padmakaiśśobhitaiḥ puṣpairbījairdadhyakṣatādibhiḥ \|\| 57 \|\|*

*triśūlaśaṃkhayugmābjanandyāvartaiḥ karīṣajaiḥ \|*  
*śrīvatsasvastikādarśavajrairvahnyādicihnitaiḥ \|\| 58 \|\|*

*aṣṭau pradīpānparito vidhāyaikaṃ tu madhyame \|*  
*teṣu vāmādikāścintyāḥ pūjyāśca nava śaktayaḥ \|\| 59 \|\|*

57-59. In a big flat vessel made of gold, silver, copper or clay he shall worship the lord with lotuses, seeds, flowers, curd, Akṣatas, Nandyāvarta flowers etc. in the forms of Śrīvatsa, Svastika, mirror, Vajra, fire etc. Eight lamps shall be lighted all round and one lamp shall be kept in the middle. In these the nine Śaktis Vāmā etc. shall be meditated upon and worshipped.

## \|\| 12.24.60 \|\|

*kavacena samācchādya saṃrakṣyāstreṇa sarvataḥ \|*  
*dhenumudrāṃ ca saṃdarśya pāṇibhyāṃ pātramuddharet \|\| 60 \|\|*

60\. After covering with Kavaca mantra and protecting with the Astra mantra he shall show the Mudrā of cow and lift the vessel with both the hands.

## \|\| 12.24.61 \|\|

*athavāropayetpātre pañcadīpānyathākramam \|*  
*vidikṣvapi ca madhye ca dīpamekamathāpi vā \|\| 61 \|\|*

61\. Or only five lamps shall be kept, four in the four quarters and one in the middle, or only one lamp need be lit.

## \|\| 12.24.62 \|\|

*tatastatpātramuddhṛtya liṃgāderupari kramāt \|*  
*triḥ pradakṣiṇayogena bhrāmayenmūlavidyayā \|\| 62 \|\|*

62\. Lifting the vessel, the devotee shall whirl it thrice above the phallic image in the manner of circumambulation, with the basic Mantra.

## \|\| 12.24.63 \|\|

*dadyādarghyaṃ tato mūrdhni bhasitaṃ ca sugaṃdhitam \|*  
*kṛtvā puṣpāṃjaliṃ paścādupahārānnivedayet \|\| 63 \|\|*

63 He shall offer Arghya and apply the scented Bhasma on the head. After offering a handful of flowers the rite of Naivedya shall be performed.

## \|\| 12.24.64 \|\|

*pānīyaṃ ca tato dadyāddattvā vācamanaṃ punaḥ \|*  
*pañcasaugaṃdhikopetaṃ tāmbūlaṃ ca nivedayet \|\| 64 \|\|*

64\. After offering water for drinking he shall offer Ācamana once again. Tāmbūla with five-scented spices shall be offered.

## \|\| 12.24.65 \|\|

*prokṣayetprokṣaṇīyāni gānanāṭyāni kārayet \|*  
*liṃgādau śivayościntāṃ kṛtvā śaktyajapecchivam \|\| 65 \|\|*

65\. All materials of worship shall be sprinkled with water. Music and dances shall go on. Conceiving the presence of Śiva and Śivā in the phallic image he shall perform the Japa of Śiva according to his ability.

## \|\| 12.24.66 \|\|

*pradakṣiṇaṃ praṇāmaṃ ca stavaṃ cātmasamarpaṇam \|*  
*vijñāpanaṃ ca kāryāṇāṃ kuryādvinayapūrvakam \|\| 66 \|\|*

66\. Circumambulation, obeisance, eulogy, dedication of the self and submission of one’s wish shall be humbly made.

## \|\| 12.24.67 \|\|

*arghyaṃ puṣpāṃjaliṃ dattvā baddhvā mudrāṃ yathāvidhi \|*  
*paścātkṣamāpayeddevamudvāsyātmani ciṃtayet \|\| 67 \|\|*

67\. Arghya and handful of flowers shall be offered and Mudrā shall be shown in accordance with injunctions. Forgiveness shall be prayed and the lord shall be ritualistically dismissed. The devotee shall meditate on the lord only in his Ātman.

## \|\| 12.24.68 \|\|

*pādyādimukhavāsāṃtamarghyādyaṃ cātisaṃkaṭe \|*  
*puṣpavikṣepamātraṃ vā kuryādbhāvapurassaram \|\| 68 \|\|*

68\. In distress the offerings are restricted to those beginning with Pādya and ending with Tāmbūla, or to those beginning with Arghya, or to mere offering of flowers, but with pious feelings.

## \|\| 12.24.69 \|\|

*tāvataiva paro dharmo bhāvane sukṛto bhavet \|*  
*asaṃpūjya na bhuñjīta śivamāprāṇasaṃcarāt \|\| 69 \|\|*

69\. Even that much is enough for earning virtue. As long as he lives the devotee shall not take meals without worshipping Śiva.

## \|\| 12.24.70-72 \|\|

*yadi pāpastu bhuṃjīta svairaṃ taysa na niṣkṛtiḥ \|*
