## \|\| 12.32.54 \|\|

*dravyairviśeṣato home vaśyamākarṣaṇaṃ tathā \|*  
*vaśyamākarṣaṇaṃ caiva śrīpadaṃ ca viśeṣataḥ \|\| 54 \|\|*

54\. Quiescent, nourishing, Vaśya and Ākarṣaṇa rites shall be performed with the seven articles of worship sacrificial twigs etc.

## \|\| 12.32.55 \|\|

*bilvapatraistu havanaṃ śatrorvijayadaṃ tathā \|*  
*samidhaḥ śāṃtikāryeṣu pālāśakhadirādikāḥ \|\| 55 \|\|*

55\. Vaśya, Ākarṣaṇa and Śrīpada (glorious position) rites shall be performed with the leaves of Bilva for Havana. It yields conquest over the enemies

## \|\| 12.32.56 \|\|

*karavīrārkajāḥ kraurye kaṇṭakinyaśca vigrahe \|*  
*praśāṃtaḥ śāṃtikaṃ kuryātpauṣṭikaṃ ca viśeṣataḥ \|\| 56 \|\|*

56\. In quiescent rites the twigs of Palāśa, Khadira etc. shall be used. In rites of cruelty the twigs of Karavīra and Arka shall be used. Twigs of thorny trees shall be used in the rite of war.

## \|\| 12.32.57 \|\|

*nirghṛṇaḥ kruddhacittastu prakuryādābhicārikam \|*  
*atīvaduravasthāyāṃ pratīkārāṃtaraṃ na cet \|\| 57 \|\|*

57\. A quiet man shall perform the quiescent and nourishing rites particularly. A ruthless man with angry mind shall perform Abhicarika rites.

## \|\| 12.32.58 \|\|

*ātatāyinamuddiśya prakuryādābhicārikam \|*  
*svarāṣṭrapatimuddiśya na kuryādābhicārikam \|\| 58 \|\|*

58\. When the harassment is unbearable and condition is pitiable, when there is no other remedy, only then shall one perform the Ābhicārika rite against desperadoes.

## \|\| 12.32.59 \|\|

*yadyāstikassudharmiṣṭho mānyo vā yo 'pi kopi vā \|*  
*tamuddiśyāpi no kuryādātatāyinamapyuta \|\| 59 \|\|*

59\. No virtuous man, occupying honourable position or otherwise shall perform the Ābhicārika rite against the ruler of his country.

## \|\| 12.32.60 \|\|

*manasā karmaṇā vācā yo 'pi kopi śivāśritaḥ \|*  
*svarāṣṭrapatimuddiśya śivā śritamathāpi vā \|\| 60 \|\|*

60\. Even if he happens to be a desperado one shall not perform Ābhicārika rite against a person who has sought refuge in Śiva, mentally, verbally or physically.

## \|\| 12.32.61 \|\|

*kṛtvābhicārikaṃ karma sadyo vinipatennaraḥ \|*  
*svarāṣṭrapālakaṃ tasmācchivabhaktaṃ ca kañcana \|\| 61 \|\|*

61\. A man performing Ābhicārika rite against the ruler of his country whether he be a devotee of Śiva or not, shall have a fall immediately.

## \|\| 12.32.62 \|\|

*na hiṃsyādabhicārādyairyadīcchetsukhamātmanaḥ \|*  
*anyaṃ kamapi coddiśya kṛtvā vai māraṇādikam \|\| 62 \|\|*

62\. If he wishes for his own happinness he shall not perform Ābhicārika rite against the protector of his country or against any devotee of Śiva.

## \|\| 12.32.63 \|\|

*paścāttāpena saṃyuktaḥ prāyaścittaṃ samācaret \|*  
*bāṇaliṃge 'pi vā kuryānnirdhano dhanavānapi \|\| 63 \|\|*

63\. If he performs the rite of Māraṇa etc. against any other person he shall perform expiatory rites after due repentence.

## \|\| 12.32.64 \|\|

*svayaṃbhūte 'tha vā liṃge ārṣake vaidike 'pi vā \|*  
*abhāve hemaratnānāmaśaktau ca tadarjane \|\| 64 \|\|*

64\. Whether the devotee is rich or poor he shall worship the lord in a Bāṇa or self-born or Ārṣaka or a Vaidika liṅga.

## \|\| 12.32.65 \|\|

*manasaivācaredetaddravyairvā pratirūpakaiḥ \|*  
*kvacidaṃśe tu yaḥ śaktastvaśaktaḥ kvacidaṃśake \|\| 65 \|\|*

65\. If liṅgas of gold and gems are not available or if he is unable to possess them he shall perform the worship mentally or with substitute articles.

## \|\| 12.32.66 \|\|

*so 'pi śaktyanusāreṇa kurvaṃścetphalamṛcchati \|*  
*karmaṇyanuṣṭhite 'pyasminphalaṃ yatra na dṛśyate \|\| 66 \|\|*

66\. If a devotee can perform worship in some part he too derives the benefit of that part in accordance with his ability.

## \|\| 12.32.67 \|\|

*dvistrirvāvartayettatra sarvathā dṛśyate phalam \|*  
*pūjopayuktaṃ yaddravyaṃ hemaratnādyanuttamam \|\| 67 \|\|*

67\. If the benefit is not seen even if the rite is performed, it shall be repeated twice or thrice. By all means the benefit will be received.

## \|\| 12.32.68 \|\|

*tatsarvaṃ gurave dadyāddakṣiṇāṃ ca tataḥ pṛthak \|*  
*sa cennecchati tatsarvaṃ śivāya vinivedayet \|\| 68 \|\|*

68\. Whatever material is used in worship, gold, gem and other articles shall be handed to the preceptor apart form the Dakṣiṇā offered separately.

## \|\| 12.32.69 \|\|

*athavā śivabhaktebhyo nānyebhyastu pradīyate \|*  
*yaḥ svayaṃ sādhayecchaktyā gurvādinirapekṣayā \|\| 69 \|\|*

69\. If the preceptor does not wish to receive, the entire gift shall be given to Śiva or the devotees of Śiva. It shall not be given to any other.

## \|\| 12.32.70-71 \|\|

*so 'pyevamācaredatra na gṛhṇīyātsvayaṃ punaḥ \|*  
*svayaṃ gṛhṇāti yo lobhātpūjāṃgadravyamuttamam \|\| 70 \|\|*

*kāṃkṣitaṃ na labhenmūḍho nātra kāryā vicāraṇā \|*  
*arcitaṃ yattu talliṃgaṃ gṛhṇīyādvā navā svayam \|\| 71 \|\|*

70-71. If any one performs the rite himself without the help of a preceptor the procedure shall be the same. He shall not appropriate the gift to himself. If he appropriates the articles of worship for himself out of greed under delusion he will not attain his desire,

## \|\| 12.32.72 \|\|

*gṛhṇīyādyadi tannityaṃ svayaṃ vānyo 'pi vārcayet \|*  
*yathoktameva karmaitadācaredyo 'napāyataḥ \|\| 72 \|\|*

72\. The liṅga used for worship may be taken by himself or given to others. If he takes that himself he shall worship it everyday or cause it to be worshipped on his behalf.

## \|\| 12.32.73 \|\|

*phalaṃ vyabhicarennaivamityataḥ kiṃ prarocakam \|*  
*tathāpyuddeśato vakṣye karmaṇaḥ siddhimuttamam \|\| 73 \|\|*

73\. If he performs the rite as ordained he cannot but have the benefit. What other inducement for worship shall there be?

## \|\| 12.32.74-75 \|\|

*api śatrubhirākrāṃto vyādhibhirvāpyanekaśaḥ \|*  
*mṛtyorāsyagataścāpi mucyate nirapāyataḥ \|\| 74 \|\|*

*pūjāyate 'tikṛpaṇo rikto vaiśravaṇāyate \|*  
*kāmāyate virūpo 'pi vṛddho 'pi taruṇāyate \|\| 75 \|\|*

74-75. Still I shall mention about the excellent achievement through the rite. Even if he is attacked by the enemy or tormented by ailments, even if he falls into the jaws of death he will be freed without danger. Even the worst miserly fellow will become worthy of respect. The poor will become Kuvera, god of wealth.

## \|\| 12.32.76 \|\|

*śatrurmitrāyate sadyo virodhī kiṃkarāyate \|*  
*viṣāyate yadamṛtaṃ viṣamapyamṛtāyate \|\| 76 \|\|*

76\. The ugly man will become beautiful, the aged will become young. The enemy will turn a friend, the opponent will grow subordinate.

## \|\| 12.32.77-79 \|\|

*sthalāyate samudro 'pi sthalamapyarṇavāyate \|*  
*mahīdharāyate śvabhraṃ sa ca śvabhrāyate giriḥ \|\| 77 \|\|*

*padmākarāyate vahniḥ saro vaiśvānarāyate \|*  
*vanāyate yadudyānaṃ tadudyānāyate vanam \|\| 78 \|\|*

*siṃhāyate mṛgaḥ kṣudraḥ siṃhaḥ krīḍāmṛgāyate \|*  
*striyo 'bhisārikāyante lakṣmīḥ sucaritāyate \|\| 79 \|\|*

77-79. The nectar that may have turned into poison shall become nectar again. The ground may turn into ocean and ocean into ground; the ditch into a mountain and the mountain into a ditch; fire into a lotus lake and the lotus lake into fire; the park into a forest and the forest into a garden; the animal into a lion and the lion into an animal.

## \|\| 12.32.80 \|\|

*svairapreṣyāyate vāṇī kīrtistu gaṇikāyate \|*  
*svairācārāyate medhā vajrasūcīyate manaḥ \|\| 80 \|\|*

80\. Women will run after him voluntarily. Prosperity will behave like a chaste lady and will not leave him. The goddess of speech will be his slave girl, fame a prostitute.

## \|\| 12.32.81 \|\|

*mahāvātāyate śaktirbalaṃ mattagajāyate \|*  
*stambhāyate samudyogaiḥ śatrupakṣe sthitā kriyā \|\| 81 \|\|*

81\. The intelligence will roam about as it pleases. His mind will be pure like a diamond. His strength will be like a violent gust of wind or like an elephant in rut.

## \|\| 12.32.82 \|\|

*śatrupakṣāyate 'rīṇāṃ sarva eva suhṛjjanaḥ \|*  
*śatravaḥ kuṇapāyante jīvantopi sabāṃdhavāḥ \|\| 82 \|\|*

82\. His activities on the side of the enemies will be paralysed in their effort. The friends of enemies will become their enemies.

## \|\| 12.32.83 \|\|

*āpanno 'pi gatāriṣṭaḥ svayaṃ khalvamṛtāyate \|*  
*rasāya nāyate nityamapathyamapi sevitam \|\| 83 \|\|*

83\. The enemies along with their kinsmen will be no better than corpses though physically alive. Though faced with mishaps he will be freed from them and become immortal.

## \|\| 12.32.84 \|\|

*aniśaṃ kriyamāṇāpi ratistvabhinavāyate \|*  
*anāgatādikaṃ sarvaṃ karasthāmalakāyate \|\| 84 \|\|*

84\. Even if he takes unwholesome food it will act as aphrodisiac. Even if he indulges in sexual intercourse everyday it will give him fresh thrills.

## \|\| 12.32.85 \|\|

*yādṛcchikaphalāyante siddhayo 'pyaṇimādayaḥ \|*  
*bahunātra kimuktena sarvakāmārthasiddhiṣu \|\| 85 \|\|*

85\. Everything hitherto inaccessible to him will become accessible like the myrobalan in the palm. Even Siddhis aṇimā etc. will become available at his will.

## \|\| 12.32.86 \|\|

*asminkarmaṇi nirvṛtte tvanavāpyaṃ na vidyate \|\| 86 \|\|*

86\. Of what use is much talk? When this rite is performed there remains nothing unattainable.

## Chapter 33 - Rites for deriving benefits hereafter

## \|\| 12.33.1 \|\|

*upamanyuruvāca \|*  
*ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi kevalāmuṣmikaṃ vidhim \|*  
*naitena sadṛśaṃ kiṃcitkarmāsti bhuvanatraye \|\| 1 \|\|*

Upamanyu said:—

1\. Now I shall mention the rite for the benefits attainable solely after death. There is nothing like this rite in the three worlds.

## \|\| 12.33.2-6 \|\|

*puṇyātiśayasaṃyuktaḥ sarvairdevairanuṣṭhitaḥ \|*  
*brahmaṇā viṣṇunā caiva rudreṇa ca viśeṣataḥ \|\| 2 \|\|*

*iṃdrādilokapāraiśca sūryādyairnavabhirgrahaiḥ \|*  
*viśvāmitravasiṣṭhādyairbrahmavidbhirmaharṣibhiḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

*śvetāgastyadadhīcādyairasmābhiśca śivāśritaiḥ \|*  
*naṃdīśvaramahākālabhṛṃgīśādyairgaṇeśvaraiḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

*pātālavāsibhirdaityaiḥ śeṣādyaiśca mahoragaiḥ \|*  
*siddhairyakṣaiśca gaṃdharvai rakṣobhūtapiśācakaiḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

*svaṃsvaṃ padamanuprāptaṃ sarvairayamanuṣṭhitaḥ \|*  
*anena vidhinā sarve devā devatvamāgatāḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

2-6. The rite is attended with the excellence of merits. It has been performed by all the gods, particularly by Brahmā, Viṣṇu, Rudra, Indra, the guardians of the quarters, the nine planets—sun-god and others, by Viśvāmitra, Vasiṣṭha and other sages who know Brahman, by Śveta, Agastya, Dadhīca and others, by us seeking refuge in Śiva, by Nandīśvara, Mahākāla, Bhṛṅgīśa and other Gaṇeśvaras, by the Daityas residing in the nether worlds, by Śeṣa and other serpents, by Siddhas, Yakṣas, Gandharvas, Rākṣasas, Bhūtas, Piśācas and practically by every one who has attained his respective position. It is by means of this rite that the gods have attained their godhood.

## \|\| 12.33.7 \|\|

*brahmā brahmatvamāpanno viṣṇurviṣṇutvamāgataḥ \|*  
*rudro rudratvamāpanna iṃdraścendratvamāgataḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. Brahmā attained his Brahmāhood, Viṣṇu his Viṣṇuhood, Rudra his Rudrahood and Indra his Indrahood. It is by means of this rite that Gaṇeśa attained his Gaṇeśahood.

## \|\| 12.33.8-10 \|\|

*gaṇeśaśca gaṇeśatvamanena vidhinā gataḥ \|*  
*sitacaṃdanatoyena liṃgaṃ snāpya śivaṃ śivām \|*

*śvetairvikasitaiḥ padmaiḥ saṃpūjya praṇipatya ca \|*  
*tatra padmāsanaṃ ramyaṃ kṛtvā lakṣaṇasaṃyutam \|\| 8 \|\|*

*vibhave sati hemādyai ratnādyairvā svaśaktitaḥ \|*  
*madhye kesarajālāsya sthāpya liṃgaṃ kanīyasam \|\| 9 \|\|*

*aṃguṣṭhapratimaṃ ramyaṃ sarvagandhamayaṃ śubham \|*  
*dakṣiṇe sthāpayitvā tu bilvapatraiḥ samarcayet \|\| 10 \|\|*

8-10. The liṅga shall be bathed with white sandal water. Therein Śiva find Śivā shall be worshipped with full-blown white lotuses and bowed to. He shall make a lotus-seat very charming and endowed with all characteristics by means of gold-dust and gem-dust in accordance with one’s affluence. In the midst of the filaments a small liṅga shall be placed. It shall be of the size of the thumb, but charming, auspicious and rendered fragrant with all scents. It shall be placed to the south and worshipped with Bilva leaves.

## \|\| 12.33.11-12 \|\|

*aguruṃ dakṣiṇe pārśve paścime tu manaḥśilām \|*  
*uttare caṃdanaṃ dadyāddharitālaṃ tu pūrvataḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

*sugandhaiḥ kusumai ramyairvicitraiścāpi pūjayet \|*  
*dhūpaṃ kṛṣṇāguruṃ dadyātsarvataśca saguggulam \|\| 12 \|\|*

11-12. To the south he shall apply Aguru. To the west he shall apply red arsenic. To the north he shall apply sandal and to the east he shall apply yellow orpiment. He shall then worship with charming fragrant flowers of various colours.

## \|\| 12.33.13 \|\|

*vāsāṃsi cātisūkṣmāṇi vikāśāni nivedayet \|*  
*pāyasaṃ ghṛtasaṃmiśraṃ ghṛtadīpāṃśca dāpayet \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. The black Aguru shall be used for incense and fumigation along with Guggulu. Fine cloths bright in colours shall be offered.

## \|\| 12.33.14 \|\|

*sarvaṃ nivedya mantreṇa tato gacchetpradakṣiṇām \|*  
*praṇamya bhaktyā deveśaṃ stutvā cānte kṣamāpayet \|\| 14 \|\|*

14\. Milk-pudding mixed with ghee, and lamps with ghee for burning shall be offered. After offering everything with repetitions of mantras he shall circumambulate.

## \|\| 12.33.15 \|\|

*sarvopahārasaṃmiśraṃ tato liṃgaṃ nivedayet \|*  
*śivāya śivamantreṇa dakṣiṇāmūrtimāśritaḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. After bowing with devotion to the lord of the gods he shall eulogise the lord and crave forgiveness. Naivedya consisting of all offerings shall be offered to the Liṅga.

## \|\| 12.33.16-17 \|\|

*evaṃ yo 'rcayate nityaṃ pañcagandhamayaṃ śubham \|*  
*sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ śivaloke mahīyate \|\| 16 \|\|*

*etadvratottamaṃ guhyaṃ śivaliṃgamahāvratam \|*  
*bhaktasya te samākhyātaṃ na deyaṃ yasya kasyacit \|\| 17 \|\|*

16-17. It shall be dedicated to Śiva with his mantras. The devotee shall seek refuge in Dakṣiṇāmūrti. He who performs the worship with the auspicious five scents shall be freed from all sins. He shall be honoured in Śiva’s region. This holy Vrata of Śiva liṅga is the most excellent, a great secret.

## \|\| 12.33.18 \|\|

*deyaṃ ca śivabhaktebhyaḥ śivena kathitaṃ purā \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. This has been mentioned to you since you are a great devotee. This shall not be given to any one and everyone. It shall be given to devotees of Śiva as mentioned by Śiva formerly.

## Chapter 34 - The delusion of Viṣṇu and Brahmā (1)

## \|\| 12.34.1 \|\|

*śrāṃtotyaṃtamadṛṣṭvāṃtaṃ pāpatādhaḥ pitāmahaḥ \| \|*  
*tathaiva bhagavān viṣṇuḥ śrāṃtaḥ saṃvignalocanaḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

Upamanyu said:—

1\. The achievement of benefit that has been mentioned here from the Nitya, Naimittika and Kāmya rites can entirely be secured immediately by installing the phallic and the bodily image of Śiva.

## \|\| 12.34.2 \|\|

*śrāṃtotyaṃtamadṛṣṭvāṃtaṃ pāpatādhaḥ pitāmahaḥ \| \|*  
*tathaiva bhagavān viṣṇuḥ śrāṃtaḥ saṃvignalocanaḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

2\. The world is in the form of Liṅga. Everything is founded on Liṅga. Hence if the Liṅga is installed, everything is installed.

## \|\| 12.34.3 \|\|

*śrāṃtotyaṃtamadṛṣṭvāṃtaṃ pāpatādhaḥ pitāmahaḥ \| \|*  
*tathaiva bhagavān viṣṇuḥ śrāṃtaḥ saṃvignalocanaḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

3\. It is only by resorting to the installation of the Liṅga that Brahmā, Viṣṇu, Rudra or other deities maintain their splendour.

## \|\| 12.34.4 \|\|

*śrāṃtotyaṃtamadṛṣṭvāṃtaṃ pāpatādhaḥ pitāmahaḥ \| \|*  
*tathaiva bhagavān viṣṇuḥ śrāṃtaḥ saṃvignalocanaḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

4\. What more reason can be advanced for the installation of Liṅga than that Liṅga of Viśveśvara has been installed by Śiva too?

## \|\| 12.34.5 \|\|

*śrāṃtotyaṃtamadṛṣṭvāṃtaṃ pāpatādhaḥ pitāmahaḥ \| \|*  
*tathaiva bhagavān viṣṇuḥ śrāṃtaḥ saṃvignalocanaḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

5\. Hence by all means one shall install the phallic or the bodily image of Śiva for his welfare here and hereafter.

## \|\| 12.34.6 \|\|

*śrāṃtotyaṃtamadṛṣṭvāṃtaṃ pāpatādhaḥ pitāmahaḥ \| \|*  
*tathaiva bhagavān viṣṇuḥ śrāṃtaḥ saṃvignalocanaḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

Śrī Kṛṣṇa said:—

6\. What is a Liṅga? How is lord Śiva a Liṅgin? How did he have the status of a Liṅga? Why is he worshipped in it?

## \|\| 12.34.7 \|\|

*śrāṃtotyaṃtamadṛṣṭvāṃtaṃ pāpatādhaḥ pitāmahaḥ \| \|*  
*tathaiva bhagavān viṣṇuḥ śrāṃtaḥ saṃvignalocanaḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

Upamanyu said:—

7\. The unmanifest is called the Liṅga. It is the source of attributes as well as that wherein the universe merges and dissolves. It has neither beginning nor end. It is the material cause of the universe.

## \|\| 12.34.8 \|\|

*śrāṃtotyaṃtamadṛṣṭvāṃtaṃ pāpatādhaḥ pitāmahaḥ \| \|*  
*tathaiva bhagavān viṣṇuḥ śrāṃtaḥ saṃvignalocanaḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

8\. It is the Māyā, the Mūlaprakṛti as extensive as the firmament. This universe including the mobile and immobile beings is born of that.

## \|\| 12.34.9 \|\|

*śrāṃtotyaṃtamadṛṣṭvāṃtaṃ pāpatādhaḥ pitāmahaḥ \| \|*  
*tathaiva bhagavān viṣṇuḥ śrāṃtaḥ saṃvignalocanaḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

9\. The universe is of three types: the impure, pure and the pure-impure. From the Liṅga are born Śiva, Maheśa, Rudra, Viṣṇu and Brahmā.

## \|\| 12.34.10 \|\|

*śrāṃtotyaṃtamadṛṣṭvāṃtaṃ pāpatādhaḥ pitāmahaḥ \| \|*  
*tathaiva bhagavān viṣṇuḥ śrāṃtaḥ saṃvignalocanaḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

10\. The Bhūtas with the sense-organs merge into this at the bidding of Śiva, He is Liṅgin since he commands the Liṅga.

## \|\| 12.34.11-12 \|\|

*śrāṃtotyaṃtamadṛṣṭvāṃtaṃ pāpatādhaḥ pitāmahaḥ \| \|*  
*tathaiva bhagavān viṣṇuḥ śrāṃtaḥ saṃvignalocanaḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

*śrāṃtotyaṃtamadṛṣṭvāṃtaṃ pāpatādhaḥ pitāmahaḥ \| \|*  
*tathaiva bhagavān viṣṇuḥ śrāṃtaḥ saṃvignalocanaḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

11-12. Since the Liṅga can do nothing by itself without being commanded by Śiva, since the dissolution of the universe born of it is only within it, this constitutes the state of being Liṅga in Śiva and not due to any other reason. The Liṅga is the body of Śiva and Śivā because it is presided over by them.

## \|\| 12.34.13 \|\|

*śrāṃtotyaṃtamadṛṣṭvāṃtaṃ pāpatādhaḥ pitāmahaḥ \| \|*  
*tathaiva bhagavān viṣṇuḥ śrāṃtaḥ saṃvignalocanaḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

13\. Hence Śiva is worshipped therein for ever along with Śivā. The goddess is the pedestal of the Liṅga and Liṅga is lord Śiva himself.

## \|\| 12.34.14 \|\|

*śrāṃtotyaṃtamadṛṣṭvāṃtaṃ pāpatādhaḥ pitāmahaḥ \| \|*  
*tathaiva bhagavān viṣṇuḥ śrāṃtaḥ saṃvignalocanaḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

14\. By the worship of Liṅga alone, Śiva and Śivā are worshipped. Their having the Liṅga for their body is not the ultimate reality.

## \|\| 12.34.15-16 \|\|

*śrāṃtotyaṃtamadṛṣṭvāṃtaṃ pāpatādhaḥ pitāmahaḥ \| \|*  
*tathaiva bhagavān viṣṇuḥ śrāṃtaḥ saṃvignalocanaḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

*śrāṃtotyaṃtamadṛṣṭvāṃtaṃ pāpatādhaḥ pitāmahaḥ \| \|*  
*tathaiva bhagavān viṣṇuḥ śrāṃtaḥ saṃvignalocanaḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

15-16. Since they are pure it is their body only in a secondary sense. That is the great Śakti of Śiva the great Ātman. Śakti at the behest of Śiva gives birth to mobile and immobile beings. One cannot describe the glory of the Liṅga, even in hundreds of years, by which Brahmā and Viṣṇu were deluded at the outset.

## \|\| 12.34.17-19 \|\|

*śrāṃtotyaṃtamadṛṣṭvāṃtaṃ pāpatādhaḥ pitāmahaḥ \| \|*  
*tathaiva bhagavān viṣṇuḥ śrāṃtaḥ saṃvignalocanaḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

*śrāṃtotyaṃtamadṛṣṭvāṃtaṃ pāpatādhaḥ pitāmahaḥ \| \|*  
*tathaiva bhagavān viṣṇuḥ śrāṃtaḥ saṃvignalocanaḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

*śrāṃtotyaṃtamadṛṣṭvāṃtaṃ pāpatādhaḥ pitāmahaḥ \| \|*  
*tathaiva bhagavān viṣṇuḥ śrāṃtaḥ saṃvignalocanaḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

17-19. Formerly when the universe was in the state of dissolution, Viṣṇu lying on his couch in the waters went into deep slumber. He lay comfortably asleep. Brahmā the grandfather of the worlds casually went there. He saw the lotus-eyed Viṣṇu sleeping undisturbedly. Deluded by the Māyā of Śiva, Brahmā said to Viṣṇu.

## \|\| 12.34.20-21 \|\|

*śrāṃtotyaṃtamadṛṣṭvāṃtaṃ pāpatādhaḥ pitāmahaḥ \| \|*  
*tathaiva bhagavān viṣṇuḥ śrāṃtaḥ saṃvignalocanaḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

*śrāṃtotyaṃtamadṛṣṭvāṃtaṃ pāpatādhaḥ pitāmahaḥ \| \|*  
*tathaiva bhagavān viṣṇuḥ śrāṃtaḥ saṃvignalocanaḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

20-21. “Who are you? Tell me”.?o saying he hit Viṣṇu angrily and wakened him. Struck by the blow of his hand Viṣṇu woke up in a trice and got up from his bed. He saw Brahmā there. Viṣṇu though infuriated within addressed him politely.

## \|\| 12.34.22-25 \|\|

*śrāṃtotyaṃtamadṛṣṭvāṃtaṃ pāpatādhaḥ pitāmahaḥ \| \|*  
*tathaiva bhagavān viṣṇuḥ śrāṃtaḥ saṃvignalocanaḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

*śrāṃtotyaṃtamadṛṣṭvāṃtaṃ pāpatādhaḥ pitāmahaḥ \| \|*  
*tathaiva bhagavān viṣṇuḥ śrāṃtaḥ saṃvignalocanaḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

*śrāṃtotyaṃtamadṛṣṭvāṃtaṃ pāpatādhaḥ pitāmahaḥ \| \|*  
*tathaiva bhagavān viṣṇuḥ śrāṃtaḥ saṃvignalocanaḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

*śrāṃtotyaṃtamadṛṣṭvāṃtaṃ pāpatādhaḥ pitāmahaḥ \| \|*  
*tathaiva bhagavān viṣṇuḥ śrāṃtaḥ saṃvignalocanaḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

22-25. “O dear son, whence have you come? Why are you agitated? Tell me.” On hearing the words of Viṣṇu, indicative of his lordly attitude Brahmā felt irritated due to his Rājasic qualities and spoke again. “Why do you address me as ‘dear son’ like a preceptor calling his disciple? Don’t you know that I am the lord. This universe is my creation. After dividing myself into three, I create, protect and annihilate. There is none in the universe who has created me.” When thus addressed Viṣṇu said to Brahmā.

## \|\| 12.34.26-30 \|\|

*śrāṃtotyaṃtamadṛṣṭvāṃtaṃ pāpatādhaḥ pitāmahaḥ \| \|*  
*tathaiva bhagavān viṣṇuḥ śrāṃtaḥ saṃvignalocanaḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

*śrāṃtotyaṃtamadṛṣṭvāṃtaṃ pāpatādhaḥ pitāmahaḥ \| \|*  
*tathaiva bhagavān viṣṇuḥ śrāṃtaḥ saṃvignalocanaḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

*śrāṃtotyaṃtamadṛṣṭvāṃtaṃ pāpatādhaḥ pitāmahaḥ \| \|*  
*tathaiva bhagavān viṣṇuḥ śrāṃtaḥ saṃvignalocanaḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

*śrāṃtotyaṃtamadṛṣṭvāṃtaṃ pāpatādhaḥ pitāmahaḥ \| \|*  
*tathaiva bhagavān viṣṇuḥ śrāṃtaḥ saṃvignalocanaḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

*śrāṃtotyaṃtamadṛṣṭvāṃtaṃ pāpatādhaḥ pitāmahaḥ \| \|*  
*tathaiva bhagavān viṣṇuḥ śrāṃtaḥ saṃvignalocanaḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

26-30. “I am the primordial creator of this universe, the protector and the annihilator. You too, O sir, were born of me formerly. At my unthwartable bidding you divided yourself into three and began creation. You create the three worlds, protect, dissolve and re-create it. You forget Viṣṇu the lord of the universe free from ailments. You insult even me, your father. It is not your fault. You have been deluded by my Māyā. Due to my favour this delusion of yours will disappear ere long. O Brahmā, listen to the truth. I am the lord of all gods. I am the creator, sustainer and annihilator. There is no other lord equal to me.”

## \|\| 12.34.31 \|\|

*śrāṃtotyaṃtamadṛṣṭvāṃtaṃ pāpatādhaḥ pitāmahaḥ \| \|*  
*tathaiva bhagavān viṣṇuḥ śrāṃtaḥ saṃvignalocanaḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

31\. A verbal dispute between Brahmā and Viṣṇu arose thus. Thereafter a terrible fight ensued causing horripilation.

## \|\| 12.34.32-36 \|\|

*śrāṃtotyaṃtamadṛṣṭvāṃtaṃ pāpatādhaḥ pitāmahaḥ \| \|*  
*tathaiva bhagavān viṣṇuḥ śrāṃtaḥ saṃvignalocanaḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

*śrāṃtotyaṃtamadṛṣṭvāṃtaṃ pāpatādhaḥ pitāmahaḥ \| \|*  
*tathaiva bhagavān viṣṇuḥ śrāṃtaḥ saṃvignalocanaḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

*śrāṃtotyaṃtamadṛṣṭvāṃtaṃ pāpatādhaḥ pitāmahaḥ \| \|*  
*tathaiva bhagavān viṣṇuḥ śrāṃtaḥ saṃvignalocanaḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

*śrāṃtotyaṃtamadṛṣṭvāṃtaṃ pāpatādhaḥ pitāmahaḥ \| \|*  
*tathaiva bhagavān viṣṇuḥ śrāṃtaḥ saṃvignalocanaḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

*śrāṃtotyaṃtamadṛṣṭvāṃtaṃ pāpatādhaḥ pitāmahaḥ \| \|*  
*tathaiva bhagavān viṣṇuḥ śrāṃtaḥ saṃvignalocanaḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

32-36. Due to Rājasic quality they fought and hit each other with fists. In order to dispel their arrogance and to enlighten them, the wonderful Liṅga of the lord appeared in between them. It had thousands of flames. It was incomprehensible and incomparable. It did not increase or decrease. It had no beginning, no middle, no end. Brahmā and Viṣṇu were enchanted by thousands of flames. Ceasing from their fight they began to think “What is this?” When they could not understand the reality they attempted to survey its beginning and end.

## \|\| 12.34.37 \|\|

*śrāṃtotyaṃtamadṛṣṭvāṃtaṃ pāpatādhaḥ pitāmahaḥ \| \|*  
*tathaiva bhagavān viṣṇuḥ śrāṃtaḥ saṃvignalocanaḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

37\. Brahmā took the form of a swan with wings all round and went up assiduously with the speed of the mind or wind.

## \|\| 12.34.38 \|\|

*śrāṃtotyaṃtamadṛṣṭvāṃtaṃ pāpatādhaḥ pitāmahaḥ \| \|*  
*tathaiva bhagavān viṣṇuḥ śrāṃtaḥ saṃvignalocanaḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

38\. Viṣṇu, the Ātman of the universe, assumed the form of a Boar resembling a mass of collyrium and went downwards.

## \|\| 12.34.39 \|\|

*śrāṃtotyaṃtamadṛṣṭvāṃtaṃ pāpatādhaḥ pitāmahaḥ \| \|*  
*tathaiva bhagavān viṣṇuḥ śrāṃtaḥ saṃvignalocanaḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

39\. Thus hastening down for a thousand years he did not have even a glimpse of the root of Liṅga,

## \|\| 12.34.40 \|\|

*śrāṃtotyaṃtamadṛṣṭvāṃtaṃ pāpatādhaḥ pitāmahaḥ \| \|*  
*tathaiva bhagavān viṣṇuḥ śrāṃtaḥ saṃvignalocanaḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. Meanwhile, Brahmā too was going up to know his top. But unable to see the end he became exhausted and fell down.

## \|\| 12.34.41 \|\|

*śrāṃtotyaṃtamadṛṣṭvāṃtaṃ pāpatādhaḥ pitāmahaḥ \| \|*  
*tathaiva bhagavān viṣṇuḥ śrāṃtaḥ saṃvignalocanaḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

41\. Similarly the weary Viṣṇu with dejected mind due to the great distress quickly rose up from below.

## \|\| 12.34.42 \|\|

*śrāṃtotyaṃtamadṛṣṭvāṃtaṃ pāpatādhaḥ pitāmahaḥ \| \|*  
*tathaiva bhagavān viṣṇuḥ śrāṃtaḥ saṃvignalocanaḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

42\. When they met each other again they were completely perplexed and stared at each other with a smile of shame. Deluded by the Māyā of Śiva they did not know what to do or what not to do.

## \|\| 12.34.43 \|\|

*śrāṃtotyaṃtamadṛṣṭvāṃtaṃ pāpatādhaḥ pitāmahaḥ \| \|*  
*tathaiva bhagavān viṣṇuḥ śrāṃtaḥ saṃvignalocanaḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

43\. They stood in front, at the back and on cither side of it and bowed. They began to think “Of what nature is this?”

## Chapter 35 - The delusion of Viṣṇu and Brahmā (2)

## \|\| 12.35.1 \|\|

*upamanyuruvāca \|*  
*athāvirabhavattatra sanādaṃ śabdalakṣaṇam \|*  
*omityekākṣaraṃ brahma brahmaṇaḥ pratipādakam \|\| 1 \|\|*

Upamanyu said:—

1\. Then there manifested the single-syllabled Brahman in the characteristic way o \[?\] a word with its sound ‘Om’. It expressed the Brahman.

## \|\| 12.35.2 \|\|

*tadapyaviditaṃ tāvadbrahmaṇā viṣṇunā tathā \|*  
*rajasā tamasā cittaṃ tayoryasmāttiraskṛtam \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. That too was incomprehensible to Brahmā and Viṣṇu because their minds had been screened with Rajas and Tamas.

## \|\| 12.35.3 \|\|

*tadā vibhaktamabhavaccaturdhaikaṃ tadakṣaram \|*  
*a u meti trimātrābhiḥ parastāccārdhamātrayā \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. Then that syllable divided itself into four, the three Mātrās—A, U, Ma and half the Mātrā thereafter.

## \|\| 12.35.4 \|\|

*tatrākāraḥ śrito bhāge jvalalliṃgasya dakṣiṇe \|*  
*ukāraścottare tadvanmakārastasya madhyataḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. The letter ‘a’ attached itself to the southern side of the blazing Liṅga, the letter “u” to the north and the letter “ma” to its middle.

## \|\| 12.35.5-6 \|\|

*ardhamātrātmako nādaḥ śrūyate liṃgamūrdhani \|*  
*vibhakte 'pi tadā tasminpraṇave paramākṣare \|\| 5 \|\|*

*vibhāvārthaṃ ca tau devau na kiṃcidavajagmatuḥ \|*  
*vedātmanā tadāvyaktaḥ praṇavo vikṛtiṃ gataḥ \|\| 6 \|\|*

5-6. The half a Mātrā sound was heard on the head of the Liṅga. Even when the great syllable Praṇava was divided, the two gods did not understand the purpose of division. The unmanifest Praṇava then underwent the change into the Veda.

## \|\| 12.35.7 \|\|

*tatrākāro ṛgabhavadukāro yajuravyayaḥ \|*  
*makārassāma saṃjāto nādastvātharvaṇī śrutiḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. There the letter “a” became the Ṛgveda, the letter “u” the Yajurveda, the letter “ma” the Sāmaveda and the Nāda the Atharvaveda.

## \|\| 12.35.8-10 \|\|

*ṛgayaṃ sthāpayāmāsa samāsāttvarthamātmanaḥ \|*  
*rajoguṇeṣu brahmāṇaṃ mūrtiṣvādyaṃ kriyāsvapi \|\| 8 \|\|*

*sṛṣṭiṃ lokeṣu pṛthivīṃ tattveṣvātmānamavyayam \|*  
*kalādhvani nivṛttiṃ ca sadyaṃ brahmasu pañcasu \|\| 9 \|\|*

*liṃgabhāgeṣvadhobhāgaṃ bījākhyaṃ kāraṇatraye \|*  
*catuḥṣaṣṭiguṇaiśvaryaṃ bauddhaṃ yadaṇimādiṣu \|\| 10 \|\|*

8-10. The Ṛgveda established half of itself succinctly. Thus Brahmā possessed of the Rajas, the first among the deities in rites also, the creator of the worlds and the principles as well as the unchanging Ātman; Nivṛtti in the path of Kalā and Sadyojāta in the five Brahmans, the lower portion in the parts of Liṅga and the source in the three reasons. It established the sixty-four Guṇas and Aiśvarya of the cosmic intellect Aṇimā etc. Thus with the ten topics the universe was pervaded by the Ṛgveda.

## \|\| 12.35.11-13 \|\|

*taditthamarthairdaśabhirvyāptaṃ viśvamṛcā jagat \|*  
*athopasthāpayāmāsa svārthaṃ daśavidhaṃ yajuḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

*sattvaṃ guṇeṣu viṣṇuṃ ca mūrtiṣvādyaṃ kriyāsvapi \|*  
*sthitiṃ lokeṣvaṃtarikṣaṃ vidyāṃ tattveṣu ca triṣu \|\| 12 \|\|*

*kalādhvasu pratiṣṭhāṃ ca vāmaṃ brahmasu pañcasu \|*  
*madhyaṃ tu liṃgabhāgeṣu yoniṃ ca triṣu hetuṣu \|\| 13 \|\|*

11-13. Then the Yajurveda established itself in the ten ways: Sattva among the attributes, Viṣṇu the first among the deities in the rites also, sustenance in the worlds and the firmament, Vidyā in the three principles, Pratiṣṭhā in the paths of Kalā and Vāmadeva in the five Brahmans, the parts of Liṅga and Yoni in the three causes. The Prākṛta was established in accordance with the Aiśvarya. Hence the universe is of the form of the Yajurveda.

## \|\| 12.35.14-16 \|\|

*prākṛtaṃ ca yathaiśvaryaṃ tasmādviśvaṃ yajurmayam \|*  
*tatopasthāpayāmāsa sāmārthaṃ daśadhātmanaḥ \|\| 14 \|\|*

*tamoguṇeṣvatho rudraṃ mūrtiṣvādyaṃ kriyāsu ca \|*  
*saṃhṛtiṃ triṣu lokeṣu tattveṣu śivamuttamam \|\| 15 \|\|*

*vidyākalāsvaghoraṃ ca tathā brahmasu pañcasu \|*  
*liṃgabhāgeṣu pīṭhordhvaṃ bījinaṃ kāraṇatraye \|\| 16 \|\|*

14-16. Similarly the Sāmaveda established itself in ten ways. It established Tamas and Rudra the first among the deities in the rites, annihilation in the three worlds and the excellent Śiva in the Tattvas, Aghora in the five Brahmans and Vidyā among the Kalās, the upper seat in the parts of the Liṅga and the source in the three causes. So also the Aiśvarya of the Puruṣa. Thus the universe is pervaded by the Sāman.

## \|\| 12.35.17-20 \|\|

*pauruṣaṃ ca tathaiśvaryamitthaṃ sāmnā tataṃ jagat \|*  
*athātharvāha nairguṇyamarthaṃ prathamamātmanaḥ \|\| 17 \|\|*

*tato maheśvaraṃ sākṣānmūrtiṣvapi sadāśivam \|*  
*kriyāsu niṣkriyasyāpi śivasya paramātmanaḥ \|\| 18 \|\|*

*bhūtānugrahaṇaṃ caiva mucyaṃte yena jaṃtavaḥ \|*  
*lokeṣvapi yato vāco nivṛttā manasā saha \|\| 19 \|\|*

*tadūrdhvamunmanā lokātsomalokamalaukikam \|*  
*somassahomayā yatra nityaṃ nivasatīśvaraḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

17-20. Then the Atharvaveda established itself thus. It was devoid of Guṇas. It placed Maheśvara, Sadāśiva as the first among the deities. Though the great Ātman, Śiva is devoid of activities. It established Sadāśiva for the purpose of activities. It created pure blessing whereby the creatures are liberated. Above the worlds, where the words recede along with the mind are the Unmanā worlds over which is the divine Somaloka where the lord stays with Umā.

## \|\| 12.35.21-22 \|\|

*tadūrdhvamunmanā lokādyaṃ prāpto na nivartate \|*  
*śāṃtiṃ ca śāṃtyatītāṃ ca vyāpikāṃ cai kalāsvapi \|\| 21 \|\|*

*tatpūruṣaṃ tatheśānaṃ brahma brahmasu pañcasu \|*  
*mūrdhānamapi liṃgasya nādabhāgeṣvanuttamam \|\| 22 \|\|*

21-22. He who reaches above there in the Unmanā world does not return. Śānti and Śāntyatītā are all-pervasive among the Kalās. Among the five Brahmans it is Puruṣa and Īśāna. There is the head of the Liṅga, the most excellent among the parts, where the sole Niṣkala Śiva shall be invoked and propitiated.

## \|\| 12.35.23-33 \|\|

*yatrāvāhya samārādhyaḥ kevalo niṣkalaḥ śivaḥ \|*  
*tatteṣvapi tadā biṃdornādācchaktestataḥ parāt \|\| 23 \|\|*

*tattvādapi paraṃ tattvamatattvaṃ paramārthataḥ \|*  
*kāraṇeṣu trayātītānmāyāvikṣobhakāraṇāt \|\| 24 \|\|*

*anaṃtācchuddhavidyāyāḥ parastācca maheśvarāt \|*  
*sarvavidyeśvarādhīśānna parācca sadāśivāt \|\| 25 \|\|*

*sarvamaṃtratanordevācchaktitrayasamanvitāt \|*  
*pañcavaktrāddaśabhujātsākṣātsakalaniṣkalāt \|\| 26 \|\|*

*tasmādapi parādbiṃdorardhedośca tataḥ parāt \|*  
*tataḥ parānniśādhīśānnādākhyācca tataḥ parāt \|\| 27 \|\|*

*tataḥ parātsuṣumneśādbrahmaraṃdhreśvarādapi \|*  
*tataḥ parasmācchakteśca parastācchivatattvataḥ \|\| 28 \|\|*

*paramaṃ kāraṇaṃ sākṣātsvayaṃ niṣkāraṇaṃ śivam \|*  
*kāraṇānāṃ ca dhātāraṃ dhyātārāṃ dhyeyamavyayam \|\| 29 \|\|*

*paramākāśamadhyasthaṃ paramātmopari sthitaṃ \|*  
*sarvaiśvaryeṇa saṃpannaṃ sarveśvaramanīśvaram \|\| 30 \|\|*

*aiśvaryāccāpi māyeyādaśuddhānmānuṣādikāt \|*  
*aparācca parāttyājyādadhiśuddhādhvagocarāt \|\| 31 \|\|*

*tatparācchuddhavidyādyādunmanāṃtātparātparāt \|*  
*paramaṃ paramaiśvaryamunmanādyamanādi ca \|\| 32 \|\|*

*apāramaparādhīnaṃ nirastātiśayaṃ sthiram \|*  
*itthamarthairdaśavidhairiyamātharvaṇī śrutiḥ \|\| 33 \|\|*

23-33. Among the Tattvas it is the greater Tattva than Bindu, Nāda and Śakti. It is greater than the greatest and in reality a non-Tattva. It transcends the three causes. It is beyond Māyā the cause of agitation. It is beyond Ananta, the Śuddhavidyā, Maheśvara, Sadāśiva the great lord of all lores. It is beyond the lord who has mantras for his body, who is accompanied by all Śaktis, who has five faces and ten arms and who is both Sakala and Niṣkala. Beyond even that, beyond the Bindu, the half moon, the moon, the great Nāda, the lord of Suṣumṇā, the lord of Brahmarandhra beyond that, beyond Śakti and beyond the principle of Śiva the great cause there is lord Śiva who has no cause. He is the creator of causes, the subject and object of meditation and stationed in the middle of the great sky above the great Ātman. Equipped with prosperity and glory he is the lord of all. He has no overlord. He is beyond Aiśvarya due to Māyā, beyond humanity, beyond the big and small, beyond what is to be discarded, what is not to be discarded, beyond Śuddhavidyā, Unmanā, and the Aiśvarya of Unmanā. He is great and devoid of beginning, limitless and independent, stable and unsurpassable. Thus with ten such characteristics Atharvaveda is very weighty and so the universe is pervaded by it.

## \|\| 12.35.34-42 \|\|

*yasmādgarīyasī tasmādviśvaṃ vyāptamatharvaṇāt \|*  
*ṛgvedaḥ punarāhedaṃ jāgradrūpaṃ mayocyate \|\| 34 \|\|*

*yenāhamātmatattvasya nityamasmyabhidhāyakaḥ \|*  
*yajurvedo 'vadattadvatsvapnāvasthā mayocyate \|\| 35 \|\|*

*bhogyātmanā pariṇatā vidyāvedyā yato mayi \|*  
*sāma cāha suṣuptyākhyamevaṃ sarvaṃ mayocyate \|\| 36 \|\|*

*mamārthena śivenedaṃ tāmasenābhidhīyate \|*  
*atharvāha turāyākhyaṃ turīyātītameva ca \|\| 37 \|\|*

*mayābhidhīyate tasmādadhvātītapadosmyaham \|*  
*adhvātmakaṃ tu tritayaṃ śivavidyātmasaṃjñitam \|\| 38 \|\|*

*tattraiguṇyaṃ trayīsādhyaṃ saṃśodhyaṃ ca padaiṣiṇā \|*  
*adhvātītaṃ turīyākhyaṃ nirvāṇaṃ paramaṃ padam \|\| 39 \|\|*

*tadatītaṃ ca nairguṇyādadhvanosya viśodhakam \|*  
*dvayoḥ pramāpako nādo nadāṃtaśca madātmakaḥ \|\| 40 \|\|*

*tasmānmamārthasvātaṃtryātpradhānaḥ parameśvaraḥ \|*  
*yadasti vastu tatsarvaṃ guṇapradhānyayogataḥ \|\| 41 \|\|*

*samastaṃ vyastamapi ca praṇavārthaṃ pracakṣate \|*  
*savārthavācakaṃ tasmādekaṃ brahmaitadakṣaram \|\| 42 \|\|*

34-42. Ṛgveda said again—“The state of wakefulness is being mentioned by me whereby I perpetually express the Ātmatattva”. Yajurveda said—“The state of dream is being mentioned by me because the Vidyā that has transformed itself into objects of enjoyments is to be known through me.” Sāmaveda said:—“What is called sound slumber is being mentioned wholly by me through Śiva that is my meaning and Tāmasic in form”. Atharvaveda said:—“What is called the fourth stage and what is beyond the fourth is expressed by me.” The three which are of the nature of the path are termed Śiva, Vidyā, Ātman. Their state of three attributes is attainable through the Vedas and shall be purified by him who wishes for Śiva’s region. What is called Turīya, beyond the path is the greatest region of salvation. That which is beyond it is the purifier of this path because of its attributeless state. The Nāda is the measurer of both. The end of Nāda has me for its Ātman. Hence the supreme lord is the chief in view of freedom from my topics. Whatever object is there whether compounded or separated, they call as the meaning of Praṇava in view of the association of the Guṇas. Therefore, this single-syllabled Brahman is the expression of all meanings.

## \|\| 12.35.43 \|\|

*tenomiti jagatkṛtsnaṃ kurute prathamaṃ śivaḥ \|*  
*śivo hi praṇavo hyeṣa praṇavo hi śivaḥ smṛtaḥ \|\| 43 \|\|*

43\. Therefore, at the outset Śiva creates the universe saying “Om”. Śiva is Praṇava and Praṇava is Śiva.

## \|\| 12.35.44-46 \|\|

*vācyavācakayorbhedo nātyaṃtaṃ vidyate yataḥ \|*  
*ciṃtayā rahito rudro vācoyanmanasā saha \|\| 44 \|\|*

*aprāpya tannivartaṃte vācyastvekākṣareṇa saḥ \|*  
*ekākṣarādakārākhyādātmā brahmābhidhīyate \|\| 45 \|\|*

*ekākṣarādukārākhyāddvidhā viṣṇurudīryate \|*  
*ekākṣarānmakārākhyācchivo rudra udāhṛtaḥ \|\| 46 \|\|*

44-46. That is because there is not much of difference between that which is expressed and the expression. Rudra is devoid of thought. The words along with the mind recede without reaching him. He is that which is expressed by the single-syllabled Om. Letter “a” expresses Brahmā, the letter “u” Viṣṇu, the letter “ma” expresses Śiva.

## \|\| 12.35.47-50 \|\|

*dakṣiṇāṃgānmaheśasya jāto brahmātmasaṃjñikaḥ \|*  
*vāmāṃgādabhavadviṣṇustato vidyeti saṃjñitaḥ \|\| 47 \|\|*

*hṛdayānnīlarudro bhūcchivasya śivasaṃjñikaḥ \|*  
*sṛṣṭeḥ pravartako brahmā sthiterviṣṇurvimohakaḥ \|\| 48 \|\|*

*saṃhārasya tathā rudrastayornityaṃ niyāmakaḥ \|*  
*tasmāttrayaste kathyaṃte jagataḥ kāraṇāni ca \|\| 49 \|\|*

*kāraṇatrayahetuśca śivaḥ paramakāraṇam \|*  
*arthametamavijñāya rajasā baddhavairayoḥ \|\| 50 \|\|*

47-50. The deity Brahmātman is born of the right limb of Maheśa. Viṣṇu came out of the left. So he is termed Vidyā. Nīlarudra came out of the heart of Śiva and is called Śiva. Brahmā is the activiser of creation, Viṣṇu the enchanter maintains sustenance. Rudra who controls both is the initiator of annihilation. The three are the causes of the universe. Śiva, the source of the three, is the great cause.

## \|\| 12.35.51 \|\|

*yuvayoḥ pratibodhāya madhye liṃgamupasthitam \|*  
*evamomiti māṃ prāhuryadihoktamatharvaṇā \|\| 51 \|\|*

51\. The Liṅga stood in between you two in order to enlighten you when you became mutually inimical due to your Rājasic quality and could not understand this meaning.

## \|\| 12.35.52-53 \|\|

*ṛco yajūṃṣi sāmāni śākhāścānyāḥ sahasraśaḥ \|*  
*vedeṣvevaṃ svayaṃ vaktrairvyaktamityavadatsvapi \|\| 52 \|\|*

*svapnānubhūtamiva tattābhyāṃ nādhyavasīyate \|*  
*tayostatra prabodhāya tamopanayanāya ca \|\| 53 \|\|*

52-53. Thus they call me “Om”. What was thus mentioned by the Atharva was repeated by the Ṛgveda, Yajurveda, Sāmaveda and thousands of their Śākhās. Even when the Vedas themselves declared thus clearly through their own mouths it was not comprehended by the two who thought it were a dream.

## \|\| 12.35.54 \|\|

*liṃgepi mudritaṃ sarvaṃ yathā vedairudāhṛtam \|*  
*taddṛṣṭvā mudritaṃ liṃge prasādālliṃginastadā \|\| 54 \|\|*

54\. In order to enlighten them and to remove their ignorance the statement of the Vedas was inscribed in the Liṅga too.

## \|\| 12.35.55 \|\|

*praśāṃtamanasau devau prabuddhau saṃbabhūvatuḥ \|*  
*utpattiṃ vilayaṃ caiva yathātmyaṃ ca ṣaḍadhvanām \|\| 55 \|\|*

55\. On seeing that inscribed in the Liṅga due to the favour of Śiva the deities were pacified and enlightened.

## \|\| 12.35.56-61 \|\|

*tataḥ parataraṃ dhāma dhāmavaṃtaṃ ca pūruṣam \|*  
*niruttarataraṃ brahma niṣkalaṃ śivamīśvaram \|\| 56 \|\|*

*paśupāśamayasyāsya prapañcasya sadā patim \|*  
*akutobhayamatyaṃtamavṛddhikṣayamavyayam \|\| 57 \|\|*

*vāhyamābhyaṃtaraṃ vyāptaṃ vāhyābhyaṃtaravarjitam \|*  
*nirastātiśayaṃ śaśvadviśvalokavilakṣaṇam \|\| 58 \|\|*

*alakṣaṇamanirdeśyamavāṅmanasagocaram \|*  
*prakāśaikarasaṃ śāṃtaṃ prasannaṃ satatoditam \|\| 59 \|\|*

*sarvakalyāṇanilayaṃ śaktyā tādṛśayānvitam \|*  
*jñātvā devaṃ virūpākṣaṃ brahmanārāyaṇau tadā \|\| 60 \|\|*

*racayitvāṃjaliṃ mūrdhni bhītau tau vācamūcatuḥ \|*  
*brahmovāca \|*  
*ajño vāhamabhijño vā tvayādau deva nirmitaḥ \|\| 61 \|\|*

56-61. On realising the mode of evolution and dissolution, the nature of the six pathways and the splendour beyond the Puruṣa possessing brilliance, the Brahman than whom there is nothing greater, Niṣkala Śiva Īśvara, who is the perpetual lord of this universe consisting of Paśu and Pāśa who has no fear from any quarter, who is stable without increase or decrease who pervades within and without who has neither inside nor outside, who is unsurpassable, who is different from all the worlds, who is indefinable, incomprehensible, inexpressible, who is essentially in the form of brilliance, who is quite delighted and ever rising, who is the abode of auspiciousness and who is accompanied by a similar Śakti, Brahmā and Viṣṇu joined the palms in reverence above their heads and spoke thus in fright to the lord.

## \|\| 12.35.62 \|\|

*īdṛśīṃ bhrāṃtimāpanna iti ko 'trāparādhyati \|*  
*āstāṃ mamedamajñānaṃ tvayi sannihate prabho \|\| 62 \|\|*

Brahmā said:—

62\. Whether I am ignorant or not, O lord, I was created by you at the beginning. Whose fault is it that I have been under such a delusion?

## \|\| 12.35.63 \|\|

*nirbhayaḥ ko 'bhibhāṣeta kṛtyaṃ svasya parasya vā \|*  
*āvayordevadevasya vivādo 'pi hi śobhanaḥ \|\| 63 \|\|*

63\. Let my ignorance alone. O lord, when you are near who can fearlessly talk about his duly or that of others.

## \|\| 12.35.64 \|\|

*pādapraṇāmaphalado nāthasya bhavato yataḥ \|*  
*viṣṇuruvāca \|*  
*stotuṃ deva na vāgasti mahimnaḥ sadṛśī tava \|\| 64 \|\|*

64\. O lord of gods, our mutual wrangle too is splendidly auspicious since it has yielded us the benefit of paying our homage to the feet of the lord.

## \|\| 12.35.65 \|\|

*prabhoragre vidheyānāṃ tūṣṇīṃbhāvo vyatikramaḥ \|*  
*kimatra saṃghaṭetkṛtyamityevāvasarocitam \|\| 65 \|\|*

Viṣṇu said:—

65\. O lord, I do not have the power of eulogising you in the manner befitting your greatness. On the other hand if the devotees keep quiet in front of the lord it is merely a transgression of virtue.

## \|\| 12.35.66 \|\|

*ajānannapi yatkiṃcitpralapya tvāṃ nato 'smyaham \|*  
*kāraṇatvaṃ tvayā dattaṃ vismṛtaṃ tava māyayā \|\| 66 \|\|*

66\. What is proper to be achieved is the relevant point now. Without knowing anything I have blurted out something for which I pray to be excused.

## \|\| 12.35.67 \|\|

*mohito 'haṃkṛtaścāpi punarevāsmi śāsitaḥ \|*  
*vijñāpitaiḥ kiṃ bahubhirbhītosmi bhṛśamīśvara \|\| 67 \|\|*

67\. That you were the primordial cause we forgot due to your Māyā. I am deluded, puffed up and have hence been chastised by you.

## \|\| 12.35.68 \|\|

*yato 'hamaparicchedyaṃ tvāṃ paricchettumudyataḥ \|*  
*tvāmuśaṃti mahādevaṃ bhītānāmārtināśanam \|\| 68 \|\|*

68\. Of what avail is this submission? O lord, I am extremely afraid because I have endeavoured to determine your size when in fact you cannot be gauged.

## \|\| 12.35.69 \|\|

*ato vyatikramaṃ me 'dya kṣaṃtumarhasi śaṃkara \|*  
*iti vijñāpitastābhyāmīśvarābhyāṃ maheśvaraḥ \|\| 69 \|\|*

69\. O Śiva, they call you a great lord, the destroyer of the distress of the frightened. I entreat you to forgive my transgression thus.

## \|\| 12.35.70 \|\|

*prīto 'nugṛhya tau devau smitapūrvamabhāṣata \|*  
*īśvara uvāca \|*  
*vatsavatsa vidhe viṣṇo māyayā mama mohitau \|\| 70 \|\|*

70\. When thus implored lord Śiva became highly delighted. He blessed the two deities and spoke to them smilingly.

## \|\| 12.35.71 \|\|

*yuvāṃ prabhutve 'haṃkṛtya buddhavairo parasparam \|*  
*vivādaṃ yuddhaparyaṃtaṃ kṛtvā noparatau kila \|\| 71 \|\|*

Lord Śiva said:—

71\. Dear Brahmā, dear Viṣṇu, you had been deluded by my Māyā. You were proud of your lordship and became mutually inimical.

## \|\| 12.35.72 \|\|

*tataścchinnā prajāsṛṣṭirjagatkāraṇabhūtayoḥ \|*  
*ajñānamānaprabhavādvaimatyādyuvayorapi \|\| 72 \|\|*

72\. You did not cease even when the wrangle turned into an actual fight. Therefore the creative activity of you both, the cause of the universe, was broken in the middle.

## \|\| 12.35.73-74 \|\|

*tannivartayituṃ yuṣmaddarpamohau mayaiva tu \|*  
*evaṃ nivāritāvadyaliṃgāvirbhāvalīlayā \|\| 73 \|\|*

*tasmādbhūyo vivādaṃ ca vrīḍāṃ cotsṛjya kṛtsnaśaḥ \|*  
*yathāsvaṃ karma kuryātāṃ bhavaṃtau vītamatsarau \|\| 74 \|\|*

73-74. In order to turn you back from your mutual dissention arising from ignorance and arrogance and to dispel your delusion and pride I indulged in this sport of manifesting myself in the phallic idol. Hence eschew a recurrence of your dispute and forget the shame. Devoid of mutual rivalry you shall resume your respective duties.

## \|\| 12.35.75-77 \|\|

*purā mamājñayā sārdhaṃ samastajñānasaṃhitāḥ \|*  
*yuvābhyāṃ hi mayā dattā kāraṇatvaprasiddhaye \|\| 75 \|\|*

*maṃtraratnaṃ ca sūtrākhyaṃ pañcākṣaramayaṃ param \|*  
*mayopadiṣṭaṃ sarvaṃ tadyuvayoradya vismṛtam \|\| 76 \|\|*

*dadāmi ca punaḥ sarvaṃ yathāpūrvaṃ mamājñayā \|*  
*yato vinā yuvāṃ tena na kṣamau sṛṣṭirakṣaṇe \|\| 77 \|\|*

75-77. Formerly at my command the compendiums on knowledge were given to you in order to proclaim your causal nature. The jewel of Mantras consisting of five syllables has been imparted to you. But you forgot all this. I shall give you everything as before together with my behest since without that you cannot create or sustain.

## \|\| 12.35.78-80 \|\|

*evamuktvā mahādevo nārāyaṇapitāmahau \|*  
*maṃtrarājaṃ dadau tābhyāṃ jñānasaṃhitayā saha \|\| 78 \|\|*

*tau labdhvā mahatīṃ divyāmājñāṃ māheśvarīṃ parām \|*  
*mahārthaṃ maṃtraratnaṃ ca tathaiva sakalāḥ kalāḥ \|\| 79 \|\|*

*daṃḍavatpraṇatiṃ kṛtvā devadevasya pādayoḥ \|*  
*atiṣṭhatāṃ vītabhayāvānaṃdāstimitau tadā \|\| 80 \|\|*

78-80. After telling Viṣṇu and Brahmā thus, the lord gave them the principal mantra along with the Jñānasaṃhitā. After obtaining the divine order of the lord, the jewel of Mantra pregnant with meaning, and the Kalās, they prostrated at the feet of the lord. They stood without fear. They were overpowered by joy.

## \|\| 12.35.81-83 \|\|

*etasminnaṃtare citramiṃdrajālavadaiśvaram \|*  
*liṃgaṃ kvāpi tirobhūtaṃ na tābhyāmupalabhyate \|\| 81 \|\|*

*tato vilapya hāheti sadyaḥpraṇayabhaṃgataḥ \|*  
*kimasatyamidaṃ vṛttamiti coktvā parasparam \|\| 82 \|\|*

*aciṃtyavaibhavaṃ śaṃbhorviciṃtya ca gatavyathau \|*  
*abhyupetya parāṃ maitrīmāliṃgya ca parasparam \|\| 83 \|\|*

81-83. In the meantime there was a great wonder. As if by magic the Liṅga of the god became invisible. Due to the sudden snapping of love they lamented and cried loudly, saying to each other ‘O what a false thing has befallen us, Pondering over the unimaginable prowess of Śiva they became free from pain.

## \|\| 12.35.84 \|\|

*jagadvyāpāramuddiśya jagmaturdevapuṃgavau \|*  
*tataḥ prabhṛti śakrādyāḥ sarva eva surāsurāḥ \|\| 84 \|\|*

84\. Becoming great friends once again and embracing each other the leading deities returned to their duties in the universe.

## \|\| 12.35.85 \|\|

*ṛṣayaśca narā nāgā nāryaścāpi vidhānataḥ \|*  
*liṃgapratiṣṭhā kurvaṃti liṃge taṃ pūjayaṃti ca \|\| 85 \|\|*

85\. Ever since that Indra and other gods, Asuras, sages, men, serpents as well as women install Liṅgas in accordance with the injunctions and worship him in the Liṅga.

## Chapter 36 - Installation of Śiva

## \|\| 12.36.1 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*bhagavañchrotumicchāmi pratiṣṭhāvidhimuttamam \|*  
*liṃgasyāpi ca berasya śivena vihitaṃ yathā \|\| 1 \|\|*

Sri Kṛṣṇa said:—

1\. O lord, I wish to hear the rules governing the installation of the phallic and the embodied image of Śiva.

## \|\| 12.36.2 \|\|

*upamanyuruvāca \|*  
*anātmapratikūle tu divase śuklapakṣake \|*  
*śivaśāstroktamārgeṇa kuryālliṃgaṃ pramāṇavat \|\| 2 \|\|*

Upamanyu said:—

2\. On a day in the bright half of the month not unfavourable to him, the devotee shall make the Liṅga of the proper size in the manner prescribed in the Śaivite scriptures.

## \|\| 12.36.3 \|\|

*svīkṛtyātha śubhasthānaṃ bhūparīkṣāṃ vidhāya ca \|*  
*daśopacārānkurvīta lakṣaṇoddhārapūrvakān \|\| 3 \|\|*

3\. Selecting an auspicious spot he shall test the ground. He shall perform the ten forms of service.

## \|\| 12.36.4 \|\|

*teṣāṃ daśopacārāṇāṃ pūrvaṃ pūjya 1 vināyakam \|*  
*sthānaśuddhyādikaṃ kṛtvāliṃgaṃ snānālayaṃ nayet \|\| 4 \|\|*

4\. But before the actual performance of this service Vināyaka shall be worshipped. After purifying the spot and other rites he shall take the Liṅga to the ablution chamber.

## \|\| 12.36.5 \|\|

*śalākayā kāṃcanayā 2 kuṃkumādirasāktayā \|*  
*lakṣitaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ śilpaśāstreṇa vilikhettataḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

5\. With a gold rod dipped into the solution of saffron he shall draw the characteristic signs in the prescribed manner.

## \|\| 12.36.6 \|\|

*aṣṭamṛtsalilairvātha pañcamṛtsalilaistathā \|*  
*liṅgaṃ piṃḍikayā sārdhaṃ pañcagavyaiśca śodhayet \|\| 6 \|\|*

6\. He shall purify the Liṅga along with its axle or nave with a solution of eight or five types of clay as well as with Pañcagavya.

## \|\| 12.36.7 \|\|

*savedikaṃ samabhyarcya divyādyaṃ tu jalāśayam \|*  
*nītvādhivāsayettatra liṃgaṃ piṃḍikayā saha \|\| 7 \|\|*

7\. After worshipping the Liṅga along with its pedestal he shall take it to the water-receptacle and keep the Liṅga immersed in water.

## \|\| 12.36.8-14 \|\|

*adhivāsālaye śuddhe sarvaśobhāsamanvite \|*  
*satoraṇe sāvaraṇe darbhamālāsamāvṛte \|\| 8 \|\|*

*diggajāṣṭakasaṃpanne dikpālāṣṭaghaṭānvite \|*  
*aṣṭamaṃgalakairyukte kṛtadikpālakārcite \|\| 9 \|\|*

*tejasaṃ dāravaṃ vāpi kṛtvā padmāsanāṃkitam \|*  
*vinyasenmadhyatastatra vipulaṃ pīṭhakālayam \|\| 10 \|\|*

*dvārapālānsamabhyarcya bhadrādīṃścaturaḥkramāt \|*  
*samudraśca vibhadraśca sunaṃdaśca vinaṃdakaḥ \|\| 11 \|\|*

*snāpayitvā samabhyarcya liṃgaṃ vedikayā saha \|*  
*sakūrcābhyāṃ tu vastrābhyāṃ samāveṣṭyaṃ samaṃtataḥ \|\| 12 \|\|*

*prāpayya śanakaistoyaṃ pīṭhikopari śāyayet \|*  
*prākśiraskamadhaḥsūtraṃ piṃḍikāṃ cāsya paścime \|\| 13 \|\|*

*sarvamaṃgalasaṃyuktaṃ liṃgaṃ tatrādhivāsayet \|*  
*pañcarātraṃ trirātraṃ vāpyekarātramathāpi vā \|\| 14 \|\|*

8-14. In a well-constructed shed for the immersion of Liṅga, pure and well-embellished with festoons and screens all round, surrounded by garlands of Darbha grass, an inner shed for the seat shall be arranged in the middle. The seat may be metallic or wooden in the shape of a lotus. On the eight quarters the representations of the eight elephants of the quarters shall be made. Eight pots shall be kept for the eight guardians of the quarters. Eight auspicious things shall be kept ready. The guardians of the quarters shall be duly worshipped. Subhadra, Vibhadra, Sunanda and Vinanda the gatekeepers of the lord shall be worshipped in the four quarters. The Liṅga shall be bathed and worshipped with the pedestal. It shall be tied with two cloths and bunches of Kuśa grass. Ii shall be brought to the Pīṭha and laid over it immersed in water. The head of the Liṅga shall be put to the east and the threads shall be put below, the nave to the west of it. The Liṅga shall be kept in water for one, three or five nights.

## \|\| 12.36.15 \|\|

*visṛjya pūjitaṃ tatra śodhayitvā ca pūrvavat \|*  
*saṃpūjyotsavamārgeṇa śayanālayamānayet \|\| 15 \|\|*

15\. Thereafter the liṅga shall be worshipped after due ceremonies as before. After worship it shall be carried along the path of festivities to the place of rest.

## \|\| 12.36.16 \|\|

*tatrāpi śayanasthānaṃ kuryānmaṃḍalamadhyataḥ \|*  
*śuddhairjalaiḥ snāpayitvā liṃgamabhyarcayetkramāt \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. A resting place shall be made in the middle of the Maṇḍala. After bathing the liṅga with pure water he shall worship it.

## \|\| 12.36.17 \|\|

*aiśānyāṃ padmamālikhya śuddhalipte mahītale \|*  
*śivakuṃbhaṃ śodhayitvā tatrāvāhya śivaṃ yajet \|\| 17 \|\|*

17\. A mystical lotus-diagram shall be drawn in the north-east on a spot of ground well-smeared. The water vessel of Śiva shall be purified. Śiva shall be invoked and worshipped.

## \|\| 12.36.18 \|\|

*vedīmadhye sitaṃ padmaṃ parikalpya vidhānataḥ \|*  
*tasya paścimataścāpi caṃḍikāpadmamālikhet \|\| 18 \|\|*

18\. In the middle of the altar he shall make a diagram of white lotus in accordance with injunctions and to the west of it he shall draw the lotus of Caṇḍikā.

## \|\| 12.36.19 \|\|

*kṣaumādyairvāhatairvastraiḥ puṣpairdarbhairathāpi vā \|*  
*prakalpya śayanaṃ tasminhemapuṣpaṃ vinikṣipet \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. The bed shall be made of silken cloth or other cloth fresh from the loom, before being washed or of flowers or Darbha grass. After making it up he shall put golden flower in it.

## \|\| 12.36.20-22 \|\|

*tatra liṃgaṃ samānīya sarvamaṃgalaniḥsvanaiḥ \|*  
*raktena vastrayugmena sakūrcena samaṃtataḥ \|\| 20 \|\|*

*saha piṃḍikayāveṣṭya śāyayecca yathā purā \|*  
*purastātpadmamālikhya taddaleṣu yathākramam \|\| 21 \|\|*

*vidyeśakalaśānnyasyenmadhye śaivīṃ ca vardhanīm \|*  
*parītya padmatritayaṃ juhuyurdvijasattamāḥ \|\| 22 \|\|*

20-22. The Liṅga shall be brought there with the songs and music vocal and instrumental. It shall be wrapped in two red cloths and a bunch of Kuśa grass along with the nave and laid down as before. A lotus shall be drawn in front and in its petals he shall place the water-pots of Vidyeśa and the vessel Vardhanī of Śiva. The excellent brahmins shall perform Homa all round the three lotuses.

## \|\| 12.36.23-25 \|\|

*te cāṣṭamūrtayaḥ kalpyāḥ pūrvādiparitaḥ sthitāḥ \|*  
*catvāraścātha vā dikṣu svadhyetārassajāpakāḥ \|\| 23 \|\|*

*juhuyuste viraṃcyādyāścatasro mūrtayaḥ smṛtāḥ \|*  
*daiśikaḥ prathamaṃ teṣāmaiśānyāṃ paścime 'tha vā \|\| 24 \|\|*

*pradhānahomaṃ kurvīta saptadravyairyathākramam \|*  
*ācāryātpādamardhaṃ vā juhuyuścāpare dvijāḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

23-25. Beginning with the east, the eight Mūrtis shall be placed all round or only the four Mūrtis Brahmā and others in the four quarters. The conductors of the Homa shall possess good mastery of the Vedas. They shall be accompanied by those who can repeat the mantras well. The preceptor shall perform the main Homa either in the north-east or in the west. He shall use all the seven materials in order. The other brahmins shall perform half or one-fourth of the number of sacrifices that the preceptor performs.

## \|\| 12.36.26-28 \|\|

*pradhānamekamevātra juhuyādatha vā guruḥ \|*  
*pūrvaṃ pūrṇāhutiṃ hutvā ghṛtenāṣṭottaraṃ śatam \|\| 26 \|\|*

*mūrdhni mūlena liṃgasya śivahastaṃ pravinyaset \|*  
*śatamardhaṃ tadardhaṃ vā kramāddravyaiśca saptabhiḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

*hutvāhutvā spṛśelliṃgaṃ vedikāṃ ca punaḥ punaḥ \|*  
*pūrṇāhutiṃ tato hutvā kramāddadyācca dakṣiṇām \|\| 28 \|\|*

26-28. Or the preceptor alone shall perform the main sacrifice. He shall perform the Pūrṇāhuti and then another set of hundred and eight Horn as with ghee. He shall place his hand ritualistically on the top of the Liṅga repeating the basic mantra. After each Homa he shall touch both the Liṅga and the pedestal. On the whole a hundred or a fifty or twenty five Homas shall be performed with the seven materials of worship. He shall perform the Pūrṇāhuti and give Dakṣiṇā.

## \|\| 12.36.29 \|\|

*ācāryātpādamardhaṃ vā hotḥṇāṃ sthapaterapi \|*  
*tadardhaṃ deyamanyebhyaḥ sadasyebhyaśca śaktitaḥ \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. The priest and the sculptor shall be given half or one-fourth of what the preceptor is given and half of that shall be given to the other brahmins in accordance with one’s capacity.

## \|\| 12.36.30-32 \|\|

*tataḥ śvabhre vṛṣaṃ haimaṃ kūrcaṃ vāpi niveśya ca \|*  
*mṛdaṃbhasā pañcagavyaiḥ punaḥ śuddhajalena ca \|\| 30 \|\|*

*śodhitāṃ caṃdanāliptāṃ śvabhre brahmaśilāṃ kṣipet \|*  
*karanyāsaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā navabhiḥ śaktināmabhiḥ \|\| 31 \|\|*

*haritālādidhātūṃśca bījagaṃdhauṣadhairapi \|*  
*śivaśāstroktavidhinā kṣipedbrahmaśilopari \|\| 32 \|\|*

30-32. Then either an image of the bull made of gold or a bunch of Kuśa grass shall be placed in the pit. Brahmaśilā shall be purified with water and clay, also with Pañca-gavya, with pure water. It shall be placed in the pit after smearing it with sandal. Repeating the names of the nine Śaktis, the rite of Karanyāsa shall be performed. Then in accordance with the injunctions prescribed in Śaivite scriptures he shall strew the minerals—Haritāla and others along with scents, seeds and medicinal herbs.

## \|\| 12.36.33-35 \|\|

*pratiliṃgaṃ tu saṃsthāpya kṣīraṃ vṛkṣasamudbhavam \|*  
*sthitaṃ buddhvā tadutsṛjya liṃgaṃ brahmaśilopari \|\| 33 \|\|*

*prāgudakpravarāṃ kiṃcitsthāpayenmūlavidyayā \|*  
*piṃḍikāṃ cātha saṃyojya śāktaṃ mūlamanusmaran \|\| 34 \|\|*

*bandhanaṃ baṃdhakadravyaiḥ kṛtvā sthānaṃ viśodhya ca \|*  
*dattvā cārghyaṃ ca puṣpāṇi kuryuryavanikāṃ punaḥ \|\| 35 \|\|*

33-35. The Liṅga shall be installed on the Bralimaśilā and dripped in the exudations of trees. To the east and the north the aloe wood shall be placed repeating the basic mantra. Repeating the basic mantra of Śakti the nave shall be joined to the articles of fixation and joining. The place shall be purified. Arghya shall he given and flowers offered. Thereafter the screen shall be drawn all round.

## \|\| 12.36.36 \|\|

*yathāyogyaṃ niṣekādi liṃgasya puratastadā \|*  
*ānīya śayanasthānātkalaśānvinyasetkramāt \|\| 36 \|\|*

36\. The ablution and other rites of the Liṅga shall be performed in a befitting manner. After taking it away from the place of rest the Kalaśas shall be placed in order.

## \|\| 12.36.37-39 \|\|

*mahāpūjāmathārabhya saṃpūjya kalaśāndaśa \|*  
*śivamaṃtramanusmṛtya śivakuṃbhajalāṃtare \|\| 37 \|\|*

*aṃguṣṭhānāmikāyogādādāya tamudīrayet \|*  
*nyasedīśānabhāgasya madhye liṃgasya maṃtravit \|\| 38 \|\|*

*śaktiṃ nyasettathā vidyāṃ vidyeśāṃśca yathākramam \|*  
*liṅgamūle śivajalaistato liṃgaṃ niṣecayet \|\| 39 \|\|*

37-39. The great worship begins with the worship of the ten water-jars. In the water inside the Śivakumbha, the thumb and the ring-finger shall be jointly inserted with the Śiva mantras. Water thus taken shall be sprinkled. The knower of mantra shall touch the north-east side of the Liṅga. He shall perform the Nyāsas of Śakti, Vidyā and Vidyeśas in order at the root of the Liṅga. He shall perform the ablution of the Liṅga with auspicious water.

## \|\| 12.36.40 \|\|

*vardhanyāṃ piṃḍikāliṃgaṃ vidyeśakalaśaiḥ punaḥ \|*  
*abhiṣicyāsanaṃ paścādādhārādyaṃ prakalpayet \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. The nave and the Liṅga shall be bathed with the water of Vardhanī and Videcśa Kalaśas. The seats, supports etc. shall be arranged.

## \|\| 12.36.41 \|\|

*kṛtvā pañcakalānyāsaṃ dīptaṃ liṃgamanusmaret \|*  
*āvāhayecchivau sākṣātprāñjaliḥ prāgudaṅmukhaḥ \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. After performing the Nyāsa rite of the five Kalās he shall meditate on the blazing Liṅga. Facing the east or north with palms joined in reverence he shall invoke Śiva and Śivā.

## \|\| 12.36.42-44 \|\|

*vṛṣādhirājamāruhya vimānaṃ vā nabhastalāt \|*  
*alaṃkṛtaṃ sahāyāṃtaṃ devyā devamanusmaran \|*

*sarvābharaṇaśobhāḍhyaṃ sarvamaṃgalanisvanaiḥ \|*  
*brahmaviṣṇumaheśārkaśakrādyairdevadānavaiḥ \|\| 42 \|\|*

*ānaṃdaklinnasarvāṃgairvinyastāṃjalimastakaiḥ \|*  
*stuvadbhireva nṛtyadbhirnāmadbhirabhito vṛtam \|\| 43 \|\|*

*tataḥ pañcopacārāṃśca kṛtvā pūjāṃ samāpayet \|*  
*nātaḥ parataraḥ kaścidvidhiḥ pañcopacārakāt \|\| 44 \|\|*

42-44. He shall conceive the lord arriving with the goddess, seated on the lordly bull or in an aerial chariot. He shall be conceived as fully bedecked in shining ornaments. He is surrounded on all sides by Brahmā, Viṣṇu, Maheśa, sun-god, Indra, other gods and the dānavas with their body drenched in the tears of delight with palms joined in reverence above the heads. They are eulogising, dancing and bowing. Then with the five services the worship shall be concluded.

## \|\| 12.36.45 \|\|

*pratiṣṭhāṃ liṃgavatkuryātpratimāsvapi sarvataḥ \|*  
*lakṣaṇoddhārasamaye kāryaṃ nayanamocanam \|\| 45 \|\|*

45\. There is no further rite after the five reverential services. The installation of idols is wholly identical with that of the Liṅga.

## \|\| 12.36.46 \|\|

*jalādhivāse śayane śāyayettāntvadhomukhīm \|*  
*kumbhodaśāyitāṃ maṃtrairhṛdi tāṃ sanniyojayet \|\| 46 \|\|*

46\. At the rite of Lakṣaṇoddhāra the eyes shall be shut. The immersion shall be performed with the idols placed prone on the bed.

## \|\| 12.36.47 \|\|

*kṛtālayāṃ parāmāhuḥ pratiṣṭhāmakṛtālayāt \|*  
*śaktaḥ kṛtālayaḥ paścātpratiṣṭhāvidhimācaret \|\| 47 \|\|*

47\. The installation of the idol with the rites for the temple is better than without those rites. If the idols are immersed in the water of the vessel the mantras shall be repeated touching the chest.

## \|\| 12.36.48-49 \|\|

*aśaktaścetpratiṣṭhāpya liṃgaṃ beramathāpi vā \|*  
*śakteranuguṇaṃ paścātprakurvīta śivālayam \|\| 48 \|\|*

*gṛhārcāṃ ca punarvakṣye pratiṣṭhāvidhimuttamam \|*  
*kṛtvā kanīyasaṃberaṃ liṃgaṃ vā lakṣaṇānvitam \|\| 49 \|\|*

48-49. Affluent people shall first build the temple and then perform the installation. If the devotee is not affluent he shall perform the installation of the phallic or the embodied image and shall afterwards build the Śiva temple in accordance with his capacity. Now I shall mention the mode of worship at the house and the excellent installation rite.

## \|\| 12.36.50-53 \|\|

*ayane cottare prāpte śuklapakśe śubhe dine \|*  
*devīṃ kṛtvā śubhe deśe tatrābjaṃ pūrvavallikhet \|\| 50 \|\|*

*vikīrya patrapuṣpādyairmadhye kuṃbhaṃ nidhāya ca \|*  
*paritastasya caturaḥ kalaśān dikṣu vinyaset \|\| 51 \|\|*

*pañca brahmāṇi tadbījaisteṣu pañcasu pañcabhiḥ \|*  
*nyasya saṃpūjya mudrādi darśayitvābhirakṣya ca \|\| 52 \|\|*

*viśodhya liṃgaṃ beraṃ vā mṛttoyādyairyathā purā \|*  
*sthāpayetpuṣpasaṃchannamuttarasthe varāsane \|\| 53 \|\|*

50-53. The idol shall be small in size but endowed with all traits. In the northern transit of the sun (Jan-July) on an auspicious day in the bright half of the month, the altar shall be made in an auspicious spot. He shall draw the diagram of the lotus in as before. The idol shall be purified with writer and clay as before. An auspicious scat shall be kept in the north. Covering the Liṅga with flowers he shall place it on the seat. Flowers and leaves shall be strewn and the vessel placed in the middle. Four vessels shall be placed all round. In those five vessels the five Brahmans are ritualistically fixed. After worship Mudrās shall be shown and the Rakṣā mantra repeated.

## \|\| 12.36.54-55 \|\|

*nidhāya puṣpaṃ śirasi prokṣayetprokṣaṇījalaiḥ \|*  
*samabhyarcya punaḥ puṣpairjayaśabdādipūrvakam \|\| 54 \|\|*

*kumbhairīśānavidyāṃtaiḥ snāpayenmūlavidyayā \|*  
*tataḥ pañcakalānyāsaṃ kṛtvā pūjāṃ ca pūrvavat \|\| 55 \|\|*

54-55. After placing the flower on its top it shall be sprinkled with the water from the Prokṣaṇī vessel. Again it shall be worshipped along with the proclamation of victory. With the water from the vessels of the four deities from Īśāna to Vidyā he shall bathe the Liṅga with the basic mantra.

## \|\| 12.36.56 \|\|

*nityamārādhayettatra devyā devaṃ trilocanam \|*  
*ekamevātha vā kuṃbhaṃ mūrtimantrasamanvitam \|\| 56 \|\|*

56\. The rite of the Nyāsa of the five Kalās shall be performed and the worship too as before. The devotee shall worship the lord and the goddess there everyday.

## \|\| 12.36.57 \|\|

*nyasya padmāṃtare sarvaṃ śeṣaṃ pūrvavadācaret \|*  
*atyaṃtopahataṃ liṃgaṃ viśodhya sthāpayetpunaḥ \|\| 57 \|\|*

57\. Or only one vessel shall be placed with the basic mantra and everything fixed therein. Every other rite shall be performed as before.

## \|\| 12.36.58 \|\|

*saṃprokṣayedupahatamanāgupahataṃ yajet \|*  
*liṃgāni bāṇasaṃjñāni sthāpanīyāni vā na vā \|\| 58 \|\|*

58\. Too much unclean Liṅga shall at first be purified and reinstalled. Unclean Liṅgas shall be sprinkled with holy water. Slightly unclean Liṅgas too shall be worshipped.

## \|\| 12.36.59 \|\|

*tāni pūrvaṃ śivenaiva saṃskṛtāni yatastataḥ \|*  
*śeṣāṇi sthāpanīyāni yāni dṛṣṭāni bāṇavat \|\| 59 \|\|*

59\. Bāṇa Liṅgas may be installed at will, for they have been already consecrated by Śiva himself.

## \|\| 12.36.60-61 \|\|

*svayamudbhūtaliṃge ca divye cārṣe tathaiva ca \|*  
*apīṭhe pīṭhamāveśya kṛtvā saṃprokṣaṇaṃ vidhim \|\| 60 \|\|*

*yajettatra śivaṃ teṣāṃ pratiṣṭhā na vidhīyate \|*  
*dagdhaṃ ślathaṃ kṣatāṃgaṃ ca kṣipelliṃgaṃ jalāśaye \|\| 61 \|\|*

60-61. Such other Liṅgas may also be installed. In regard to a Svayambhū, a divine or a sage Liṅga the same is the procedure. If there is no pedestal, a pedestal shall be assigned and the rite of Prokṣaṇa performed.

## \|\| 12.36.62 \|\|

*saṃdhānayogyaṃ saṃdhāya pratiṣṭhāvidhimācaret \|*  
*berādvā vikalālliṃgāddevapūjāpurassaram \|\| 62 \|\|*

62\. Burnt, weakened or partially broken Liṅga shall be thrown in a pond or a river. That which can be joined shall be joined and installed.

## \|\| 12.36.63 \|\|

*udvāsya hṛdi saṃdhānaṃ tyāgaṃ vā yuktamācaret \|*  
*ekāhapūjāvihatau kuryāddviguṇamarcanam \|\| 63 \|\|*

63\. The lord shall be dismissed ritualistically from the idol that is mutilated, after due worship but retained in the heart.

## \|\| 12.36.64 \|\|

*dvirātre ca mahāpūjāṃ saṃprokṣaṇamataḥ param \|*  
*māsādūrdhvamanekāhaṃ pūjā yadi vihanyate \|\| 64 \|\|*

64\. If the worship is in default for one day it shall be doubled, if in default for two days, great worship shall be performed. Samprokṣaṇa rite shall be performed thereafter.

## \|\| 12.36.65 \|\|

*pratiṣṭhā procyate kaiścitkaiścitsaṃprokṣaṇakramaḥ \|*  
*saṃprokṣaṇe tu liṃgāderdevamudvāsya pūrvavat \|\| 65 \|\|*

65\. If there is default in worship for about a month, or for more days, some advocate reinstallation. But others say that the Samprokṣaṇa rite alone is enough.

## \|\| 12.36.66-67 \|\|

*aṣṭapañcakrameṇaiva snāpayitvā mṛdaṃbhasā \|*  
*gavāṃ rasaiśca saṃsnāpya darbhatoyairviśodhya ca \|\| 66 \|\|*

*prokṣayetprokṣaṇītoyairmūlenāṣṭottaraṃ śatam \|*  
*sapuṣpaṃ sakuśaṃ pāṇiṃ nyasya liṃgasya mastake \|\| 67 \|\|*

66-67. Samprokṣaṇa rite is as follows:—The lord is ritualistically dismissed from the Liṅga as before, bathed with clay of eight or five types, water, Pañcagavya and purified with water from Darbha grass and sprinkled with water from the Prokṣaṇī vessel, one hundred and eight times with the basic mantra.

## \|\| 12.36.68 \|\|

*pañcavāraṃ japenmūlamaṣṭottaraśataṃ tataḥ \|*  
*tato mūlena mūrdhādipīṭhāṃtaṃ saṃspṛśedapi \|\| 68 \|\|*

68\. Holding flowers and Darbha, the hand shall be placed on the top of the Liṅga five times and the basic mantra shall be repeated hundred and eight times.

## \|\| 12.36.69 \|\|

*pūjāṃ ca mahatīṃ kuryāddevamāvāhya pūrvavat \|*  
*alabdhe sthāpite liṃge śivasthāne jale 'tha vā \|\| 69 \|\|*

69\. Beginning from the head and ending with the pedestal, the Liṅga shall be touched repeating the basic mantra. The great worship shall be performed after invoking the lord as before.

## \|\| 12.36.70 \|\|

*vahnau ravau tathā vyomni bhagavaṃtaṃ śivaṃ yajet \|\| 70 \|\|*

70\. If an installed Liṅga is not available, he shall worship the lord in a place sacred to Śiva, or in water, fire, the sun or the sky.

## Chapter 37 - The Goal of Yoga

## \|\| 12.37.1 \|\|

*śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca \|*  
*jñāne kriyāyāṃ caryāyāṃ sāramuddhṛtya saṃgrahāt \|*  
*uktaṃ bhagavatā sarvaṃ śrutaṃ śrutisamaṃ mayā \|\| 1 \|\|*

Sri Kṛṣṇa said:—

1\. Everything mentioned succinctly by your holiness with regard to knowledge, rites and activities, after taking out the essence, has been heard by me. It is as sacred as the Vedas.

## \|\| 12.37.2 \|\|

*idānīṃ śrotumicchāmi yogaṃ paramadurlabham \|*  
*sādhikāraṃ ca sāṃgaṃ ca savidhiṃ saprayojanam \|\| 2 \|\|*

2\. Now I wish to hear about Yoga which is very difficult to achieve along with its authorisation, ancillaries, injunctions and purpose.

## \|\| 12.37.3-4 \|\|

*yadyasti maraṇaṃ pūrvaṃ yogādyanupamardataḥ \|*  
*sadyaḥ sādhayituṃ śakyaṃ yena syānnātmahā naraḥ \|\| 3 \|\|*

*tacca tatkāraṇaṃ caiva tatkālakaraṇāni ca \|*  
*tadbhedatāratamyaṃ ca vaktumarhasi tattvataḥ \|\| 4 \|\|*

3-4. If death were to overtake before, it can be averted without resorting to the practices of penance, by taking recourse to Yoga whereby the man avoids becoming a self-killer. Hence it behoves you to mention factually the different types of Yoga and their relative importance, cause, time and procedure.

## \|\| 12.37.5 \|\|

*upamanyuruvāca \|*  
*sthāne pṛṣṭaṃ tvayā kṛṣṇa sarvapraśnārthavedinā \|*  
*tataḥ krameṇa tatsarvaṃ vakṣye śṛṇu samāhitaḥ \|\| 5 \|\|*

Upamanyu said:—

5\. O Kṛṣṇa, the question has been pertinently put by you who understand the meaning of all questions. Hence I shall mention everything in order. Listen attentively.

## \|\| 12.37.6-7 \|\|

*niruddhavṛttyaṃtarasyaṃ śive cittasya niścalā \|*  
*yā vṛttiḥ sa samāsena yogaḥ sa khalu pañcadhā \|\| 6 \|\|*

*maṃtrayogaḥsparśayogo bhāvayogastathāparaḥ \|*  
*abhāvayogassarvebhyo mahāyogaḥ paro mataḥ \|\| 7 \|\|*

6-7. All other activities are restrained and the mind kept steady in Śiva. This is succinctly called Yoga. It is of five types: Mantrayoga, Sparśayoga, Bhāvayoga, Abhāvayoga and Mahāyoga which is greater than everything.

## \|\| 12.37.8 \|\|

*maṃtrābhyāsavaśenaiva maṃtravācyārthagocaraḥ \|*  
*avyākṣepā manovṛttirmaṃtrayoga udāhṛtaḥ \|\| 8 \|\|*

8\. The concentration of the mind without disturbances, on the expressed meaning of the mantra along with the practice of the mantra is mantrayoga.

## \|\| 12.37.9 \|\|

*prāṇāyāmamukhā saiva sparśe yogobhidhīyate \|*  
*sa maṃtrasparśanirmukto bhāvayogaḥ prakīrtitaḥ \|\| 9 \|\|*

9\. Coupled with Prāṇāyāma the same is called sparśayoga. Without the contact of Mantra, it is Bhāvayoga.

## \|\| 12.37.10 \|\|

*vilīnāvayavaṃ viśvaṃ rūpaṃ saṃbhāvyate yataḥ \|*  
*abhāvayogaḥ saṃprokto 'nābhāsādvastunaḥ sataḥ \|\| 10 \|\|*

10\. Wherein the universe with all its parts is meditated upon it is called Abhāvayoga since in that the existent object is not seen.

## \|\| 12.37.11 \|\|

*śivasvabhāva evaikaściṃtyate nirupādhikaḥ \|*  
*yathā śaivamanovṛttirmahāyoga ihocyate \|\| 11 \|\|*

11\. Wherein the nature of Śiva is contemplated without any conditioning or restricting factor, the concentration of the mind on Śiva is called Mahāyoga.

## \|\| 12.37.12 \|\|

*dṛṣṭe tathānuśravike viraktaṃ viṣaye manaḥ \|*  
*yasya tasyādhikārosti yoge nānyasya kasyacit \|\| 12 \|\|*

12\. In this Yoga only he is authorised whose mind is detached from the perceived and Veda-ordained objects of pleasure.

## \|\| 12.37.13 \|\|

*viṣayadvayadoṣāṇāṃ guṇānāmīśvarasya ca \|*  
*darśanādeva satataṃ viraktaṃ jāyate manaḥ \|\| 13 \|\|*

13\. The mind is detached only on perceiving the defects in the objects and in the attributes of the lord, perpetually.

## \|\| 12.37.14-15 \|\|

*aṣṭāṃgo vā ṣaḍaṃgo vā sarvayogaḥ samāsataḥ \|*  
*yamaśca niyamaścaiva svastikādyaṃ tathāsanam \|\| 14 \|\|*

*prāṇāyāmaḥ pratyāhāro dhāraṇā dhyānameva ca \|*  
*samādhiriti yogāṃgānyaṣṭāvuktāni sūribhiḥ \|\| 15 \|\|*

14-15. In brief the Yoga is of eight or six ancillaries. The eight ancillaries are Yama, Niyama, Āsana Prāṇāyāma, Pratyāhārā, Dhāraṇa, Dhyānā and Samādhi as mentioned by the wise.

## \|\| 12.37.16 \|\|

*āsanaṃ prāṇasaṃrodhaḥ pratyāhārotha dhāraṇā \|*  
*dhyānaṃ samādhiryogasya ṣaḍaṃgāni samāsataḥ \|\| 16 \|\|*

16\. The six Aṅgas are in brief Āsana, Prāṇasaṃrodha, Pratyāhāra, Dhāraṇā, Dhyāna and Samādhi.

## \|\| 12.37.17-18 \|\|

*pṛthaglakṣaṇameteṣāṃ śivaśāstre samīritam \|*  
*śivāgameṣu cānyeṣu viśeṣātkāmikādiṣu \|\| 17 \|\|*

*yogaśāstreṣvapi tathā purāṇeṣvapi keṣu ca \|*  
*ahiṃsā satyamasteyaṃ brahmacaryāparigrahaḥ \|*

*yama ityucyate sadbhiḥ pañcāvayavayogataḥ \|*  
*śaucaṃ tuṣṭistapaścaiva japaḥ praṇidhireva ca \|\| 18 \|\|*

17-18. The definitions of all these separately have been mentioned in Śivaśāstra and other Śaivite scriptures, especially Kāmikā etc. They are mentioned in Yogaśāstras and Purāṇas also. Yama is the observance of restraints such as nonviolence, non-stealing, abstention from sexual intercourse and non-acceptance of monetary gifts. The five constitute the subdivisions of Yama.

## \|\| 12.37.19 \|\|

*iti pañcaprabhedassyānniyamaḥ svāṃśabhedataḥ \|*  
*svastikaṃ padmamadhyeṃduṃ vīraṃ yogaṃ prasādhitam \|\| 19 \|\|*

19\. Niyama is the positive curb or restraint with the following five subdivisions—purity, contentment, penance, japa and attentiveness.

## \|\| 12.37.20 \|\|

*paryaṃkaṃ ca yatheṣṭaṃ ca proktamāsanamaṣṭadhā \|*  
*prāṇaḥ svadehajo vāyustasyāyāmo nirodhanam \|\| 20 \|\|*

20\. Āsana is the Yogic pose and is of eight types such as Svastika, Padma, Ardhendu, Vīra, Yoga, Prasādhita, Paryaṅka and Yatheṣṭa.

## \|\| 12.37.21 \|\|

*tadrocakaṃ pūrakaṃ ca kuṃbhakaṃ ca tridhocyate \|*  
*nāsikāpuṭamaṃgulyā pīḍyaikamapareṇa tu \|\| 21 \|\|*

21\. Prāṇa is the vital breath in the body. Āyāma is checking. Hence Prāṇāyāma means checking or restraining the breath. It is of three forms—Recaka, Pūraka and Kumbhaka.

## \|\| 12.37.22 \|\|

*audaraṃ recayedvāyuṃ tathāyaṃ recakaḥ smṛtaḥ \|*  
*bāhyena marutā dehaṃ dṛtivatparipūrayet \|\| 22 \|\|*

22\. One of the nostrils is pressed with the finger and the air from the belly is let out through the other. This is Recaka (Exhaling).

## \|\| 12.37.23 \|\|

*nāsāpuṭenāpareṇa pūraṇātpūrakaṃ matam \|*  
*na muṃcati na gṛhṇāti vāyumaṃtarbahiḥ sthitam \|\| 23 \|\|*

23\. Then through the other nostril the external air is inhaled and the body is filled up like the bellows. It is Pūraka (Inhaling).

## \|\| 12.37.24 \|\|

*saṃpūrṇaṃ kuṃbhavattiṣṭhedacalaḥ sa tu kuṃbhaka \|*  
*recakādyaṃ trayamidaṃ na drutaṃ na vilaṃbitam \|\| 24 \|\|*

24\. He does not breathe out the internal or breathe in the external air. He remains steady like the fìlled-up jar. It is called Kumbhaka (Retention).

## \|\| 12.37.25 \|\|

*tadyataḥ kramayogena tvabhyasedyogasādhakaḥ \|*  
*recakādiṣu yobhyāso nāḍīśodhanapūrvakaḥ \|\| 25 \|\|*

25\. The three, Recaka etc. shall not be done hurriedly or slowly. The practiser of Yoga shall adopt them gradually with restraint.

## \|\| 12.37.26 \|\|

*svecchotkramaṇaparyaṃtaḥ prokto yogānuśāsane \|*  
*kanyakādikramavaśātprāṇāyāmanirodhanam \|\| 26 \|\|*

26\. The practice of Recaka shall begin with the purification of the veins and conclude with its voluntary exit as mentioned in the Yogānuśāsana.

## \|\| 12.37.27 \|\|

*taccaturdhopadiṣṭaṃ syānmātrāguṇavibhāgataḥ \|*  
*kanyakastu caturdhā syātsa ca dvādaśamātrakaḥ \|\| 27 \|\|*

27\. Prāṇāyāma is one of the four varieties in view of the time-units, Kanyaka etc.

## \|\| 12.37.28 \|\|

*madhyamastu dviruddhātaścaturviṃśatimātrakaḥ \|*  
*uttamastu triruddhātaḥ ṣaḍviṃśanmātrakaḥ paraḥ \|\| 28 \|\|*

28\. Kanyaka is without Udghāta (strokes). Its duration is twelve Mātrās. Madhyama has two strokes, its duration is twenty-four Mātrās.

## \|\| 12.37.29 \|\|

*svedakaṃpādijanakaḥ prāṇāyāmastaduttaraḥ \|*  
*ānaṃdodbhavaromāṃcanetrāśrūṇāṃ vimocanam \|\| 29 \|\|*

29\. Uttama has three strokes and its duration is thirty-six Mātrās. Uttara is the Prāṇāyāma that causes perspiration and trembling of the body.

## \|\| 12.37.30 \|\|

*jalpabhramaṇamūrchādyaṃ jāyate yoginaḥ param \|*  
*jānuṃ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya na drutaṃ na vilaṃbitam \|\| 30 \|\|*

30\. The yogin has experiences—the thrill of bliss, horripilation and shedding of tears. He may prattle. There may be vertigo and senselessness.

## \|\| 12.37.31 \|\|

*aṃgulīsphoṭanaṃ kuryātsā mātreti prakīrtitā \|*  
*mātrākrameṇa vijñeyāścodvātakramayogataḥ \|\| 31 \|\|*

31\. Mātrā is the unit of time required for the snapping of the fingers after moving them round the knees neither speedily nor slowly.

## \|\| 12.37.32 \|\|

*nāḍīviśuddhipūrvaṃ tu prāṇāyāmaṃ samācaret \|*  
*agarbhaśca sagarbhaśca prāṇāyāmo dvidhā smṛtaḥ \|\| 32 \|\|*

32\. The duration of Prāṇāyāma shall be increased in accordance with the Mātrās and strokes. The veins shall be necessarily purified.

## \|\| 12.37.33 \|\|

*japaṃ dhyānaṃ vināgarbhaḥ sagarbhastatsamanvayāt \|*  
*agarbhādgarbhasaṃyuktaḥ prāṇāyāmaḥśatādhikaḥ \|\| 33 \|\|*

33\. The Prāṇāyāma is again twofold: Agarbha and Sagarbha. Restraining the breath without meditation and Japa is called Agarbha Prāṇāyāma. If they too are included it is called Sagarbha.

## \|\| 12.37.34 \|\|

*tasmātsagarbhaṃ kurvanti yoginaḥ prāṇasaṃyamam \|*  
*prāṇasya vijayādeva jīyaṃte deha 1 āyavaḥ \|\| 34 \|\|*

34\. The Sagarbha Prāṇāyāma is hundred times more efficacious than the Agarbha. Yogins practise Sagarbha Prāṇāyāma.

## \|\| 12.37.35-36 \|\|

*prāṇo 'pānaḥ samānaśca hyudāno vyāna eva ca \|*  
*nāgaḥ kūrmaśca kṛkalo devadatto dhanaṃjayaḥ \|\| 35 \|\|*

*prayāṇaṃ kurute yasmāttasmātprāṇo 'bhidhīyate \|*  
*avāṅnayatyapānākhyo yadāhārādi bhujyate \|\| 36 \|\|*

35-36. The vital breaths of the body can be conquered through the mastery over Prāṇa. The vital breaths are Prāṇa, Apāna, Samāna, Udāna, Vyāna, Nāga, Kūrma, Kṛkara, Devadatta and Dhanañjaya. That which causes the movement is called Prāṇa.

## \|\| 12.37.37 \|\|

*vyāno vyānaśayatyaṃgānyaśeṣāṇi vivardhayan \|*  
*udvejayati marmāṇītyudāno vāyurīritaḥ \|\| 37 \|\|*

37\. Apāna is the vital air that takes the food lower down. Vyāna is diffused through the limbs and it develops them.

## \|\| 12.37.38 \|\|

*samaṃ nayati sarvāṃgaṃ samānastena gīyate \|*  
*udgāre nāga ākhyātaḥ kūrma unmīlane sthitaḥ \|\| 38 \|\|*

38\. Udāna is the vital air that affects the vulnerable points in the body among the limbs. The vital air that spreads equally is called Samāna.

## \|\| 12.37.39 \|\|

*kṛkalaḥ kṣavathau jñeyo devadatto vijṛṃbhaṇe \|*  
*na jahāti mṛtaṃ cāpi sarvavyāpī dhanaṃjayaḥ \|\| 39 \|\|*

39\. The vital air Nāga is for the activity of belching. Kūrma is for the activity of dosing the eyes; the vital air Kṛkara is the activity of sneezing and the vital air Devadatta is the activity of yawning.

## \|\| 12.37.40 \|\|

*krameṇābhyasyamānoyaṃ prāṇāyāmapramāṇavān \|*  
*nirdahatyakhilaṃ doṣaṃ karturdehaṃ ca rakṣati \|\| 40 \|\|*

40\. Dhanañjaya is the vital air that circulates through the body. It does not leave off even the dead body. Gradually practised, Prāṇāyāma is very efficacious.

## \|\| 12.37.41 \|\|

*prāṇe tu vijite samyaktaccihnānyupalakṣayet \|*  
*viṇmūtraśleṣmaṇāṃ tāvadalpabhāvaḥ prajāyate \|\| 41 \|\|*

41\. It burns off all defects. It preserves the body of practisers. When the Prāṇa is mastered the symptoms are manifest.

## \|\| 12.37.42-44 \|\|

*bahubhojanasāmarthyaṃ cirāducchvāsanaṃ tathā \|*  
*laghutvaṃ śīghragāmitvamutsāhaḥ svarasauṣṭhavam \|\| 42 \|\|*

*sarvarogakṣayaścaiva balaṃ tejaḥ surūpatā \|*  
*dhṛtirmedhā yuvatvaṃ ca sthiratā ca prasannatā \|\| 43 \|\|*

*tapāṃsi pāpakṣayatā yajñadānavratādayaḥ \|*  
*prāṇāyāmasya tasyaite kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm \|\| 44 \|\|*

42-44. Urine, phlegm and faeces are reduced in quantity. Ability to eat much and to breathe slowly, lightness of the body, ability to walk fast, enthusiasm, clearness of voice and tone, destruction of ailments, strength, brilliance, comeliness of features, courage, intelligence, youthfulness, firmness and all round pleasure these are the symptoms. All forms of austerities, expiations, sacrifices, charitable gifts, holy rites do not merit even a sixteenth part of the benefit of Prāṇāyāma.

## \|\| 12.37.45-47 \|\|

*indriyāṇi prasaktāni yathāsvaṃ viṣayeṣviha \|*  
*āhatya yannigṛhṇāti sa pratyāhāra ucyate \|\| 45 \|\|*

*namaḥpūrvāṇīṃdriyāṇi svargaṃ narakameva ca \|*  
*nigṛhītanisṛṣṭāni svargāya narakāya ca \|\| 46 \|\|*

*tasmātsukhārthī matimāñjñānavairāgyamāsthitaḥ \|*  
*iṃdriyāśvānnigṛhyāśu svātmanātmānamuddharet \|\| 47 \|\|*

45-47. The total withdrawal of the sense-organs operating in their respective objects is called Pratyāhāra. The sense-organs are the mind etc. They are capable of according heaven and hell. When restrained they yield heaven, when let loose they are hellish.
